items.abstract: This study explores the intersection of religion and state through a single-case, mixed-methods research design, focusing on Israeli state elementary school principals, who administer religious directives embedded in state legislation. We ask: Under what conditions street-level managers’ discretion in policy implementation increases social satisfaction and cohesion? We argue that such discretion increases social satisfaction and cohesion under the following conditions: (1) When state policies are explicitly or implicitly vague and flexible, (2) When official policy is contested among societal groups, and (3) When street-level managers opt to respond to client preferences. In addition, we suggest that public satisfaction with the resulted public services increases when a manager's personal ideology aligns with client attitudes and expectations. The study demonstrates how principals exercise significant discretion in implementing religious policy and thus contributes to broader public administration literature by highlighting the role of street-level managers in navigating policy ambiguity, while mediating societal tensions.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 이스라엘 국립 초등학교 교장에 대한 단일 사례 혼합방법 연구를 통해, 종교 정책 집행에서 일선 관리자의 재량이 언제 사회적 만족과 결속을 높이는지 분석했다. 정책이 모호하고 유연하며 사회집단 간 논쟁의 대상이고, 관리자가 이용자 선호에 응답할 때 재량의 긍정적 효과가 커졌으며, 관리자의 개인 이념이 이용자 태도·기대와 일치할 때 서비스 만족도도 높아졌다.
items.title: Navigating Ambiguity: Street-Level Managers Discretion in the Implementation of Religious Policy in Divided Societies

items.abstract: Abstract We develop the concept of, and estimation tools for, durable majority gerrymanders : electoral district maps drawn to reduce an opposing political party's probability of winning a majority in a legislative chamber. Directly interpretable, forward‐looking, and motivated by the democratic principle that a party in power should have some chance of losing it, this measure provides new insights into the role of redistricting in state legislative elections. We show that, when map drawers are unconstrained, the ability to create durable majorities is so widespread that at least one party in every state can draw a map where a majority of legislative districts withstand almost any likely future electoral swing. Enacted maps are less durable due to a combination of underlying geography, voter partisanship, and state‐level guidelines. This paper provides the theoretical framework and empirical tools to understand which gerrymandered maps enable state‐level majorities to emerge and to endure.

Benjamin Schneer: Associate Professor, Harvard Kennedy School Cambridge Massachusetts USA
Maxwell Palmer: Associate Professor, Department of Political Science Boston University Boston Massachusetts USA

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 야당의 주 의회 다수당 승리 가능성을 낮추는 ‘지속 가능한 다수 게리맨더링’을 개념화하고, 이를 추정하는 도구로 선거구 재획정이 다수당의 형성과 지속에 미치는 영향을 분석한다. 제약이 없으면 모든 주에서 한 정당이 예상 가능한 미래 선거 변동에도 견디는 의석 다수를 만들 수 있지만, 실제 확정된 지도는 지리, 유권자 당파성, 주 차원의 지침 때문에 덜 지속적인 것으로 나타난다.
items.title: Durable majority gerrymanders: Where partisan gerrymandering can displace democracy

items.abstract: Abstract Political actors form coalitions around their joint normative beliefs in order to influence the policy process on contentious issues such as climate change or population aging. Policy process theory maintains that learning within and across coalitions is a central predictor of policy change but has yet to explain how policy learning works. This article explains the formation and maintenance of coalitions by focusing on the ways actors adopt policy beliefs from other actors in policy debates. A policy debate is a complex social system in which temporal network dependence guides how actors contribute ideological statements. Belief adoption matters in three complementary ways: bonding , which exploits cues within coalitions; bridging , which explores new beliefs outside one's perimeter; and repulsion , which reinforces polarization between coalitions and cements their belief systems. We formalize this theory of endogenous coalition formation in policy debates and test it on a micro‐level empirical data set.

Laurence Brandenberger: Institute of Political Science University of Zurich Zurich Switzerland
Philip Leifeld: Department of Social Statistics University of Manchester Manchester UK

items.summary_ko: 정책 논쟁에서 행위자들이 다른 행위자의 정책 신념을 채택하는 방식이 연합의 형성과 유지 및 정책학습에 어떻게 작용하는지를 이론화하고, 시간적 네트워크 의존성을 반영한 미시 수준 경험자료로 검증했다. 연합 내부의 단서 활용(bonding), 외부 신념 탐색(bridging), 연합 간 반발(repulsion)이 상호보완적으로 신념체계를 형성하고 양극화를 강화하는 것으로 제시된다.
items.title: Endogenous coalition formation in policy debates

items.abstract: Does news coverage stimulate curiosity in state high court candidates? Data compiled from the Associated Press and Google Trends from 2004 to 2020 suggest that as media coverage increases on candidates, people are more likely to seek information about the candidates on Google. Furthermore, reports about the candidates’ off-bench behavior are more likely to promote information-seeking behavior. State judicial selection method also plays a crucial role in information-seeking behavior, as coverage of nonpartisan justices motivates information-seeking regardless of the type of coverage. This study suggests that information about the campaigns of incumbent officeholders increases information-seeking behavior, but information about their job performance does not.
items.summary_ko: 주(州) 고등법원 후보자에 대한 언론 보도가 시민의 구글 정보탐색을 촉진하는지 2004~2020년 AP 보도와 Google Trends 자료로 분석한 결과, 보도량이 많을수록 정보탐색이 증가했다. 특히 재판 외 행동에 관한 보도가 효과가 컸으며, 비정당 선출 방식에서는 보도 유형과 관계없이 정보탐색이 촉진된 반면, 현직자의 선거운동 보도는 이를 늘렸지만 직무수행 보도는 그렇지 않았다.
items.title: Examining the Influence of Media Coverage on Information-Seeking of Judicial Candidates

items.abstract: Whether youth can gain political knowledge through social media is long debated. Existing research has insufficiently accounted for different curating actors of political information, an indirect learning logic, and within-person changes. To fill these gaps, we conducted a large-scale three-wave panel study among 16- to 30-year-olds (NT3 = 2276) to examine how exposure to different social media actors such as politicians, peers, or influencers relates to the acquisition of current affairs knowledge over time. We investigated perceived opinion leadership gratifications as a novel underlying mechanism in this process. While increased exposure to all curating actors’ political content was related to higher opinion leadership gratifications in the same wave, we found little indirect learning effects over time on the within-person level through obtained gratifications. This association emerged only during the national election period, when perceived opinion leadership gratifications from peers’ political content were linked to above-usual gains in objective political knowledge over time.
items.summary_ko: 16~30세 청년을 대상으로 3시점 패널조사를 실시해 정치인·동료·인플루언서 등 소셜미디어 정보 큐레이터에 대한 노출이 시사 지식 습득과 어떻게 관련되는지, 그리고 의견지도자 보상 인식이 매개하는지를 분석했다. 모든 큐레이터의 정치 콘텐츠 노출은 같은 시점의 의견지도자 보상 인식 증가와 관련됐지만, 시간에 따른 개인 내 간접 학습 효과는 대체로 미약했으며, 전국 선거 기간에만 동료 콘텐츠에서 얻은 의견지도자 보상 인식이 객관적 정치 지식의 평소보다 큰 증가와 연결됐다.
items.title: Trending Topics, Growing Knowledge? How Curating Actors’ Political Social Media Content Affects Youth’s Political Knowledge

items.abstract: ABSTRACT A growing body of experimental public administration research examines how structural arrangements in public services, such as delegating service delivery to public or private actors, shape citizens' blame attributions for service failures. However, the mechanisms underlying these attributions are less well understood. This article investigates two mechanisms, focusing on the mediating roles of citizens' perceptions of politicians' causal responsibility (perceived control over service delivery) and functional responsibility (perceived duty to ensure service quality). A UK‐based survey experiment on local waste collection failures tests these mechanisms using causal mediation analysis. The results show higher levels of delegation reduce blame primarily by lowering perceptions of politicians' control over service delivery. In contrast, there is no strong evidence of mediation through perceived duty, suggesting that role‐based expectations of functional responsibility are more resistant to change. These findings provide new insight into how different public service delivery methods influence blame attribution for service performance.

Oscar Nowlan: Department of Government London School of Economics and Political Science London UK

items.summary_ko: 영국 지방 폐기물 수거 실패를 다룬 설문 실험과 인과적 매개분석을 통해, 공공서비스 위탁이 정치인의 서비스 제공 통제력에 대한 인식을 낮춰 비난을 주로 감소시키는지, 그리고 서비스 품질 확보 의무 인식이 이를 매개하는지를 검토했다. 위탁은 통제력 인식을 낮추는 경로를 통해 비난을 줄였지만, 기능적 책임 의무 인식을 통한 매개에 대한 강한 증거는 없었다.
items.title: Public Service Delegation and the Mechanisms of Blame Attribution: Evidence From a Survey Experiment on Public Service Failure

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Participatory and collaborative governance (P&CG) is widely celebrated as an institutional vehicle for democratizing public decision‐making by inviting affected stakeholders into inclusive and deliberative policy processes. This essay argues that underlying appeals to democratic legitimacy in P&CG are tacit commitments to specific (and often ideologically bounded) conceptions of justice. Democracy, far from being normatively univocal, encompasses competing justice principles that yield divergent and sometimes incompatible design imperatives. In response, this essay calls for a shift from vague democratic invocations to a more precise theorization of justice as the operative normative currency in P&CG. To this end, the essay outlines an analytical framework that maps three core dimensions of governance design (input, process, and output) onto corresponding domains of justice: representational, procedural, and distributive. Systematically unpacking the plural and conflicting ethical principles within each domain shows how different principles of justice produce distinct governance dilemmas and trade‐offs.

Alexander L. Q. Chen‐Florea: Department of Social Sciences and Business Roskilde University Roskilde Denmark

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 참여·협력적 거버넌스에서 민주적 정당성이라는 호소가 특정한 정의관에 대한 암묵적 약속을 포함한다는 점을 문제로 제기하고, 민주주의 대신 정의를 핵심 규범적 기준으로 명확히 이론화할 것을 제안한다. 거버넌스 설계의 투입·과정·산출 차원을 각각 대표성·절차·분배 정의에 연결하는 분석 틀을 제시하며, 정의 원칙의 다원성과 충돌이 서로 다른 설계 딜레마와 상충을 낳는다고 주장한다.
items.title: Putting Democratic Theory and Principles of Justice in the Right Place: Ethical Pluralism in Collaborative and Participatory Governance

items.abstract: We explore citizens’ support for behavioral interventions by distinguishing interventions that exploit citizens’ bounded rationality through choice architecture (Nudge) from those that challenge bounded rationality by promoting reflection through deliberative forums (Think). We also examine the role of trust in government in shaping these preferences. Findings from two experiments involving 3,010 US participants show that citizens are more willing to support Think rather than Nudge. Whereas the adoption of Nudge, as compared to Think, does not seem to influence trust in government, encouraging higher levels of trust in government has a stronger effect on support for Nudge than for Think.

Martin Lodge: London School of Economics and Political Science

items.summary_ko: 두 온라인 실험(미국 참가자 3,010명)을 통해 시민들이 선택구조로 제한된 합리성을 활용하는 ‘넛지’와 숙의를 통해 성찰을 촉진하는 ‘싱크’ 중 무엇을 더 지지하는지, 그리고 정부 신뢰가 이러한 선호에 미치는 영향을 검토했다. 시민들은 넛지보다 싱크를 더 지지했으며, 정부 신뢰를 높이는 것은 싱크보다 넛지 지지에 더 큰 영향을 미쳤지만, 넛지 채택 자체는 싱크와 비교해 정부 신뢰에 뚜렷한 영향을 주지 않았다.
items.title: Citizens’ support for behavioural public policy and trust in government: evidence from two online experiments

items.abstract: Abstract Existing research suggests that a lack of institutional memory causes history to repeat in problematic ways within public administration agencies. However, this claim has not been well supported by theory or data that illuminate the process and effects of history repeating. To remedy this, the nascent concept of institutional amnesia is presented here as a means of theorizing repetitions of public administrative history. A sequential explanatory mixed method research design uses quantitative survey data (n = 1608) and qualitative interview data (n = 75) generated in the public services of Australia, New Zealand, and the UK to show how institutional amnesia can lead to the recycling of ideas and practices, the inefficient relearning of information-seeking processes and the delivery of conducive decision-making environments that can help address historical problems. These findings draw attention to the fact that administrative history does indeed repeat in public agencies because of institutional amnesia, but that it does so in positive as well as negative ways.

Alastair Stark: School of Political Science and International Studies, University of Queensland , Brisbane 4172,
Dennis C Grube: Department of Politics and International Relations, University of Cambridge , Cambridge CB3 9DP,
Heather Lovell: School of Geography, Planning, and Spatial Sciences, University of Tasmania , Tasmania 7005,
Hridesh Gajural: School of Regulation and Global Governance, Australian National University , Canberra 2601,
Jack Corbett: School of Social Sciences, Monash University , Victoria 3145,

items.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 제도적 기억의 부재인 ‘제도적 망각’이 공공기관에서 행정의 역사를 어떻게 반복시키는지 설명하고자, 호주·뉴질랜드·영국 공공서비스의 설문조사(n=1,608)와 인터뷰(n=75)를 활용한 순차적 혼합방법을 적용했다. 제도적 망각은 아이디어와 관행의 재순환, 정보탐색 과정의 비효율적 재학습을 초래하지만, 역사적 문제 해결에 도움이 되는 의사결정 환경도 조성할 수 있어 역사 반복은 부정적·긍정적 방식 모두로 나타났다.
items.title: Institutional amnesia and public administration: does history repeat?

items.abstract: Recent scholarship attends to politicized popular cultural spaces. Scarcely understood is how audiences of these spaces contend with this scrutiny. In response, I introduce the concept of anti-political space to describe how fans of politicized media spatially distinguish popular cultural spaces from institutional politics. This is conceptualized through a critical discourse analysis of the official Barstool Sports (Barstool) subreddit from 2019 to 2025, where fans share critical news coverage of Barstool. Across 16 analyzed threads, criticism is rendered unfounded or demonstrative of politically obsessed liberal culture. I argue fans’ varied expressions of victimhood and estrangement, while nominally defending against politicization, showcase how reactionary political discourse appears beyond institutional political spaces. Theoretically, this analysis recognizes how symbolic contests over what constitutes politics occur through boundary work. As the political relevance of popular cultural spaces increases in the contemporary media landscape, this analysis underscores how boundary work defends against the felt intrusion of politics into popular culture. Amid broader sociotechnical changes, I suggest anti-political spaces are poised to be a continued feature of the contemporary media environment.
items.summary_ko: 정치화된 대중문화 공간의 이용자들이 제도정치와 대중문화를 어떻게 구분하고 정치적 비판에 대응하는지, 2019~2025년 r/BarstoolSports의 비판적 보도 관련 16개 게시물에 대한 비판적 담론분석으로 검토했다. 이용자들은 비판을 근거 없거나 ‘정치에 집착하는 진보적 문화’의 산물로 묘사하며 피해의식과 소외감을 드러냈고, 이러한 경계 설정이 대중문화의 정치적 침투를 막는 동시에 반동적 정치 담론을 비제도적 공간에 재현한다고 주장한다.
items.title: Policing the Political Boundary: How the r/BarstoolSports Audience Confronts Politicization

items.abstract: Abstract Standard statistical uncertainty measures, like standard errors, are unable to quantify the uncertainty from an unrepresentative sampling process. Existing work has highlighted the potential risk in large datasets, in which larger surveys resulting in more precise estimates can misleadingly overstate the degree of confidence in biased survey results. In this research note, we introduce a sensitivity framework for researchers to transparently summarize their uncertainty to a biased sampling process. We illustrate the framework on a set of COVID-19 vaccine surveys, and show that had researchers conducted a sensitivity analysis, they would have found that despite substantially smaller standard errors, the larger surveys conducted on less representative samples were more susceptible to potential bias than smaller surveys conducted on more representative samples. We argue that these summary measures should be routinely reported to accurately quantify uncertainty to potential bias, allowing researchers to assess their confidence in results, in large and small datasets.

Erin Hartman: Department of Political Science, University of California, Berkeley Associate Professor, , Berkeley, CA,
Melody Huang: Department of Political Science, Yale University Assistant Professor, , New Haven, CT,

items.summary_ko: 대표성이 낮은 표본에서 발생하는 비무시적 응답 편향에 대한 불확실성을 어떻게 평가할지 분석하기 위해, 연구진은 설문 가중치에 대한 민감도 분석 틀을 제시하고 코로나19 백신 접종률 설문에 적용했다. 그 결과, 표준오차는 더 작더라도 대표성이 낮은 표본을 사용한 대규모 조사가 대표성이 높은 소규모 조사보다 잠재적 편향에 더 취약할 수 있음을 보였다.
items.title: Assessing Nonignorable Response: Sensitivity Analysis for Survey Weighting, with Applications to Survey Estimates of COVID-19 Vaccination Uptake

items.abstract: Research on public service motivation consistently finds that public employees volunteer and contribute more than their private sector counterparts, yet less is known about how engagement varies across behavioral domains and institutional contexts. This study examines how civic engagement is structured among public employees compared to other citizens, with particular attention to variation across levels of government. Using the 2023 CPS Volunteering and Civic Life Supplement, the analysis constructs multidimensional measures across four domains: political participation, civic involvement, political expression, and social connectedness. Weighted regressions and propensity score matching show that public employees, especially at the local level, exhibit a distinct civic profile characterized by greater involvement in institutional forms of participation such as voting and volunteering, but lower engagement in informal activities such as political discussion and social interaction. These patterns persist after accounting for observable characteristics and suggest that public employment channels participation into specific forms rather than uniformly increasing overall engagement, with implications for how civil service reforms may alter the civic composition of local communities.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 2023년 CPS 자원봉사·시민생활 보충조사를 활용해 정부 수준별 공공부문 종사자와 다른 시민의 시민참여가 어떻게 다른지 분석했다. 가중 회귀와 성향점수매칭 결과, 특히 지방정부 종사자는 투표·자원봉사 같은 제도적 참여는 더 많지만 정치적 대화·사회적 교류 같은 비공식 참여는 더 적은 독특한 참여 양상을 보였다.
items.title: Civic Embeddedness and Public Employment: How Institutional Proximity Structures Civic Participation

items.abstract: How do front-line public managers become institutional entrepreneurs? This article answers that question through a longitudinal single-case study of a large Norwegian municipality's healthcare services. Drawing on organizational institutionalism and public management scholarship, I first show how front-line public managers initiate divergent change by leveraging a sensing–legitimation nexus. They detect external and internal triggers, frame the need for change, and secure political, administrative, and professional support through direct negotiation and compelling operational narratives. They then act as co-creation catalysts, engaging residents and building cross-sector partnerships to adapt service designs and mobilize scarce resources. Finally, they institutionalize transformative public healthcare delivery by embedding routines in daily operations, formalizing interdisciplinary team structures, clarifying roles, and demonstrating performance gains. Evidence from two innovation projects shows that resource-constrained, non-heroic actors can disrupt entrenched practices and stabilize innovation as the new institutional arrangement. The study contributes to institutional entrepreneurship theory by positioning front-line public managers as credible entrepreneurial agents and by identifying co-creation as a core mechanism of public sector institutional change.

Petter Gullmark: UiT The Arctic University of Norway, School of Business and Economics, Tromsø, Norway

items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이 대규모 지방자치단체의 보건의료 서비스를 대상으로 한 종단적 단일사례연구는 일선 공공관리자가 어떻게 제도적 기업가가 되는지를 분석했다. 이들은 외부·내부 변화를 감지하고 정당화·협상한 뒤, 주민 및 부문 간 파트너십을 통한 공동창조와 일상 업무·팀 구조·역할의 제도화를 통해 제약된 자원 속에서도 혁신을 새로운 제도적 배열로 정착시켰다.
items.title: How Front-Line Public Managers Become Institutional Entrepreneurs

items.abstract: This study investigates how formal politicization shapes the turnover of senior public executives. Using a dataset of 138 CEOs across 79 Italian public hospitals between 2017 and 2021, it examines the relative influence of managerial competence and partisan loyalty on the likelihood of CEO exit. Although both factors affect turnover, partisan loyalty emerges as the primary driver. Political stability significantly lowers CEO dismissal risk, even with weak organizational performance or limited managerial human capital, which plays a secondary role. These findings suggest that NPM reforms have been only partially effective, with patronage practices persisting within a formally meritocratic institutional framework.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 2017~2021년 이탈리아 공공병원 79곳의 CEO 138명 자료를 이용해 공식적 정치화가 고위 공공경영자의 퇴임에 미치는 영향을 분석했다. 정당 충성도가 관리 역량보다 퇴임을 더 크게 좌우했으며, 정치적 안정성은 조직 성과나 관리 인적자본이 약해도 해임 위험을 낮췄다.
items.title: “Old Habits Die Hard”: Formal Politicization and the Turnover of Public Hospital CEOs

items.abstract: Abstract Quantitative methods remain central in public administration research, but without a corrective lens, they can obscure the underlying dynamics they purport to measure. Building on Critical Race Theory’s critique of color-blind objectivity and the emerging QuantCrit literature, this article frames how conventional statistical practices, including feedback-driven policies, fixed classification schemes, and unexamined research standpoints, perpetuate racialized inequities. We position Quantitative Critical Race Theory (QuantCrit) as a methodological corrective, anchored by four tenets: the centrality of racism, the non-neutrality of numbers, the contingency of categories, and the necessity to incorporate marginalized voices. Applying these principles, we trace QuantCrit’s evolution, illustrate its relevance across public administration subfields (notably representative bureaucracy and public budgeting), and provide a practical roadmap for embedding reflexivity, asset-focused questions, and intersectional measures into quantitative designs. By shifting from mere demographic tabulation to interrogating the statistical logics that entrench racial inequities, QuantCrit empowers public administration scholars to move beyond documenting disparities and toward dismantling the institutional structures of systemic racism.

Brittany Houston: School of Public Policy, University of Massachusetts Amherst , Amherst, MA 01003-9277,
James E Wright II: School of Public Affairs & School of Criminology and Criminal Justice, Watts College of Public Service, Arizona State University , Phoenix, AZ 85004,

items.journal: Perspectives on Public Management and Governance
items.summary_ko: 이 글은 인종적 불평등을 간과하거나 재생산할 수 있는 공공행정의 전통적 양적 연구 관행을 어떻게 교정할 수 있는지 검토한다. QuantCrit의 네 가지 원칙을 바탕으로 대표관료제와 공공예산 등 분야에 적용할 수 있는 성찰성·자산 중심 질문·교차성 측정의 설계 방향을 제시하며, 단순한 격차 기록을 넘어 인종화된 통계 논리와 제도적 구조를 분석해야 한다고 주장한다.
items.title: Beyond neutrality: QuantCrit as a methodological corrective in quantitative public administration research

items.abstract: In this article, we examine TikTok memes about former Vice president Kamala Harris that circulated through the digital registers of the Charli XCX-inspired “Kamala is Brat” trend. By analyzing the form, function, and affective resonance of these memes, we explore how creators interpreted and reframed Harris’s image leading up to the 2024 U.S. presidential election. Using a multimodal analysis, we introduce a three-layer analytic that distinguishes memetic form, communicative function, and affective character. Our findings show how creators mobilized recognizable meme templates, narrative positioning, and affective cues to recast Harris through identity-signaling and aesthetic contrast to her opponent. We also find that TikTok’s features enabled a pop culture intertextuality in which other viral trends – including the appeal of “it girl” Julia Fox, and the symbolic ambiguity of signifiers ranging from Pulp Fiction, The Matrix, and coconuts – become linked to the candidate. We argue that platform-native meme cultures on TikTok operate as mechanisms of vernacular electoral mediation, enabling creators to reinterpret candidate imagery and political narratives through the aesthetic conventions of platform culture. In doing so, this work demonstrates how participatory meme practices contribute to the symbolic construction of electoral candidates in contemporary digital media environments.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 2024년 미국 대선을 앞두고 ‘Kamala is Brat’ 트렌드의 틱톡 밈이 카멀라 해리스의 이미지를 어떻게 해석·재구성했는지를 다중양식 분석으로 탐구했다. 분석 결과, 틱톡의 플랫폼 고유 밈 형식과 대중문화적 상호텍스트성이 정체성 신호와 미학적 대비를 통해 후보자 이미지와 정치 서사를 재구성하는 참여적 선거 매개의 수단으로 작동했다.
items.title: Kamala is Brat: TikTok and the Affective Politics of Memes

items.abstract: Public and political debate increasingly problematizes the relationship between second-generation migrants and public authorities, yet little is known about how they evaluate local government. This study examines behavioural intentions towards municipalities – exit, voice, loyalty and neglect – and assesses how trust, local identification and discrimination shape these responses. Using survey data from second-generation migrants in Dutch municipalities, we find loyalty predominates, while trust, local identification and discrimination shape these orientations towards local government. These findings highlight the central role of trust and inclusion in shaping citizen–state relations and demonstrate the value of integrating migrant-centred perspectives into public administration research.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 지방자치단체의 2세 이민자를 대상으로 지방정부에 대한 행동 의향(이탈·발언·충성·방임)이 신뢰, 지역 정체성, 차별에 따라 어떻게 달라지는지 설문조사로 분석했다. 충성이 가장 우세했으며, 신뢰·지역 정체성·차별이 지방정부에 대한 이러한 행동 지향을 형성하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Should we stay or should we go? Implications of trust in the municipality for second-generation migrants’ behavioural intentions towards the municipality

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Public and nonprofit organizations exhibit high rates of female employment often attributed to sector structures and social roles. To better understand how individual behaviors dynamically contribute to these distinctive ratios, we deconstruct public and nonprofit employment into gendered patterns of attraction and attachment. Using duration analysis and following a cohort from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997, this research finds that women demonstrate a higher attraction to their first public and nonprofit job compared to men, evidenced through a faster rate of entry into this employment. There are no significant gender differences when considering the duration of an individual's first stint in these sectors. Additional investigation finds that these sector‐level patterns, when decomposed to account for gender‐dominant professions, are driven by stronger female attraction to female‐dominated professions while masking higher female turnover from male‐dominated professions. Results inform recruitment and retention strategies for public and nonprofit organizations.

Femida Handy: School of Social Policy and Practice University of Pennsylvania Philadelphia Pennsylvania USA
Tiana Marrese: School of Public Affairs and Administration Rutgers University Newark New Jersey USA
Ying Liu: University of Rhode Island Kingston Rhode Island USA

items.summary_ko: 청년 코호트의 공공·비영리 부문 최초 진입과 이탈을 성별에 따라 어떻게 설명할 수 있는지, NLSY97 코호트에 대한 지속기간 분석으로 검토했다. 여성은 남성보다 최초 공공·비영리 일자리에 더 빠르게 진입했지만 최초 재직기간에는 성별 차이가 없었으며, 이러한 패턴은 여성 지배 직종에 대한 여성의 높은 유입과 남성 지배 직종에서의 여성 이직률 증가가 함께 작용한 결과로 나타났다.
items.title: The Gendered Path of Least Resistance: First Entry and Exit Behaviors of Public and Nonprofit Employees

items.abstract: Abstract This article centers on the concept of “belonging” to argue that belonging and freedom are fundamentally related, and that this relationship cannot be easily captured in formal terms alone. I contend that experiences of incomplete belonging among citizens deserve attention from political science because, in addition to their more obvious challenge to equality, they also erode freedom, even in the context of robust formal guarantees. Citizens perceived as not fully belonging are more likely to eschew behaviors or opinions they know can exacerbate the likelihood of being perceived as interlopers. But although this challenge to individual freedom may be by itself worrisome, I focus on the ways in which some citizens’ unequal belonging undermines collective freedom—what Hannah Arendt calls political freedom—by confining some people's sincere expressions to narrow public spaces, limiting pluralism, and depleting the public space of opportunities for deliberation and political action.

Yuna Blajer de la Garza: Assistant Professor Department of Political Science Loyola University Chicago Chicago Illinois USA

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 시민의 불완전한 소속감이 형식적 권리 보장 아래에서도 개인의 자유와 집단적·정치적 자유를 어떻게 약화시키는지 개념적으로 논의한다. 소속되지 않은 것으로 인식되는 시민들은 이방인으로 보일 위험을 피하려고 표현과 행동을 제한하며, 그 결과 공적 공간의 다원성·숙의·정치적 행동의 기회가 축소된다고 주장한다.
items.title: (Non)belonging and (un)freedom

items.abstract: Abstract Large‐scale fires are becoming increasingly common due to climate change. While conventional wisdom suggests that firsthand experiences with natural disasters foster green coalitions by raising awareness of environmental degradation, we propose an alternative view: Natural disasters can heighten the perceived trade‐off between economic development and environmental policies. This study examines the case of Brazil, where large‐scale fires, by clearing natural vegetation, create new opportunities for land grabbing and the expansion of agriculture and livestock production. Using satellite, administrative, and electoral data, we provide evidence that large‐scale fires increase support for green candidates only in municipalities that are unlikely to reap economic benefits from fires. Survey data further indicate that voters prioritize environmental protection over economic growth only when they stand to receive limited or no benefit from the newly cleared land. Our findings suggest that the potential for natural disasters to foster green coalitions is contingent upon distributive concerns.

Paula Rettl: Assistant Professor, Business, Government, and the International Economy Unit Harvard Business School Boston Massachusetts USA
Silvia Pianta: Junior Scientist, RFF‐CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment Milan Italy
CMCC Foundation—Euro‐Mediterranean Center on Climate Change Lecce Italy

items.summary_ko: 브라질에서 대규모 산불이 녹색 후보 지지에 미치는 영향이 산불로 조성된 토지에서 경제적 이익을 얻을 가능성에 따라 달라지는지 분석했다. 위성·행정·선거 자료와 설문 자료를 활용한 결과, 산불의 경제적 이익을 얻기 어려운 지방자치단체에서만 녹색 후보 지지가 증가했으며, 유권자도 새로 개간된 토지에서 얻을 이익이 제한적일 때에만 경제성장보다 환경보호를 우선했다.
items.title: Global harms, local profits: How the uneven costs of natural disasters affect support for green political platforms

items.abstract: On 6 December 2024, Romania’s Constitutional Court annulled the first round of presidential elections, triggering an exceptional crisis of democratic legitimacy in post-communist Europe. While procedurally justified, the decision sparked intense public reactions, both emotional and political. The findings confirm that populist interpretations of institutional actions proliferate in fragmented and emotionalized digital media environments, where distrust is personalized and intensified. Drawing on a nationally representative survey (N = 964), conducted by IRES shortly after the annulment, the study examines how Romanian citizens perceived the legitimacy of the Court’s decision and identifies the key socio-political and media-related factors shaping these perceptions. Binary logistic regression and mediation models were used to assess the drivers of perceived illegitimacy. TikTok use, negative emotions (anger, disappointment, resentment), political distrust, and anti-establishment party support significantly increase the likelihood of viewing the decision as illegitimate, whereas trust in journalists reduces it. The study contributes to the literature on populism as a communicative style and emotional register, showing how legitimacy itself becomes a contested symbol in digital environments marked by personalization, fragmentation, and affective intensification. We argue that institutional legitimacy is no longer grounded solely in procedural legality but is increasingly shaped by emotionally resonant narratives circulating through digital platforms. We complement the survey with a headline-level media analysis (N = 3,923; Dec 2024 - Aug 2025), to serve as a contextual counterfactual: instead of escalating antagonism, mainstream media gradually stabilize institutional language. A keyness comparison shows that the Early window (first 14 days) is driven by institutional/legal terms (CCR, decision, annulment), while the Late window becomes actor-centric (Simion, Antonescu, Ponta, Bolojan). Over time, lexical entropy declines markedly, signaling a standardization of vocabulary around procedural frames rather than escalating antagonism. Taken together, the results point to a decoupling between media normalization and individual affect, suggesting that democratic legitimacy in platformized communication environments is increasingly produced through affective legitimacy rather than procedural authority.
items.summary_ko: 루마니아 헌법재판소의 대선 1차 투표 무효화 결정을 시민들이 정당하지 않다고 인식하게 만드는 사회·정치적·미디어 요인을 전국 대표 설문(N=964), 이항 로지스틱 회귀와 매개분석으로 분석하고, 헤드라인 분석(N=3,923)으로 미디어 맥락을 보완했다. 틱톡 이용, 분노·실망·원망, 정치적 불신, 반기성 정당 지지는 정당성 인식을 낮추는 가능성을 높인 반면 기자 신뢰는 이를 낮췄으며, 주류 언론의 절차적 언어 정상화와 개인의 정서적 반응이 분리되는 양상이 나타났다.
items.title: Affective Legitimacy and Digital Populism: Evidence from Romania’s Annulled Presidential Elections

items.abstract: For authoritarian propaganda to change hearts and minds, it must first reach the masses and capture their attention. In an era of media proliferation, what can an authoritarian regime do to make ordinary citizens consume pro-regime propaganda voluntarily? How can it lower citizens’ resistance to being indoctrinated? In this article, we answer these questions by studying a new generation of propaganda movies in contemporary China. Leveraging observational data and a pre-registered survey experiment, we find that entertainment elements in propaganda movies – both personality-based and narrative-based – play a key role in appealing to viewers and increasing consumption; this effect is especially pronounced among groups that are the least inclined to expose themselves to propaganda in the first place. Also, viewers are more receptive to political indoctrination when it is interwoven with entertainment, even when they recognize such content. Combined, these findings highlight the importance of entertainment in authoritarian propaganda: not only does it serve as a vehicle to disseminate political indoctrination, but it also functions as a source of appeal that renders such indoctrination more palatable to the masses.
items.summary_ko: 중국의 새로운 선전 영화에서 오락 요소가 대중의 자발적 시청과 정치적 주입에 대한 수용성을 높이는지 관찰자료와 사전등록 설문실험으로 분석했다. 인물 중심·서사 중심 오락 요소는 특히 원래 선전에 노출되려 하지 않는 집단의 시청을 늘렸고, 시청자가 선전성을 인식하더라도 오락과 결합된 정치적 메시지를 더 수용하게 했다.
items.title: Entertainment as Trojan Horse: Voluntary Consumption of Propaganda in China

items.abstract: Inter-organizational cooperation is widely promoted as a strategy to improve cost efficiency in public service delivery. However, empirical findings on the efficiency gains remain mixed, and the conditions under which cost savings are realized are not well understood. To further the research field, this meta-analysis synthesizes evidence from 26 studies comprising 152 effect sizes to examine whether cooperation involving public organizations reduces service provision costs and to examine why estimated cost effects vary across studies. Through the analysis, we find a small but statistically significant cost-reducing effect (r = −.05), indicating that cooperation is associated with modestly lower service costs. The meta-regression results further show that the difficulty of achieving cost savings is significantly increased when cooperation spans multiple service areas. The estimated cost effects also vary with the study design and measurement choices: intensity-based operationalizations are associated with larger cost reductions than propensity-based measures, and quasi-experimental designs yield more conservative estimates than simple regressions. In contrast, the type of cooperation, asset specificity, and measurement difficulty do not affect cost outcomes significantly. Based on these findings, we offer cautious implications for policymakers and public managers seeking to design cost-effective cooperative service arrangements and identify priorities for future research.
items.summary_ko: 공공조직 간 협력이 서비스 제공 비용을 낮추는지, 그리고 비용 절감 효과의 차이를 설명하는 조건이 무엇인지 26개 연구(152개 효과크기)의 메타분석과 메타회귀로 검토했다. 협력은 작지만 통계적으로 유의한 비용 절감 효과(r=-.05)를 보였으며, 여러 서비스 영역을 포괄할수록 절감이 어려워지고, 측정 방식과 연구 설계에 따라 추정치가 달라졌다.
items.title: The Cost Savings in Inter-Organizational Cooperation: A Meta-Analytic Review and Extension

items.abstract: Abstract Our study describes European attitudes toward energy using a harmonized dataset comprising 46 waves of the Eurobarometer (2006–2024). This tracking survey covers all European Union member states; hence, our data accumulates 1,286 individual country surveys. We focus on attitudes relevant to energy transition through three complementary lenses: energy issue salience, policy priorities, and opinions on renewable energy sources. This study documents cross-national and temporal variation in attitudes without estimating the causal effects of specific energy-related European policies or contextual events. We record a marked increase in the salience of energy during crisis periods, especially Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, which rapidly elevated energy’s importance in the hierarchy of public concerns. We also show that support for renewables, in the context of energy transition, coexists with affordability and security concerns in some regions of the EU, particularly in Central-Eastern and Southern Europe. To our knowledge, this is the first study to systematically harmonize such a large collection of Eurobarometer waves into a single comparable dataset, enabling long-term tracking of energy attitudes across all EU member states. In addition to the substantive results, our study also points to several difficulties the Eurobarometer project faces in providing long-term monitoring of public opinion across the highly diverse member states of the European Union.

Mariusz Baranowski: Adam Mickiewicz University Associate Professor, Faculty of Sociology, , Poznan,
Piotr Cichocki: Assistant Professor, Faculty of Sociology, Adam Mickiewicz University , Poznan,
Piotr Jabkowski: Associate Professor, Faculty of Sociology, Adam Mickiewicz University , Poznan,

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 2006~2024년 46개 유로바로미터 파동을 조화한 자료로 EU 회원국의 에너지 이슈 현저성, 정책 우선순위, 재생에너지에 대한 태도의 국가별·시기별 변화를 추적한다. 에너지에 대한 관심은 위기, 특히 2022년 러시아의 우크라이나 침공기에 크게 높아졌으며, 일부 중·동부 및 남부 유럽에서는 재생에너지 지지가 비용 부담과 에너지 안보 우려와 공존했다.
items.title: Attitudes Toward Energy Across European Union Member States (2006–2024)

items.abstract: This study examines nonprofit sector capacity by integrating economic concepts of supply and demand with practitioner perspectives. Focusing on health and human services nonprofits in a midsize southeastern U.S. city, it combines community indicators with survey and interview data. Findings suggest that sector capacity depends not only on resource availability and organizational density but also on the strength of local networks and community context. Well-established nonprofits embedded in local networks differ from more loosely connected organizations, demonstrating how network position shapes perceptions of capacity and the ability to meet community needs. These findings advance research on nonprofit carrying capacity.

Amanda J. Stewart: North Carolina State University, Raleigh, USA
Jessica L. Berrett: University of Colorado Colorado Springs, USA

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 경제학의 공급·수요 관점과 실무자 관점을 통합해 지역 비영리 부문의 역량이 무엇에 의해 형성되는지 조사했다. 미국 중간 규모 도시의 보건·인간서비스 비영리단체를 대상으로 지역 지표, 설문, 인터뷰를 결합한 결과, 역량은 자원 가용성이나 조직 밀도뿐 아니라 지역 네트워크의 강도와 공동체 맥락에도 좌우되며, 네트워크에 깊이 embedded된 기존 단체와 연결성이 낮은 단체는 역량 인식과 지역 수요 충족 능력에서 차이를 보였다.
items.title: More Than the Sum of Its Parts? Bridging Research-to-Practice Gaps to Explain Local Nonprofit Sector Health

items.abstract: How do portrayals of foreign nations as threats shape public opinion on foreign policy and domestic racial attitudes? This study examines how portrayals of China as a threat influence Americans’ support for U.S. policy toward China and attitudes toward Asian Americans. A content analysis of CNN and Fox News transcripts from 2010 to 2020 shows that both outlets increasingly portrayed China as a threat, although Fox News more often emphasized threats to the United States, whereas CNN focused more on threats affecting other countries, international institutions, and populations. A national survey and a preregistered survey experiment further demonstrate that exposure to China threat narratives, regardless of whether the threat targets the United States or another country, increases support for hawkish U.S. foreign policy and heightens anti-Asian resentment, especially among Republicans. These findings show how portrayals of foreign threats shape public opinion and spill over into racial attitudes at home.
items.summary_ko: 중국을 위협으로 묘사하는 언론 보도가 미국인의 대중국 강경 외교정책 지지와 아시아계 미국인에 대한 반감을 어떻게 형성하는지 분석했다. 2010~2020년 CNN·Fox News 내용분석, 전국 설문, 사전등록 설문실험을 통해 위협 대상이 미국인지 다른 국가인지와 무관하게 이러한 서사가 강경정책 지지와 반아시아 정서를 높이며, 특히 공화당원에게서 효과가 크게 나타남을 밝혔다.
items.title: Enemies Abroad, Animosity at Home: Media Influence on U.S.-China Policy and Anti-Asian Sentiment

items.abstract: Palestinians use Instagram to construct symbolic geographies that resist displacement and assert cultural presence. Analyzing 9,126 posts from 834 users posted between October 2023-March 2024, we identify three recurring visual themes that serve as anchors of digital placemaking. The sharing of images depicting everyday routines and familiar spaces functions as an act of asserting belonging in the face of cartographic erasure. Resilience is conveyed through motifs of joy, family, and faith, symbolizing continuity under siege. Knowledge cultivation emerges through practices of naming places, traditions, and environmental markers, reinforcing cultural memory. Comparing Instagram content with 7,448 international news headlines, we find that user-generated posts often offer alternative framings that are absent in mainstream narratives. We close with a discussion of how Palestinian Instagram users created a networked archive that resists material destruction and algorithmic suppression, mapping threatened spaces and producing narrative coherence through everyday digital acts of documentation and resistance.

Insyirah Mujtahid: NUS Centre for Trusted Internet & Community
Kokil Jaidka: NUS Centre for Trusted Internet & Community

items.summary_ko: 팔레스타인 인스타그램 이용자들이 장소의 일상, 기쁨·가족·신앙, 장소·전통·환경 표지를 시각적으로 기록해 이주와 지리적 삭제에 저항하고 문화적 존재감을 주장하는 방식을 분석했다. 2023년 10월부터 2024년 3월까지 834명의 이용자가 게시한 9,126개 게시물과 국제 뉴스 헤드라인 7,448개를 비교한 결과, 이용자 게시물은 주류 서사에 없는 대안적 프레임을 제시하며 위협받는 공간과 문화 기억을 보존하는 네트워크형 기록보관소를 형성했다.
items.title: Reclaiming Place Through Symbolic Geographies: Visual Resistance on Palestinian Instagram

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Social equity budgeting has gained increasing attention, yet research has largely focused on expenditures while neglecting revenue equity. This study contributes to the literature by examining the relationships between minority population size and local governments' reliance on exploitative revenues, and whether minority political representation moderates this relationship. Drawing on racial threat and political representation theories, we analyze data from 66 Florida counties between 2011 and 2019. Results show that counties with larger minority populations rely more heavily on exploitative revenues, but this relationship diminishes when minority political representation increases. These findings highlight how minority leadership could moderate fiscal practices that disproportionately burden minority communities. More broadly, this study advances the framework of social equity budgeting by shifting the focus from expenditure allocation to revenue generation.

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 소수인구 규모와 지방정부의 착취적 세입 의존 간 관계를 분석하고, 소수자 정치적 대표성이 이를 조절하는지 검토했다. 2011~2019년 플로리다 66개 카운티 자료를 분석한 결과, 소수인구가 많은 카운티일수록 착취적 세입에 더 의존했지만 소수자 대표성이 높아지면 이 관계가 약화됐다.
items.title: From Social Equity Budgeting to Revenue Equity: Minority Leadership and Local Governments' Exploitative Revenues

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The emergency management profession and discipline is increasingly embracing social equity as a core value, yet limited attention has been paid to whether local emergency management organizations possess the capacity to implement equity‐focused practices. Drawing on the Capacity Building Framework, this exploratory study analyzes data from a national panel survey of US emergency managers to examine the organizational capacity to advance social equity through the lens of adaptive capacity. The findings reveal that while political, technical, financial, and managerial capacities matter, financial capacity is the most critical constraint. Respondents prioritized additional funding for personnel, community outreach and education, and the development of accessible public resources. The results highlight how resource scarcity shapes the pursuit of equity at the local level and underscores the need to align equity goals with investments in organizational capacity. This study contributes insight into the practical challenges emergency managers face in translating equity commitments into action.

items.title: Organizational Capacity to Implement Social Equity in Emergency Management: A Local Government Perspective

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Post‐2024, the United States faces an acute labor crisis marked by accelerating Local Election Official (LEO) attrition. This study examines causal drivers of this exodus, focusing specifically on disproportionate turnover within volatile “swing” and “pivot” counties. Utilizing a mixed‐methods design, using longitudinal data from the Bipartisan Policy Center, US Census Bureau, Elections Voter Survey, MIT Election Data and Science Lab (MEDSL), and the Reed LEO survey, alongside an original dataset compiled from 74 competitive counties and 25 “super landslide” counties. Using Geographic Information Systems, we connect a detailed county profile to spatial mapping of the legal and political environment across the 2016, 2020, and 2024 elections. LEOs in highly competitive jurisdictions face an erosion of institutional trust, serving as a primary catalyst for departure. These volatile jurisdictions highlight where democratic machinery is vulnerable, offering evidence‐based insights for state‐level policy interventions designed to stabilize the public administrative workforce amidst unprecedented hyperpolarization.

items.title: Under Pressure: Analyzing LEO Turnover in America's Swing and Pivot Counties for 2016, 2020, 2024

items.abstract: This mixed‑method applied research study examines how audiences are responding to news stories that are shaped by retraining efforts to help American journalists rebuild audiences. We wanted to know: were these trainings working? Do audiences choose stories that were influenced by these trainings over more traditional elite-focused, problem-oriented, conflict-driven stories? Working with three newsroom-training organizations, we report the results of a series of conjoint experiments that test how well stories abiding by new journalistic techniques of engagement, solutions and “good-conflict” framing play with audiences. We then use the findings from seven focus groups (n = 49) with surveys to explain why people may have responded the way they did in the tests. We found that audiences overwhelmingly selected and appreciated the re-framed content and reported that it makes them trust the news brands more. The focus group participants claimed such content would entice them to become members, subscribe, or even donate to the mainstream brand – if they came across it. However, only a few of the participants said they had heard about the news outlet. Though the principles behind these trainings may seem counterintuitive to some journalists, they offer a potential path forward in uncertain times for local news.
items.summary_ko: 미국 언론인의 재훈련으로 참여·해결책·‘건설적 갈등’ 방식으로 재구성된 뉴스가 전통적인 엘리트 중심·문제 중심·갈등 중심 뉴스보다 선택되는지, 그리고 그 이유가 무엇인지 검토했다. 세 개의 뉴스룸 훈련기관과 협력해 컨조인트 실험을 실시하고 7개 포커스그룹(n=49) 및 설문으로 보완한 결과, 응답자들은 재구성된 콘텐츠를 압도적으로 선택·긍정적으로 평가했으며 뉴스 브랜드에 대한 신뢰와 구독·후원 의향이 높아졌다고 보고했다.
items.title: Assessing Civic Journalism Training: A Mixed-Method Applied Research Study

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the interplay between agile digital transformation and the rule of law within the public sector, focusing on case studies from a semi‐large municipal government in the Netherlands and a department of the Flemish regional government in Belgium. Drawing on expert interviews, the paper explores how agile methods, championed for flexibility, interact with existing administrative routines and affect rule of law principles that prioritize consistency. Theoretically, the paper builds on public administration scholarship concerning administrative routines and the rule of law. Empirically, the paper shows that agile methods align well with administrative routines that prioritize decentralized leadership and collaboration. Moreover, it shows that agile approaches can foster, rather than threaten, the rule of law: many legal uncertainties arise not from agile practices themselves but from existing complexities in laws and policies, highlighting a need for stronger technical precision in lawmaking and administrative awareness in digital implementation.

Shirley Kempeneer: Tilburg University Tilburg Law School Tilburg the Netherlands

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 네덜란드 지방정부와 벨기에 플랑드르 지역정부의 사례를 전문가 인터뷰로 분석해, 유연성을 중시하는 애자일 디지털 전환이 기존 행정 루틴 및 법치주의와 어떻게 상호작용하는지 살펴본다. 애자일 방식은 분권적 리더십과 협업을 중시하는 루틴과 부합하며, 법치주의를 위협하기보다 촉진할 수 있고, 법적 불확실성의 주요 원인은 애자일 자체보다 복잡한 법·정책에 있음을 보인다.
items.title: Agile Digital Transformation and the Rule of Law: Perks and Perils in a Belgian and a Dutch Public Sector Organization

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Public administration scholarship often treats the Weberian ideal type as a universal model of bureaucracy, making governance arrangements that differ from it appear deficient rather than different. A decolonizing approach instead asks whether non‐Western historical records can offer alternative ways of theorizing governance. This study explores that possibility through the Nagarakretagama, a 14th‐century Javanese court eulogy composed by Mpu Prapanca in 1365, which predates Machiavelli's The Prince by 148 years. Qualitative content analysis of all 98 cantos identifies five governance domains: bureaucratic hierarchy, mandala‐based territorial administration, conditional fiscal exemptions, a legal order combining written law and custom, and ceremonial practices integrated with administration. These dimensions show how the Javanese empire organized authority, territory, revenue, law, and legitimacy through institutional arrangements that differ from the Weberian model. Reading this governance system as theory reveals an alternative conceptualization of administration and advances a decolonizing, pluriversal approach to public administration.

Dede Setiono: Department of Public Policy and Management, Faculty of Social and Political Sciences Universitas Gadjah Mada Yogyakarta Indonesia

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 비서구 역사 기록이 베버 관료제와 다른 거버넌스 이론을 제시할 수 있는지 탐구하기 위해 14세기 자바 궁정 문헌 『나가라크레타가마』 98편 전체를 질적 내용 분석했다. 분석 결과 관료제적 위계, 만달라 기반 영토 행정, 조건부 재정 면제, 성문법과 관습을 결합한 법질서, 행정과 통합된 의례라는 다섯 영역을 통해 자바 제국의 통치가 권위·영토·수입·법·정당성을 조직한 대안적 행정 개념을 보여준다고 제시한다.
items.title: Governing Before the State: Indigenous Javanese Administrative Theory

items.abstract: Abstract Artificial intelligence (AI) interviewing offers the potential to enhance the depth and quality of survey research, yet it may also introduce respondent fatigue and unintended consequences for the measurement of political attitudes. From the standpoint of respondents, more extensive interviews impose greater cognitive and temporal burdens, which may reduce engagement or increase satisficing. From the perspective of political behavior researchers, deeper probing may shift the subset of beliefs or arguments that respondents access when forming opinions, thereby altering the distribution and apparent stability of measured attitudes. To investigate these dynamics, we conduct a large-scale, fully randomized experiment. We find that AI-mediated interviewing significantly increases both the volume and specificity of respondents’ articulated rationales, but any decline in participant satisfaction is minuscule and we detect no increase in participant rolloff. However, AI interviews appear to shape subsequent responses: After offering justifications through AI interaction, respondents exhibit greater polarization in follow-up items. This result suggests that AI interviewing may alter the cognitive architecture of opinion formation. These findings both highlight the potential for AI interviewing and underscore the need for studies of how AI interviewing may become a source of attitudinal change.

items.summary_ko: AI 매개 반구조화 면접이 고정형 설문과 비교해 응답자의 만족도·이탈, 응답의 양과 구체성, 후속 태도 응답에 미치는 영향을 대규모 완전 무작위 실험으로 비교했다. AI 면접은 응답자가 제시한 근거의 양과 구체성을 높였고 만족도 저하나 이탈 증가는 거의 없었지만, 후속 문항에서 응답 양극화를 증가시켰다.
items.title: An Experimental Comparison of AI-Enabled Semi-Structured Interviews and Fixed Surveys: Respondent Satisfaction, Response Patterns, Quality, and Representation

items.abstract: Abstract Can participatory institutions (PIs) facilitate development when captured by the government? We propose an original theoretical framework to investigate how changing incumbent priorities can shape the developmental and political effects of captured PIs. While patrons concerned with survival can force PIs to specialize in political activities, those pursuing regime consolidation may incentivize PIs to multitask, delivering developmental gains and political rewards. We deploy our framework to study Venezuela's Communal Councils. Leveraging difference‐in‐differences analyses, an original survey of Council participants, and 51 interviews with government officials and grassroots Communal Council members, we find that Councils yielded both economic and political returns during an early period marked by political stability and regime consolidation. However, as Venezuela's economic collapse pushed the government into an authoritarian survival mode, Councils became politically specialized. While showing that captured PIs can foster development under certain circumstances, our findings cast doubt on PIs’ development‐enhancing potential under autocracy.

Jared Abbott: Department of Political Science California State University‐Los Angeles Los Angeles California USA
Jose Morales‐Arilla: Escuela de Gobierno y Transformación Pública Tecnologico de Monterrey Ciudad de México Mexico

items.summary_ko: 정부에 포획된 참여제도가 개발을 촉진할 수 있는 조건과 정권 우선순위 변화가 그 효과에 미치는 영향을 이론적으로 제시하고, 베네수엘라 공동체평의회를 대상으로 이중차분 분석, 참여자 설문, 51건의 인터뷰를 실시했다. 정치적 안정과 정권 공고화 시기에는 평의회가 경제적·정치적 성과를 냈지만, 경제 붕괴로 정부가 권위주의적 생존 모드에 들어서자 정치 활동에 특화되었다.
items.title: Captured participatory institutions: Theory and evidence from Venezuela's Consejos Comunales

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Governments have created in‐house consulting organizations to reduce dependence on external firms and retain public capability and control. Yet organizations grouped under this label pursue different forms of public value that require different designs. This article distinguishes three reasons for a dedicated unit: retaining control over consequential work, capturing returns from problems that recur across government, and mobilizing expertise dispersed across public and adjacent institutions. It develops three corresponding configurations—Strategic Transformation, Scalable Solutions, and Expertise Platform—and shows how choices about work, staffing, knowledge, authority, client relationships, financing, and evaluation must fit together. Documentary comparison of eight units in five countries grounds the analysis. The cases show that viability depends on whether work renews the conditions needed for subsequent work and that evaluation must reflect configuration and stage. Internalization is therefore organization‐building, not the reversal of a procurement decision: a unit creates public value only when work reproduces the conditions on which that value depends.

Sean Safford: Centre for the Sociology of Organizations, CNRS Sciences Po Paris France

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 정부 내부 컨설팅 조직이 추구하는 공공가치와 조직 생존가능성에 따라 어떻게 설계되어야 하는지를 묻고, 5개국 8개 조직의 문서 비교를 통해 세 가지 구성(전략적 전환, 확장 가능한 해결책, 전문성 플랫폼)을 제시한다. 분석 결과, 업무·인력·지식·권한·고객관계·재원·평가가 해당 구성과 발전 단계에 맞게 정렬되고 후속 업무의 조건을 재생산할 때 조직이 지속가능하며, 내부화는 조달 결정을 되돌리는 것이 아니라 조직을 구축하는 과정으로 나타났다.
items.title: Three Configurations of In‐House Government Consulting: Public‐Value Purpose and Organizational Viability

items.abstract: Local option sales taxes in the United States are an interesting form of direct democracy that is influenced directly by public managers. The referenda, or ballot measures, in which people vote on sales taxes have multiple features that can be presented in a variety of ways. As such, they represent a unique opportunity to study the behavioral impact of options and information on citizen choice. With this research, we develop a novel experiment that uses the logic of a conjoint design by varying all of the key features in the referenda, but presents that information in a paragraph form that mimics the format of actual referenda. Results of this sales tax ballot conjoint experiment show that, in general, people only focus on a few key pieces of information, but specific sub-groups are interested in more and different features of the proposed sales tax. This suggests that managers may have more influence among key demographics, and knowing the attributes that matter to those demographics may help shape how sales tax ballot referenda are presented.
items.summary_ko: 미국 지방 판매세 주민투표에서 정보 제시 방식과 선택적 정보가 시민의 지지에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 분석하기 위해, 실제 주민투표 형식을 모방한 문단형 결합실험을 실시했다. 시민들은 대체로 소수의 핵심 정보에 집중했지만, 일부 하위집단은 제안된 판매세의 더 많고 다른 특성에도 관심을 보여, 관리자들이 특정 인구집단에 더 큰 영향력을 행사할 가능성을 시사했다.
items.title: Managers as message makers: a conjoint experiment on information framing and citizen support for local sales tax referenda

items.abstract: Abstract The role of principal-agent dynamics in performance and accountability reforms has been a recurring theme in public administration research. Yet, less attention has been dedicated to how the intersection of sector and policy design shapes principal-agent dynamics and subsequent policy outcomes. This study theoretically explores and empirically tests how sector and policy design shape the effects of state legislation that seeks to prevent shirking (mismanagement and underreporting) in the context of sexual misconduct outcomes in US colleges and universities. We code every state policy designed to regulate higher education institutions’ management of sexual misconduct from 2007 to 2018 in the US and leverage a Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood with a staggered difference-in-differences design to identify the effects. Our findings suggest that both sector and policy design matter: public institutions increase reporting in response to prevention policies that promote education and awareness, but prevention policies have no effect on private institutions. Other policies regulating enforcement and infrastructure produce null effects across both sectors. These findings have important implications for principal-agent theory and policy design research on effective methods for reducing shirking in social equity, accountability, and performance reporting.
