items.summary_ko: 미국 주의 대학 성적 misconduct 관리 법정책에서 부문과 정책 설계가 조직의 축소 보고·관리 실패를 줄이는 데 어떤 영향을 미치는지, 2007~2018년 전수 정책 코딩과 포아송 의사최대우도·시차적 이중차분으로 분석했다. 교육·인식 제고형 예방정책은 공립기관의 보고를 늘렸지만 사립기관에는 효과가 없었고, 집행·인프라 규제정책은 두 부문 모두에서 유의한 효과가 없었다.
items.title: Conditional compliance: the role of sector and policy design in state sexual misconduct policy

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Democratic backsliding has emerged as a defining political challenge of the contemporary era, yet systematic cross‐national evidence linking it to governance outcomes remains scarce. This article argues that backsliding affects governance through two analytically distinct channels: a political accountability channel, whereby weakened contestation and oversight reduce the external costs of poor performance; and an administrative channel, through which executive politicization erodes meritocratic recruitment and bureaucratic impartiality. Using a country‐year panel of 86 countries from 1996 to 2024 and generalized structural equation models, we decompose the direct, indirect, and total effects of backsliding on government effectiveness, regulatory quality, and control of corruption across stages of democratic decline. The findings show that governance deterioration is stage‐specific, channel‐specific, and outcome‐specific, following a nonlinear, U‐shaped pattern in which complete erosion—rather than autocratic reversion—produces the largest governance losses.

David Ibañez: School of Finance, Economics and Government Universidad EAFIT Medellin Colombia
Ricardo A. Bello‐Gómez: School of Public Affairs and Administration Rutgers University Newark New Jersey USA

items.summary_ko: 민주적 후퇴가 정치적 책무성과 행정적 경로를 통해 정부효과성·규제의 질·부패통제에 미치는 영향을 1996~2024년 86개국 국가-연도 패널과 일반화 구조방정식 모형으로 분석한다. 거버넌스 악화는 단계·경로·성과지표별로 다르며, 권위주의적 회귀보다 민주주의의 완전한 침식에서 가장 크게 나타나는 비선형 U자형 패턴을 보인다.
items.title: Democratic Backsliding and Governance Outcomes: Measuring Administrative and Political Channels of Decline

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The relationship between inequity and administrative burden constitutes a pivotal concern in the realm of public administration and policy, but how policy inequity (i.e., inequity in policy implementation) influences administrative burden has garnered scant attention. The present study employs data about public assistance programs in China spanning from 2015 to 2017 to examine the consequences of policy inequity on administrative burden. The empirical findings underscore that policy inequity augments psychological and compliance costs while concurrently diminishing citizens' participation in welfare programs, thereby indicating that policy inequity intensifies administrative burden. Notably, individual‐level social capital and contextual‐level information transparency in terms of public exposure related to welfare approval and receipt significantly moderate this relationship. Contrary to our theoretical expectations, social capital and public exposure amplify, rather than dampen, the impact of policy inequity on administrative burden. This study highlights the policy inequity lens and offers important implications for burden reduction.

Peng Liu: School of Public Administration and Policy, Renmin University of China Beijing China
Qingqing Zhang: School of Public Administration and Policy, Renmin University of China Beijing China
Yongzheng Yang: School of Public Administration and Policy, Renmin University of China Beijing China

items.summary_ko: 중국 공공부조 프로그램의 2015~2017년 자료를 활용해 정책 불공평성이 행정 부담에 미치는 영향을 분석했다. 정책 불공평성은 심리적 비용과 순응 비용을 높이고 복지 프로그램 참여를 줄였으며, 개인 수준의 사회적 자본과 맥락 수준의 정보 투명성은 예상과 달리 이 영향을 완화하지 않고 증폭했다.
items.title: To Add Insult to Injury: Exploring the Impact of Policy Inequity on Administrative Burden

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Public administration has traditionally emphasized the normative ideal that public agencies have a responsibility to improve the lives of communities through public service delivery. We turn to public libraries to explore possibilities for what we call Expansive Public Service Delivery. Expansive Public Service Delivery is defined by a mission to serve all, professional and ethical responsibilities, and proactive responsiveness through outreach and (re)assessment. Public libraries have long aimed to improve communities and advance democracy by providing open, free information access to all. Today, they also proactively seek to expand their services to underserved groups ensuring their relevance and mission achievement. This research draws from 25 in‐depth qualitative interviews to explore librarian narratives to identify four core responsibilities that constitute Expansive Public Service Delivery. We conclude with a discussion of how service for all, professionalism, ethical responsibility, and reflexive decision‐making around community needs can result in more vibrant, sustainable public organizations.

Justin M. Stritch: University of North Carolina – Charlotte Charlotte USA
Mary K. Feeney: School of Public Affairs Arizona State University Phoenix Arizona USA

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 공공도서관을 사례로, 모두를 위한 서비스 제공·전문성·윤리적 책임·지역사회 요구에 대한 성찰적 의사결정이 확장적 공공서비스 제공을 어떻게 구성하는지 탐색한다. 사서 25명과의 심층 질적 인터뷰를 통해, 이러한 책임들이 공공조직의 활력과 지속가능성을 높일 수 있음을 제시한다.
items.title: Expansive Public Service Delivery: Advancing Public Value Governance

items.abstract: This paper examines innovation management as a deliberate organizational arrangement through which public organizations seek to remain relevant in contexts of uncertainty, technological and societal changes, and bureaucratic constraints. Drawing on a multiple-case study of five national police agencies, the study analyzes what works well and less well in systematic innovation management arrangements. While all agencies established innovation units with similar responsibilities, they differed in how innovation management systems were configured and sustained. Three configurations are identified – Strong Heavyweight, Light Heavyweight, and Lightweight – showing how enabling and constraining mechanisms help explain variation in innovation capacity across highly institutionalized public-sector contexts.

Jacob Brix: Aalborg University Business School, Aalborg University

authors: Ana Paula Franco Paes Leme Barbosa
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 불확실성, 기술·사회 변화, 관료적 제약 속에서 공공조직의 혁신 역량을 유지하기 위한 의도적 조직 व्यवस्था인 혁신관리의 구성과 지속 조건을 탐구한다. 5개 국가 경찰기관의 다중 사례를 비교한 결과, 혁신 부서의 책임은 유사했지만 혁신관리 체계의 구성과 지속 방식은 달랐으며, 이를 Strong Heavyweight, Light Heavyweight, Lightweight의 세 유형으로 구분하고 촉진·제약 메커니즘이 혁신 역량의 차이를 설명함을 제시한다.
items.title: Public sector innovation management in the shadow: why the overlooked sibling still matters

items.abstract: Abstract Why do some societies succeed in breaking away from historical traditions while others remain trapped? This paper proposes a formal theory to investigate the interaction between short‐run and long‐run political dynamics, highlighting a co‐evolution of political institutions and social structures. A society consists of various social groups, such as the rulers, the elites, and the commoners. Short‐run strategic considerations give rise to different coalitions among these groups, which determine not only political regimes but also redistribution policies. In the long run, these policies shape the accumulation of wealth and power, where small initial differences can lead to divergent paths of development. Finally, the paper examines three historical case studies on medieval Europe, imperial China, and the medieval Muslim world to illustrate potential pathways of long‐run political development.

Clair Yang: The Henry M. Jackson School of International Studies, College of Arts and Sciences, University of Washington Seattle Washington USA

items.summary_ko: 왜 일부 사회는 역사적 전통에서 벗어나고 다른 사회는 그 경로에 머무는지를 설명하기 위해, 통치자·엘리트·평민 간 단기 전략과 연합이 정치체제·재분배를 형성하고 이것이 장기적으로 부와 권력의 축적을 바꾸는 형식이론을 제시한다. 초기의 작은 차이가 제도와 사회구조의 공진화를 통해 상이한 발전 경로로 이어질 수 있음을 보이며, 중세 유럽·제국 중국·중세 이슬람 세계의 사례로 가능한 경로를 예시한다.
items.title: A theory of political divergence and gradual institutional change

items.abstract: Recent work has shown that moral-emotional content spreads rapidly on social media platforms such as X (Twitter). These patterns have led to concerns that social media facilitates the spread of moral outrage – potentially exacerbating political conflict and animosity. While most past work has focused on the supply side of this phenomenon, i.e. the transmission of morally charged political content, we consider the demand side: do people actually want to see this type of content in their information environment? In this paper, we first theoretically contextualize the motivations to engage with or avoid moral-emotional content. Then, through three pre-registered studies conducted in the U.S. in 2022 and 2023, we test whether people actively choose information that includes moral-emotional elements. Contrary to our initial expectations, we find that participants do not actively select moral-emotional content compared to neutral or emotional content. Despite previous findings on transmission, our results suggest that people may not want to see this type of content in their information environment. By focusing on selection rather than transmission, the findings presented in this paper add another nuance to an ongoing debate on the prevalence and consequences of online political outrage.
items.summary_ko: 도덕적·감정적 정치 콘텐츠를 사람들이 정보환경에서 적극적으로 선택하는지, 미국에서 2022~2023년에 사전등록된 세 연구로 검증했다. 참가자들은 중립적 콘텐츠나 감정적 콘텐츠보다 도덕적·감정적 콘텐츠를 더 선택하지 않았으며, 이는 해당 콘텐츠의 확산과 실제 선호가 다를 수 있음을 시사한다.
items.title: Rethinking Assumptions About Moral Content Selection: Moral-Emotional Content May Be Less Appealing Than Assumed

items.abstract: Abstract Systematic differences of electoral participation between various social groups indicate crucial constraints of comprehensive democratic inclusion. Yet, there is a dearth of research on electoral participation among individuals with intellectual disability (ID), whose participation rates are considerably lower than among non‐ID citizens. This study examines determinants of electoral participation among individuals with ID based on administrative records covering five cohorts of individuals from the Swedish upper‐secondary school for pupils with ID ( N = 8438), and their parents. Our main results indicate that the severity of the disability and parents who have voted are the strongest predictors of voting among individuals with ID. The latter suggests that family background is vital. However, the socioeconomic status of the families, such as parents' level of education, income, and occupation, are less pivotal factors.

Björn Boman: Department of Political Science Stockholm University Stockholm Sweden
Johan Wejryd: Institute for Housing and Urban Research Uppsala University Uppsala Sweden
Jonas Hultin Rosenberg: School of Business, Society and Engineering Department of Social Sciences and Humanities Västerås Sweden

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 지적장애가 있는 청년의 선거 참여를 결정하는 요인을 스웨덴 지적장애 학생 대상 행정자료와 부모 자료(5개 코호트, N=8,438)로 분석했다. 장애의 중증도와 부모의 투표 경험이 가장 강한 예측요인이었으며, 부모의 교육·소득·직업과 같은 가족의 사회경제적 지위는 상대적으로 덜 중요했다.
items.title: Does disability trump family background? Determinants of electoral participation among young individuals with intellectual disability

items.abstract: Abstract We examined how responses to outgroup indifference in conflict are shaped by the perceived nature of interdependence, which changes expectations of outgroup emotions toward the ingroup. Unlike conflicts perceived as positively interdependent, we hypothesized that in conflicts perceived as negatively interdependent, outgroup indifference would constitute a positive expectancy violation, thereby inviting favorable responses. Moreover, we examined affective and inferential processes as mediators across four studies ( N = 2521). In Study 1, outgroup indifference (vs. anger and hatred but not hope) reduced negative emotions (but did not affect expected collaboration), subsequently increasing support for cooperation. Study 2 added qualitative measures and showed that outgroup indifference (vs. anger) increased support for cooperation through decreased negative emotions and increased expected collaboration. Study 3 provided correlational evidence that perceptions of interdependence predict participants' expectations of outgroup emotions. Lastly, in Study 4, outgroup indifference increased expected collaboration and emotions when interdependence was perceived as negative.

Eran Halperin: Department of Psychology Hebrew University of Jerusalem Jerusalem Israel
Garrett L. Brady: Department of Management and Technology Bocconi University Milan Italy
Gerben A. van Kleef: Department of Social Psychology University of Amsterdam Amsterdam The Netherlands
Smadar Cohen‐Chen: Department of Management, Sussex Business School University of Sussex Brighton UK

items.summary_ko: 부정적 상호의존으로 인식되는 갈등에서 외집단의 무관심이 외집단의 분노나 증오보다 부정적 정서를 줄이고 협력 기대를 높여 협력 지지를 촉진하는지 네 차례 연구(N=2,521)로 검토했다. 연구 결과, 외집단 무관심은 부정적 상호의존 맥락에서 긍정적 기대 위반으로 작용해 협력 기대와 협력 지지를 높였으며, 이러한 효과는 주로 부정적 정서 감소와 협력 기대 증가를 통해 나타났다.
items.title: Not‐so‐great expectations: Outgroup indifference facilitates conflict resolution in negatively interdependent contexts

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Recent scholarship on administrative burden has increasingly focused on psychological costs, design interventions, and digital burdens. This study combines these interests and examines the psychological costs of negative emotions during administrative encounters at varying levels of digital maturity. Building on affective events theory and employing facial coding in a controlled experiment, the study demonstrates that negative emotions rise during bureaucratic encounters, with frustration resulting in more errors made by applicants. Simplifying the procedure through pre‐filled forms does not reduce negative emotional arousal; however, it enhances satisfaction with the procedure. Vulnerable citizens, as indicated by low education and foreign citizenship, benefit more from this informational integration than other groups, suggesting that procedural redesign can enhance the inclusiveness of public service delivery. Overall, the research advances both scholarly and practical understanding of the emotional dimension of administrative burdens from a process‐oriented perspective, highlighting the persistent challenge of reducing emotional costs to enhance citizen experiences.

David Hensel: Statistical Office for Hamburg and Schleswig‐Holstein Hamburg Germany
Donald Moynihan: University of Michigan Ann Arbor Michigan USA
Judith Hattke: Helmut‐Schmidt‐University/University of the Armed Forces Hamburg Germany
Pamela Herd: University of Michigan Ann Arbor Michigan USA

items.summary_ko: 디지털 복지 신청에서 행정적 만남 중 부정적 감정의 심리적 비용이 어떻게 나타나는지, 그리고 사전 입력 양식에 따른 절차 단순화가 이를 완화하는지 통제 실험과 얼굴 표정 코딩으로 분석했다. 부정적 감정, 특히 좌절은 신청자의 오류를 늘렸고 사전 입력은 감정적 각성을 줄이지 않았지만 절차 만족도를 높였으며, 저학력자와 외국 국적자에게 효과가 더 컸다.
items.title: Face‐to‐Face With Administrative Burdens: Design Simplification, Emotional Costs, and Procedural Outcomes in Digital Welfare Applications

items.abstract: Indigenous procurement is widely promoted as an instrument of economic reconciliation, yet headline gains often mask limited transformational impact. Applying McCrudden’s social procurement framework, we conduct a systematic cross-national comparison of identity-specific procurement architectures across Canada, Australia, and Aotearoa New Zealand. We show that contract values cluster heavily within major metropolitan hubs and narrow industry sectors, leaving remote and early-stage community enterprises marginalized. Furthermore, persistent cross-national data gaps and aggregated reporting conceal these structural inequities while enabling policy distortions like fronting. We recommend structural reforms including regional benchmarks and independent auditing to align procurement with genuine Indigenous economic sovereignty.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다·호주·아오테아로아 뉴질랜드의 정체성 기반 원주민 조달 정책 구조를 McCrudden의 사회적 조달 프레임워크로 체계적으로 비교해, 계약 가치가 대도시와 일부 산업에 집중되고 원격·초기 단계 공동체 기업이 주변화되며 데이터 공백과 집계 보고가 이러한 불평등과 전면기업(fronting)을 가린다는 점을 밝혔다. 지역별 기준과 독립 감사 등 구조 개혁이 실질적 원주민 경제 주권에 맞게 조달을 조정해야 한다고 제안한다.
items.title: Towards inclusive prosperity: comparative analysis of Indigenous procurement policies in Canada, Australia, and New Zealand

items.abstract: Since 1985, Public Service Recognition Week acknowledges the role of government employees in American democracy. Building upon the study of public service values, this research investigates gubernatorial proclamations issued in 2025, treating that years as a crucial case for the study of government employee recognition. Despite instability in the U.S. federal government, state-level proclamations illustrate a consistent emphasis on common public service values, including commitment, integrity, and professionalism. The analysis of proclamation content shows some variation in the values emphasized by the two major political parties, but no statistically discernable relationship between gubernatorial party and proclamation issuance. Still, only about one third of U.S. governors issued proclamations for Public Service Recognition Week in 2025, pointing to the need for ongoing scrutiny of employee recognition practices at the state and national level. This research closes by comparing state-level action to presidential proclamations from 1987 to 2024 and discusses implications for the application of public service value theory to the study of state government employment and employee recognition.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 2025년 미국 주지사들의 공공서비스 인식 주간 포고문에서 공공서비스 가치가 어떻게 강조되는지, 그리고 주지사의 정당과 포고문 발행 간 관계가 있는지를 분석했다. 포고문에는 헌신·청렴·전문성이 공통적으로 나타났고 정당별 강조 가치에는 일부 차이가 있었지만, 주지사 정당과 발행 여부 사이에는 통계적으로 식별 가능한 관계가 없었으며 약 3분의 1의 주지사만 포고문을 발행했다.
items.title: Partisanship, Public Service Values, and Public Service Recognition Week Proclamations

items.abstract: Abstract Public management research has long recognized that power shapes reform outcomes. However, it has often examined different manifestations of power through separate research streams, including street-level discretion, professional power, and network governance, without integrating them into a unified theoretical framework. Drawing on Clegg’s circuits of power framework, this article develops an integrative approach that examines how episodic, dispositional, and facilitative power interact during public management reform. We argue that reform outcomes depend largely on whether these circuits exhibit full alignment, partial alignment, or misalignment. We develop this argument into a Power Circuit Alignment framework, which connects micro-level practices, meso-level structures, and macro-level systems and identifies circuit alignment as the key process explaining divergent reform trajectories. In doing so, the framework advances public management research by integrating previously separate power literatures within a single multi-level account. It also specifies how the circuits operate in public management: democratic accountability shapes the distribution of episodic authority, professional norms shape dispositional support and resistance, and interorganizational and intergovernmental complexity shapes facilitative capacity.

Mhamed Biygautane: Faculty of Arts, School of Social and Political Sciences, The University of Melbourne , Melbourne,
Stewart Clegg: Faculty of Engineering, School of Project Management, John Grill Institute for Project Leadership, The University of Sydney , Sydney,

items.journal: Perspectives on Public Management and Governance
items.summary_ko: 공공관리 개혁에서 서로 분리되어 연구된 권력의 양상을 어떻게 통합적으로 설명할 수 있는지를 탐구한다. Clegg의 권력 회로 이론에 기반한 다층적 개념 모형을 제시하며, 개혁 성과와 경로는 일화적·성향적·촉진적 권력 회로의 완전한 정렬, 부분적 정렬 또는 불일치에 따라 달라진다고 주장한다.
items.title: Power circuit alignment and reform trajectories: a dynamic framework for public management research

items.abstract: Prior evidence suggests that fact-checking can update beliefs regarding factually incorrect information in the short term but its effects often decay rapidly. Such decay raises normative concerns about its sustainability and real-world impact. Here, we examine whether a cognitively efficient, low-cost intervention – called an “accuracy reminder” – can enhance the durability of fact-checking effects. In a large-scale pre-registered panel longitudinal experiment (N = 7,188), participants were randomly assigned to receive fact-checks and, under some conditions, follow-up prompts to reevaluate the same claim at interval-optimized time points. Across topical domains and partisan identities, reminder conditions produced durable belief correction effects lasting up to four weeks, more than doubling the persistence observed without reminders. Effects were robust across reminder frequency and timing, as well as against individual differences, suggesting implementation flexibility and theoretical generalizability. These findings identify retrieval-based reinforcement as a scalable means of sustaining factual belief correction and reinforcing shared factual baselines in spite of cognitive decay and partisan resistance.
items.summary_ko: 사실확인 효과가 빠르게 약화되는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 사실확인 후 동일한 주장에 대한 재평가를 유도하는 저비용 ‘정확성 알림’이 효과의 지속성을 높이는지 대규모 사전등록 패널 종단실험(N=7,188)으로 검증했다. 정확성 알림은 주제와 당파적 정체성에 관계없이 최대 4주간 신념 교정 효과를 지속시켰으며, 알림이 없을 때보다 효과의 지속성이 두 배 이상 높았다.
items.title: Hold That Thought: Enhancing the Durability of Fact-Checking Effects Through Low-Cost Accuracy Reminders

items.abstract: ABSTRACT How do informal actors achieve rapid bureaucratic dismantlement without formal authority? Analyzing the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) initiative, this article argues that when performance‐based legitimacy displaces procedural legitimacy as the dominant evaluative framework, informal actors can bypass established safeguards and reshape government institutions. Three concepts capture this process: advisory capture , legitimacy regime transition , and constrained coercion . The analysis reveals that dismantlement targets agencies based on political vulnerability rather than functional logic, that informal authority becomes institutionalized through formal rulemaking such as the Schedule Policy/Career rule, and that judicial review operates as ongoing contestation rather than definitive constraint. Protecting democratic governance requires defending not only formal rules but the legitimacy regimes within which those rules derive meaning.

Byunggeor Moon: Department of Public Policy and Management Yonsei University Seoul Republic of Korea

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 비공식 행위자가 공식 권한 없이 어떻게 관료제를 신속히 해체할 수 있는지를 DOGE 구상 분석을 통해 이론화한다. 성과 기반 정당성이 절차적 정당성을 대체하는 정당성 체제 전환 속에서 자문 포획과 제한된 강제가 제도적 안전장치를 우회·재편하며, 그 과정이 정치적 취약성에 따른 기관 표적화와 공식 규칙화를 수반하고 사법심사는 지속적 경합으로 작동한다고 주장한다.
items.title: Informal Authority, Legitimacy Transition, and Institutional Change: A Theory of Advisory Capture

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The federal service experienced unprecedented turnover in the first year of the second Trump administration. Early reports have documented the substantial losses of personnel and the politicization and antagonism underlying those changes. This research breaks down separations over the past year, with a focus on the Deferred Resignation Program (DRP), to understand where turnover occurred and how it affected organizational knowledge and capacity. The analysis examines federal workforce data from January 2015 to December 2025 and reveals that the federal service lost substantial expertise and experience through both voluntary and involuntary means of separation. These results shed light on the fallout from 2025 executive actions, clarify the implications for government capacity, and point out prospective pathways for mitigating damages to the federal service moving forward.

Anmol Soni: Department of Public Administration, E. J. Ourso College of Business Louisiana State University Baton Rouge Louisiana USA
Evan Mistur: Department of Public Affairs and Planning, College of Architecture, Planning, and Public Affairs University of Texas at Arlington Arlington Texas USA
M. Blake Emidy: Department of Public Service and Administration, Bush School of Government and Public Service Texas A&M University College Station Texas USA

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 2025년 연방공무원 이직이 어디에서 발생했으며 조직의 지식과 역량에 어떤 영향을 미쳤는지를 파악하기 위해 2015년 1월부터 2025년 12월까지의 연방 인력 자료를 분석했다. 분석 결과, 자발적·비자발적 퇴직을 통해 상당한 전문성과 경험이 유실된 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Sifting Through: Federal Separations in 2025 and Their Implications for Knowledge Loss and Agency Capacity

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This article examines the effects of women's political empowerment (WPE) on tax revenue mobilization using a panel sample of 41 African countries over the 2000–2022 period. Utilizing the system Generalized Method of Moments, the empirical results demonstrate that WPE significantly enhances tax revenue mobilization in Africa. This finding remains robust to alternative measures of both WPE and tax revenue. Furthermore, beyond a specific turning point, increased WPE tends to diminish tax revenue mobilization. Finally, the study highlights that WPE operates through several transmission channels, including corruption control, the size of the informal economy, and female labor force participation. In terms of public policy, strengthening gender quotas within the African political sphere is crucial to enhancing tax mobilization. Nonetheless, given the threshold effects identified in this relationship, policymakers must prioritize the quality of women's political representation rather than focusing solely on increasing their numerical representation within political decision‐making circles.

Marie Laure Belomo Onguene: University of Yaoundé II Yaoundé Cameroon

items.summary_ko: 아프리카 41개국의 2000~2022년 패널자료에 시스템 일반화적률법(GMM)을 적용해 여성의 정치적 권한이 조세수입 동원에 미치는 영향을 분석한 결과, 여성의 정치적 권한 확대는 조세 동원을 유의하게 높였지만 일정 전환점을 넘으면 그 효과가 약화되었다. 이 관계는 부패 통제, 비공식경제 규모, 여성 노동력 참여를 통해 작동했으며, 정책적으로는 여성 대표성의 양보다 질과 성별 할당제의 강화가 중요하다고 제시한다.
items.title: Tax Mobilization in Africa: Is the Secret Hidden in Women's Political Empowerment?

items.abstract: Street-level bureaucrats often lack workplace clarity, which contributes to higher turnover. Drawing on street-level bureaucracy theory and the Job Demands–Resources model, this study examines how organizational transparency and role conflict, two dimensions of workplace clarity, shape turnover intentions among social workers in Chinese nonprofit organizations. Using multilevel data from the China Social Work Longitudinal Study, we find that organizational transparency reduces and role conflict increases turnover intentions. Value fit mediates both relationships, and job autonomy moderates them by enhancing the benefits of organizational transparency and buffering the harms of role conflict. Findings validate the extension of street-level bureaucracy theory to the nonprofit context and offer actionable insights for improving workforce stability in a complex governance environment.

Tingzhong Huang: Institute for Global Public Policy, Fudan University, Shanghai, China
LSE-Fudan Research Centre for Global Public Policy, Fudan University, Shanghai, China

items.summary_ko: 중국 비영리기관 사회복지사를 대상으로 다층 자료를 분석해 조직 투명성과 역할 갈등이 이직 의도에 미치는 영향을 검토했다. 조직 투명성은 이직 의도를 낮추고 역할 갈등은 높였으며, 가치 적합성이 두 관계를 매개하고 직무 자율성이 투명성의 효과를 강화하고 역할 갈등의 부정적 영향을 완화했다.
items.title: Why Street-Level Bureaucrats Leave: The Effects of Organizational Transparency and Role Conflict

items.abstract: Literature in public administration and public budgeting examines how budgetary processes affect the allocation of public resources across different populations. Using a gender-responsive budgeting (GRB) framework, this study examines patterns of athletic scholarship funding in the context of Title IX mandates in federally funded higher education institutions. Drawing on Equity in Athletics Disclosure Act (EADA) data from 2010 to 2022, the analysis focuses on scholarship allocations across National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) Division I institutions. Distinct from much of the existing GRB literature, the study incorporates legal guidelines, panel data methods, and explicit distinctions by biological sex. Fixed-effects regressions indicate that total athletic student aid is positively associated with the scale of male student athletic participation, particularly in public institutions. Participation-adjusted analyses further show that both public and private institutions allocate athletic student aid to female student-athletes at levels broadly consistent with Title IX’s proportionality standards after accounting for enrollment composition. Specifically, private institutions exhibit stronger per capita adjustments favoring female student-athletes, pointing to meaningful heterogeneity in how funding allocations are implemented across institutional contexts. Overall, the findings demonstrate how a GRB-informed approach aids in interpreting aggregate funding patterns and highlight variation in institutional responses to mandates and policies pertinent to gender issues in collegiate athletics.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 성인지 예산(GRB) 관점에서 Title IX 적용 연방 지원 고등교육기관의 운동부 장학금 배분이 성별 참여 및 등록 구성과 어떻게 연관되는지, 2010~2022년 NCAA 디비전 I EADA 패널자료로 분석했다. 고정효과 회귀 결과, 총 운동부 학자금 지원은 특히 공립기관에서 남학생 선수 참여 규모와 양의 관계를 보였으며, 참여·등록 구성 조정 후에는 공·사립기관 모두 여성 선수 지원이 Title IX 비례성 기준과 대체로 부합했고 사립기관의 여성 1인당 조정 효과가 더 강했다.
items.title: Gender-Responsive Budgeting in Higher Education: An Examination of Collegiate Athletics Student Aid

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The United Nations' fifth Sustainable Development Goal calls for gender equality and empowerment. Gender budgeting (GB) has been proposed as a potential mechanism to reduce gender disparities. This is a novel approach to budgeting that considers the impact of public spending on women and other underrepresented groups. Despite its growing popularity, spreading to over 80 countries since its launch in the 1980s, the effectiveness of GB remains less understood. This study tests whether GB has led to tangible improvements in women's well‐being, equality, and empowerment. We use an event study research design with staggered adoption to analyze data across 47 countries from 2000 to 2023. Our analyses of average and heterogeneous treatment effects reveal short‐ and long‐term impacts; notably, we find significant reductions in maternal mortality ratios and adolescent birth rates, as well as improvements in women's political empowerment.

Marjorie De la Cruz: Department of Public Policy and Administration, School of International and Public Affairs Florida International University Miami Florida USA
Milena I. Neshkova: Department of Public Policy and Administration, School of International and Public Affairs Florida International University Miami Florida USA
Yoon‐Jung Choi: Department of Public Policy and Administration, School of International and Public Affairs Florida International University Miami Florida USA

items.summary_ko: 성인지 예산이 여성의 웰빙·평등·역량 강화에 실질적 개선을 가져왔는지를 검토하기 위해 2000~2023년 47개국 자료에 시차를 둔 도입을 활용한 사건연구를 실시했다. 성인지 예산은 단기·장기적으로 모성 사망률과 청소년 출산율을 유의하게 낮추고 여성의 정치적 역량 강화를 개선한 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Does Gender Budgeting Improve Women's Well‐Being, Equality, and Empowerment?

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The complex nature of top public managerial work is widely acknowledged in theory but rarely examined empirically. Existing research has mostly analyzed bivariate relationships among core components of top managerial work in government, including managers' attributes, practices, outcomes, and contexts. Drawing on a systems‐based framework, we investigate how effective top managerial work unfolds as a complex relational practice. We analyze seven cases of long‐serving, distinguished Chilean senior executives through a comprehensive and process‐oriented lens, based on 27 semi‐structured interviews with the managers and members of their personal and professional networks. Our findings indicate how the relational dynamics in which senior public executives engage shape their managerial attributes and practices. Specifically, strategizing, motivation building, and technical expertise are best understood as emerging primarily through interactions within agencies and with external sociopolitical environments. These results qualify perspectives that explain senior public management effectiveness by overemphasizing executives' individual attributes and views, and underscore the need for personnel policies and governance environments that equip managers with the capacities called for by a systems approach to top public management.

Constanza Faune: Centre for Public Systems, Industrial Engineering Department University of Chile Santiago Chile
Javier Fuenzalida: Centre for Public Systems, Industrial Engineering Department University of Chile Santiago Chile
School of Social and Political Sciences University of Melbourne Melbourne Victoria Australia
Norma M. Riccucci: School of Public Affairs and Administration Rutgers University Newark New Jersey USA

items.summary_ko: 칠레의 장기 재직 우수 고위 공공관리자 7명을 대상으로 27건의 반구조화 인터뷰를 분석해, 효과적인 최고위 관리가 개인 속성의 단순한 발현이 아니라 기관 내부 및 외부 사회정치적 환경과의 관계적 상호작용 속에서 형성되는 과정을 규명했다. 특히 전략 수립, 동기 부여, 기술적 전문성은 이러한 상호작용을 통해 주로 출현하며, 이에 맞는 인사정책과 거버넌스 환경이 필요하다고 제시한다.
items.title: Rethinking Top Public Management Through Relational Dynamics: A Systems‐Informed Study of Senior Executives

items.abstract: Administrative burdens embedded within many public policies are often politically contentious, such that core values and belief systems can drive either support or opposition. In this paper, we use survey data from US respondents to replicate and extend previous research on the public acceptance of administrative burdens in general. First, we confirm the measure's validity by examining its effects on beliefs across policies that range from highly polarized to less politically contentious. Second, we test the relationship between tolerance of administrative burden and cultural theory (CT) variables that tap into worldview orientations related to hierarchy, egalitarianism, individualism, and fatalism, which previous research has found predictive of policy preferences across a wide range of domains, even after accounting for political ideology and partisanship. We hypothesize that egalitarians and individualists will generally be less tolerant of burdens, while hierarchs will be more accepting of burdensome requirements. However, this effect varies depending on the nature of the burdens and how they relate to perceived threats for each worldview.

Matthew C. Nowlin: The University of Texas at Arlington

items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 미국 응답자 설문자료를 활용해 행정 부담 수용도 측정의 타당성을 양극화 수준이 다른 정책들에서 확인하고, 문화이론의 세계관 변수와 행정 부담 관용도의 관계를 분석했다. 평등주의자와 개인주의자는 부담에 덜 관용적이고 위계주의자는 더 수용적일 것으로 가설화했으며, 그 효과는 부담의 성격과 각 세계관이 인식하는 위협에 따라 달라질 수 있음을 검토했다.
items.title: Cultural Theory, Political Ideology, and Burden Tolerance: The Role of Core Beliefs in Shaping Support for Administrative Burdens

items.abstract: Research on public value preferences (PVPs) among civil servants is a key area in public value studies. However, existing research on PVPs has not considered their implicit dimensions, which largely limits the understanding of the concept’s structure and measurement. Drawing on the dual-attitudes model from social psychology, this article proposes an explicit–implicit dual structure of PVPs and empirically tests this structure using a quasi-experimental design. The sample comprised a civil servant group (n = 109) and a non‑civil servant group (n = 116). Findings show that civil servants’ PVPs have a two-dimensional structure of explicit and implicit: Compared with non-civil servants, civil servants have more positive explicit PVPs but relatively negative implicit PVPs. This study systematically examines the existence, direction, and magnitude of the incongruence between civil servants’ implicit and explicit PVPs, offering a more cognitively complex theoretical framework for PVPs.
items.summary_ko: 공무원의 공공가치 선호가 명시적·암묵적 태도의 이중 구조를 갖는지 준실험적으로 검증했다. 공무원은 비공무원보다 명시적 선호는 더 긍정적이지만 암묵적 선호는 상대적으로 부정적이어서 두 차원 간 불일치가 나타났다.
items.title: Implicit-Explicit Incongruence: The Dual Structure of Public Value Preferences in Civil Servants

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Studies in representative bureaucracy have focused on whether passive representation translates into active representation. We shift this analytical lens by conceptualizing passive representation not as a static demographic condition or a preliminary stage, but as a dynamic organizational process. Drawing on 15 in‐depth interviews and a focus group with 14 ultra‐Orthodox women serving in mid‐ and senior‐level public positions in Israel, we examine how passive representation is enacted, negotiated, and gradually institutionalized in male‐dominated settings. Findings show how women's underrepresentation structures their entry and advancement through informal expectations and gendered networks, and how women “negotiate presence” by building legitimacy through heightened professionalism, creative networking in the face of gender segregation, and strategic engagement with supportive leaders. Through mentoring and gate‐opening practices, our participants created ripple effects that increased access for others over time. We argue that passive representation is a relational and evolving mechanism shaped by role interpretations and organizational constraints, reshaping access and participation even without formal policy changes.

Maayan Davidovitz: The Lester and Sally Entin Faculty of Humanities, School of Education Tel Aviv University Tel Aviv Israel
Rachel Gali Cinamon: The Lester and Sally Entin Faculty of Humanities, School of Education Tel Aviv University Tel Aviv Israel

items.summary_ko: 이스라엘 공공조직의 중·고위직 초정통파 여성 14명을 대상으로 한 15건의 심층 인터뷰와 포커스그룹을 통해, 남성 중심 환경에서 수동적 대표성이 어떻게 실행·협상되고 점차 제도화되는지 분석했다. 여성들은 높은 전문성, 성별분리 상황에 맞춘 창의적 네트워킹, 지원적 지도자와의 전략적 협력을 통해 정당성을 구축했으며, 멘토링과 기회 개방으로 다른 여성들의 접근과 참여를 확대했다.
items.title: Negotiating Presence: The Dynamics of Passive Representation Among Ultra‐Orthodox Women in Public Organizations

items.abstract: Municipalities implementing energy transition mandates rely on contingent workers to fill capacity and expertise gaps, raising concerns about dependency and knowledge loss. Drawing on Resource Dependence Theory and client–consultant literature, this study develops a framework capturing the feedback loop between external reliance and internal capacity development. Fifteen interviews across six Dutch municipalities show that labour shortages and temporary subsidies drive contingent hiring, while short contracts and limited knowledge transfer heighten dependency. Municipalities facing similar constraints diverge through knowledge integration, governance arrangements, and relational dynamics. It advances public administration scholarship by conceptualising dependency as a process rather than structural outcome.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 지방자치단체가 에너지 전환 의무를 이행할 때 외부 인력 의존과 내부 역량 개발이 어떻게 상호작용하는지를 6개 지방자치단체 대상 15건의 인터뷰로 분석했다. 인력 부족과 한시적 보조금이 외부 인력 채용을 촉진하고, 짧은 계약과 제한적인 지식 이전이 의존성을 높였지만, 지식 통합·거버넌스 방식·관계적 역학에 따라 의존의 경로는 달라졌으며 의존성을 고정된 결과가 아닌 과정으로 개념화했다.
items.title: Contingent capacity: navigating organizational dependency in Dutch municipal energy transitions

items.abstract: This study examines whether gendered differences in discretion shape inequality among street-level bureaucrats (SLBs). Focusing on the provision of informal personal resources (IFRs) to clients, we analyzed 59 in-depth interviews with social workers in Israel. While both women and men engage in extensive informal practices, their scope and form differ. Two mechanisms drive the reproduction of inequality: invisibility versus visibility of IFRs, and boundary setting between personal and professional spheres. These findings reveal that discretion in implementation not only is gendered but also reproduces conventional hierarchies, intensifying gender inequality at the street level of public administration.
items.summary_ko: 이스라엘 사회복지사 59명을 대상으로 한 심층 인터뷰를 통해, 일선 관료가 재량으로 제공하는 비공식적 개인 자원이 성별에 따라 어떻게 다르게 나타나는지 분석했다. 여성과 남성 모두 이러한 관행을 광범위하게 활용하지만, 자원의 가시성 및 개인적·전문적 영역의 경계 설정 차이가 불평등을 재생산하고 성별 불평등을 심화시키는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Gender inequality at the street level explained: redoing gender through informal practices

items.abstract: This study was conducted to assess the usefulness of the complex policy change analysis (CPCA) model and to identify key turning points in the process of revising South Korea’s three kindergarten laws (3KL). Using the CPCA model and its associated analytical methods, the analysis confirmed three main findings: the victory of the pro-revision coalition, which secured both public and presidential support; the failure of the anti-revision coalition due to its reliance on extra-parliamentary struggle; and the limited functional role played by the policy mediators. These findings offer empirical support for the explanatory power of the CPCA model in accounting for policy change.

Jae-Moo Lee: The Korea Institute of Network Governance, Seoul, Republic of Korea
Kyung-Seu Cho: Eulji University, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 복합 정책변화 분석(CPCA) 모형을 활용해 한국의 유치원 3법 개정 과정에서 주요 전환점을 분석하고, 해당 모형의 유용성을 평가했다. 분석 결과, 공공 및 대통령 지지를 확보한 개정 찬성 연합이 승리했으며, 의회 밖 투쟁에 의존한 반대 연합은 실패했고, 정책 중개자의 기능적 역할은 제한적이었다.
items.title: South Korea’s Three Kindergarten Laws: A Revision Process Analysis Using a Complex Policy Change Analytical Model

items.abstract: Abstract Normative and empirical scholars typically treat partisans’ distrust of their political rivals as a product of individual cognitive biases. But even if bias is inevitable, it is parties’ coalition‐building and messaging strategies that determine who bias is directed toward. This paper argues that the social sorting of party conflict exacerbates the epistemic and democratic harm of partisan distrust by generating distinctive patterns of epistemic inequality. I show that when voters associate parties with particular social groups, members of those groups suffer greater risk of testimonial injustice and related credibility deficits owing to their perceived partisanship. These dynamics are most damaging for members of marginalized groups, as party–group overlap can reinforce the prejudices they already face. Addressing these harms, I argue, requires looking beyond individual partisans to the background features of party systems that shape how elites mobilize group identities and animus in the struggle for office.

Justin Pottle: Department of Political Science Loyola University Chicago Chicago Illinois USA

items.summary_ko: 정당 갈등의 사회적 동조화가 정당 불신을 개인의 인지 편향을 넘어 어떻게 인식론적 불평등으로 심화시키는지 이론적으로 분석한다. 정당과 특정 사회집단의 결합은 해당 집단 구성원에게 증언적 부정의와 신뢰성 결핍의 위험을 높이며, 특히 주변화된 집단에서 기존 편견과 결합해 피해를 키운다는 점을 보인다.
items.title: Partisan bias in a sorted party system: A problem of epistemic inequality

items.abstract: Drawing on pre- and post-COVID-19 surveys of human service and arts-and-culture nonprofits, this study examined how preexisting social connectedness and revenue structure were associated with organizational resilience. Nonprofits with more connections to government reported fewer operational disruptions, particularly in program delivery, contract continuity, and volunteer capacity, than peers whose ties were concentrated within the nonprofit sector. Financial profiles also mattered, although the relationship between revenue diversification and resilience was more complex than expected. Together, the findings identify social connectedness and revenue structure as important correlates of resilience. The study’s central contribution is to specify the conditions under which collaboration and resource diversification translate into organizational capacity during crises and to offer guidance for nonprofit leaders seeking to build more resilient organizations.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 코로나19 전후 인적서비스·예술문화 비영리단체 설문을 바탕으로 정부와의 네트워크 연결 및 수입구조가 조직 회복력과 어떤 관련이 있는지 분석했다. 정부와 더 많이 연결된 단체는 비영리 부문 내부에 관계가 집중된 단체보다 프로그램 제공, 계약 지속성, 자원봉사 역량에서 운영 중단을 덜 경험했으며, 수입 다변화의 효과는 예상보다 복합적이었다.
items.title: Connected for Survival: How Organizational Networks with Government Strengthen Nonprofit Resilience in Delivering Public Services

items.abstract: The governance turn in public administration suggests that collaboration with private and third-sector actors can improve services and results. However, evidence remains fragmented at the practice-field level, where such benefits are expected to materialize. To assess the evidence base, we synthesized 71 studies of voluntary cross-sectoral collaborations for work inclusion, that is, initiatives aimed at enhancing employment for vulnerable jobseekers. The literature is predominantly process oriented, emphasizing how these tension-prone collaborations can be organized and sustained. It further suggests that collaboration is often layered onto, rather than challenging, established administrative approaches. While studies report jobseeker empowerment and employment gains, the governance assumption that collaboration improves results remains weakly substantiated. Governance scholarship would benefit from stronger field-based evidence on when, how, and at what cost cross-sectoral collaboration improves results relative to what can be achieved through established approaches.
items.summary_ko: 취약 구직자의 고용 증진을 위한 자발적 부문 간 협력에 관한 71편의 연구를 체계적으로 종합해, 협력의 조직·지속 방식과 성과 근거를 검토했다. 문헌은 협력 과정에 집중하며 기존 행정 접근을 대체하기보다 그 위에 추가되는 경향을 보였고, 구직자 역량 강화와 고용 개선이 보고되었지만 협력이 기존 방식보다 성과를 향상한다는 거버넌스의 가정은 충분히 입증되지 않았다.
items.title: Cross-Sectoral Collaboration for Work Inclusion and the Governance Perspective: A Systematic Literature Review and Research Directions

items.abstract: Abstract Political efforts to weaken democratic institutions place civil servants in a dilemma between political responsiveness and protecting democratic values. As civil servants are embedded in the political-administrative hierarchy, we argue that signals from their direct hierarchical superiors are critical to understand how civil servants address this dilemma. Using a randomized survey experiment among Norwegian national-level civil servants (N = 1,446) and ordered logistic regression models, we find that democratic backsliding increases opposition to government wishes, internal and external voice, and consideration of exit from the organization. Managerial signals moderate these effects: civil servants are more inclined to voice concerns or consider exit when managers signal responsiveness to government wishes. In a conceptual replication and extension among US federal, state and local civil servants (N = 504) using ordered logistic regression models, we likewise find a greater inclination to exit if the manager signals responsiveness to government wishes, but also that respondents are less inclined to voice concerns to the manager. Overall, our findings imply that managerial signals within the political-administrative hierarchy are shaping civil servants’ immediate reactions to democratic backsliding.

Benny Geys: BI Norwegian Business School (Campus Bergen) Department of Economics, , Kong Christian Frederiks Plass 5, 5006 Bergen, Norway
Mads Pieter van Luttervelt: Aarhus University Department of Political Science, , Bartholins Allé 7, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark

items.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
items.summary_ko: 민주적 후퇴 상황에서 관료의 대응이 직속 상관의 정부 의사에 대한 반응성 신호에 따라 어떻게 달라지는지를 노르웨이 국가공무원 대상 무작위 설문실험과 미국 공무원 대상 개념적 반복·확장 설문으로 분석했다. 민주적 후퇴는 정부 요구에 대한 반대, 내부·외부 발언, 조직 이탈 고려를 높였으며, 상관이 정부 요구에 반응적이라고 신호할수록 우려 표명과 이탈 고려가 증가했지만 미국 표본에서는 상관에게 우려를 표명하려는 경향이 감소했다.
items.title: Civil Servants and Democratic Backsliding: The Role of Managerial Signals

items.abstract: A suite of state-level laws that increase the burden placed on eligible voters has proliferated in the years following the 2013 Shelby County v. Holder decision. Critics have argued that these laws are thinly veiled attempts by Republicans to disenfranchise minority groups who lean toward the Democratic Party. If this is the case, attitudes about these restrictive policies should be powerfully driven by empathy for the groups negatively impacted, so long as individuals recognize the racialized intent behind the laws. This study examines the links between outgroup empathy and opposition to a variety of voting restrictions. Evidence from multiple national surveys conducted from 2018 to 2024 indicates that higher outgroup empathy indeed corresponds to greater opposition to restrictive voting laws. As predicted, however, this relationship is highly conditional on political sophistication: those most likely to be aware that these laws target minorities are also those who bring outgroup empathy to bear on their opposition to voting regulations intended to restrict access to the ballot.

José D. Villalobos: The University of Texas at El Paso

items.summary_ko: 2013년 이후 확산된 투표 접근 제한 법안에 대한 반대가 소수집단에 대한 공감과 어떤 관련이 있는지, 그리고 정치적 숙련도에 따라 이 관계가 달라지는지를 2018~2024년 여러 전국 설문으로 분석했다. 분석 결과, 외집단 공감이 높을수록 제한적 투표법에 반대했으며, 소수집단을 겨냥한 법안임을 인식할 가능성이 높은 정치적 숙련자에게서 이 관계가 특히 강하게 나타났다.
items.title: Outgroup Empathy and Opposition to Restrictive Voting Laws

items.abstract: How does the ever-growing relevance of social media shape political campaigning? A vibrant public and academic debate addresses the role of social media in elections and democratic processes. Yet, despite a surge in research, we still know little about the extent to which political parties adjust established issue strategies to the priorities of different social media platforms’ audiences and how effective these are in generating user engagement. Drawing on theories of issue competition – issue ownership, riding-the-wave, and issue yield – we analyze parties’ social media communication during the 2025 German federal election campaign on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. Combining manual quantitative content analysis of party and candidate posts with large-scale survey data from the German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES), we assess both strategic use and effectiveness of issue strategies. Our results show that parties strategically prioritize owned issues and those salient on the general public agenda, often combining both dimensions in issue yield strategies. However, these strategies only partly align with what the specific platform audiences value and reward. User engagement is highest for posts that match platform-specific issue preferences, especially when the issues are salient both to a party’s supporters on that platform and to its wider user base. The findings offer new insights into the dynamics of contemporary digital campaigning and cross-platform party competition.
items.summary_ko: 2025년 독일 연방선거에서 정당들이 페이스북·인스타그램·틱톡의 이용자층에 맞춰 이슈 전략을 조정하는지, 그리고 이러한 전략이 이용자 참여를 얼마나 이끌어내는지를 분석했다. 정당·후보자 게시물의 수동 정량 내용분석과 독일종단선거연구(GLES) 대규모 설문자료를 결합한 결과, 정당들은 소유 이슈와 일반 대중 의제의 현저성이 높은 이슈를 우선했지만 플랫폼별 선호와는 부분적으로만 일치했으며, 플랫폼 이용자 선호에 부합하는 게시물, 특히 지지자와 전체 이용자 모두에게 중요한 이슈를 다룬 게시물의 참여도가 가장 높았다.
items.title: Social Media Savvy? The Use and Effectiveness of Political Parties’ Issue Strategies Across Platforms in the German Federal Election Campaign 2025

items.abstract: How does top-down accountability shape policy implementation? Drawing on institutional logics, this paper distinguishes two state sub-logics: ‘high-stakes context logic’ emphasizing centralized control during crises, and ‘routine governance logic’ allowing discretion during day-to-day administration. These sub-logics condition the perceived legitimacy of accountability demands, felt accountability, and behavioural responses. A survey experiment with over 800 public service respondents shows that, under high-stakes logic, intensified accountability progressively improve compliance, whereas under routine logic, moderate accountability produces optimal compliance, with high-intensity accountability yielding diminishing returns. These findings challenge binary views of accountability and reveal how within-logic variations may alter governance mechanisms.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 제도적 논리 관점에서 위기 상황의 ‘고강도 맥락 논리’와 일상 행정의 ‘정례 거버넌스 논리’가 하향식 책무성 요구와 정책 집행에 미치는 영향을 설문 실험으로 분석했다. 800명 이상의 공공서비스 종사자를 대상으로 한 결과, 고강도 맥락에서는 책무성 강화가 순응을 점진적으로 높였지만 정례 거버넌스에서는 중간 수준의 책무성이 최적이었고 고강도 책무성은 한계효과를 보였다.
items.title: Beyond monolithic state logic: how top-down accountability shapes policy implementation

items.abstract: In response to demands for greater police accountability, many departments have adopted policies designed to better regulate the use of force and to make it easier to investigate and punish officers accused of wrongdoing. While not widespread, there is some evidence that these changes have increased disciplinary actions. However, it remains uncertain whether police discipline has been applied equitably across racial and gender groups within departments. Drawing on multiple bodies of scholarship, we develop the expectation that, because of their status as members of organizational outgroups, Black, Hispanic and female officers are likely to be disciplined at higher rates. Importantly, we also argue that racial, ethnic and gender differences in disciplinary outcomes are at least partially mediated by the way in which police departments treat complaints against these officers. We test these hypotheses in data from Chicago's Civilian Office of Police Accountability (COPA) from 1971 through 2018. Analyses of over 249,000 allegations indicate that female and Black officers and officers face a higher likelihood of reprimand and suspension compared to White male officers. Differences across these groups are entirely explained, however, by the greater likelihood that complaints against these officers are deemed sufficiently supported by evidence to warrant disciplinary action. We conclude by discussing the broader implications for understanding employee discipline and the potential impact of recent efforts to enhance police accountability.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 시카고 민원처리기관의 1971~2018년 24만9천 건 이상 신고 자료를 분석해, 경찰 조직 내 흑인·히스패닉·여성 경찰관의 징계 결과가 백인 남성보다 불리한지, 그리고 민원 처분이 이를 매개하는지 검증했다. 여성 및 흑인 경찰관은 견책·정직 가능성이 더 높았지만, 그 차이는 이들에 대한 민원이 징계 조치를 정당화할 만큼 증거가 충분하다고 판단될 가능성이 더 높기 때문에 전적으로 설명되었다.
items.title: Disparity in Police Disciplinary Outcomes: The Mediating Effect of Complaint Disposition for Organizational Outgroups

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Co‐production is a complex and nuanced field of social action that operates at multiple levels of the policy cycle, closely interconnecting the roles, motivations, and outcomes of different social actors. But how co‐production practices are shaped by gender is often overlooked. This article highlights the complexity of co‐production practices within Indonesia's ambitious national strategy to reduce child stunting. Based on qualitative research of three local government areas implementing stunting intervention programs, we draw on the ‘Four Co(s)’ framework to explore variations across co‐commissioning, co‐design, co‐delivery, and co‐assessment. Ongoing challenges to the eradication of stunting in some areas highlight the tense intersections between early marriage, poverty and rural and technological disadvantage. But as we argue, it is also dependent on social actors, especially women, who serve as catalysts. Future research that pays closer attention to the inherently gendered expressions of co‐production is both theoretically and practically necessary.

Jusuf Irianto: Department of Public Administration, Faculty of Social and Political Sciences Universitas Airlangga Surabaya Indonesia
Mary S. Mangai: School of Public Management and Administration University of Pretoria, Hatfield Campus Pretoria South Africa
