Violeta Schubert: Development Studies Program, School of Social and Political Sciences The University of Melbourne Parkville Australia

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 인도네시아 아동 발육부진 감축 프로그램에서 성별이 공동생산의 공동기획·공동설계·공동집행·공동평가를 어떻게 형성하는지 탐색한다. 세 지방정부 지역에 대한 질적 연구와 ‘Four Co(s)’ 틀을 적용한 결과, 조혼·빈곤·농촌 및 기술적 불리함이 지속적인 문제로 나타났으며 특히 여성이 공동생산을 촉진하는 핵심 행위자로 기능하는 것으로 분석되었다.
items.title: Toward a Gender Sensitive and Locally Rooted co‐Production Approach: Insights From Implementing Child Stunting Eradication Program in Indonesia

items.abstract: The goal of this article is to explore whether municipal and regional cooperation can provide robust governance solutions during a polycrisis. The methodology of the article is based on a single-country case study from Czechia. The case study focuses on coping with the COVID-19 pandemic and the refugee crisis resulting from the war in Ukraine. We demonstrate how cooperation between a city and a region contributed to robust solutions and improved the lives of local communities. Although municipal and regional cooperation can potentially create significant positive effects that align with the definition of robust governance, this potential is not fully realized in Czechia. The main reasons for this untapped potential are failures of the central government, a lack of leadership and strategic focus, and the absence of formalized learning.
items.summary_ko: 이 글은 체코의 코로나19 팬데믹과 우크라이나 전쟁에 따른 난민 위기 대응을 단일국가 사례연구로 분석해, 도시와 지역 간 협력이 강건한 거버넌스 해법을 제공할 수 있는지 탐색한다. 협력은 지역사회의 삶을 개선하고 강건한 해법에 기여했지만, 중앙정부의 실패, 리더십과 전략적 초점 부족, 공식화된 학습의 부재로 그 잠재력이 충분히 실현되지 않았다.
items.title: Can cooperation between a city and a region lead to a robust solution during a polycrisis? – the case of Czechia

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This study investigates power dynamics in metropolitan governance by analyzing the evolution of an inter‐municipal network in a Latin American city. It argues that actors build partnering strategies in a bid to improve their position in the network while minimizing the costs of collaborative action. These network micro‐mechanisms aggregate to produce macro‐level structures that may or may not mitigate the starting power asymmetries. By applying stochastic actor‐oriented models (SAOMs) to longitudinal data for 2009–2021, corresponding to three mayoral terms, the research reveals how collaborative dynamics are driven by resource disparities and preferential attachment that, in turn, reinforce the central positions of certain municipalities and potentially exacerbate power imbalances in metropolitan governance. The findings underscore the critical importance of considering these power dynamics when studying the operation and performance of polycentric governance systems, particularly in contexts marked by existing inequalities.

Alejandro Espinosa‐Rada: Institute of Sociology, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile Santiago Chile
Karina Arias‐Yurisch: School of Government Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile Santiago Chile
Karina Retamal‐Soto: Department of Public Administration and Management Universidad de Chile Santiago Chile

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 라틴아메리카 한 도시의 지방정부 간 네트워크가 2009~2021년 세 차례 시장 임기 동안 어떻게 변화했으며, 그 과정에서 권력 비대칭이 완화되거나 심화되는지를 분석한다. 종단 네트워크 자료에 확률적 행위자 지향 모형(SAOM)을 적용한 결과, 자원 격차와 선호적 연결이 일부 지방정부의 중심적 지위를 강화해 광역 거버넌스의 권력 불균형을 심화시킬 가능성이 나타났다.
items.title: Disclosing Power Dynamics in Metropolitan Governance: An Analysis of Network Micro‐Mechanisms of Change in an Evolving Inter‐Municipal Network

items.abstract: Abstract Does affective polarization change how citizens view and participate in democracy? We posit that the answer to this crucial question depends on how affectively un polarized citizens view and participate in democracy. Yet, the most common operationalization of affective polarization––measuring sympathy ratings for one party relative to another––does not differentiate between people’s absolute sympathy ratings for the parties, which may mask essential heterogeneity among unpolarized citizens. This paper theorizes the methodological origin of this heterogeneity, describes it, and highlights its implications. Cluster analyses and regressions from three nationally representative surveys in the US provide three conclusions. First, substantial shares of the US population are affectively un polarized. Second, unpolarized citizens cluster into two groups: one feeling lukewarm and one feeling cold toward both parties. Third, these unpolarized groups report diverging democratic attitudes and participation patterns. We discuss the methodological implications and the need for future research on affectively unpolarized citizens.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 정서적 양극화가 민주주의에 대한 시민의 인식과 참여에 미치는 영향을 이해하기 위해, 정당에 대한 절대적 호감도의 차이를 반영하여 미국 전국대표 설문 3건을 군집분석과 회귀분석으로 분석했다. 정서적으로 비양극화된 시민은 양당에 미지근한 집단과 모두에게 냉담한 집단으로 나뉘며, 두 집단은 민주주의 태도와 참여 양상에서 서로 다른 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Cool Citizens? How Affectively Unpolarized Citizens View and Participate in Democracy

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Local implementers have discretion in selecting forms of housing for the homeless, yet the determinants of these choices remain poorly understood. Using the institutional collective action (ICA) framework, this study examines California's Homekey program to assess how coordination demands shape decisions among hotel conversions, multifamily acquisitions, and modular or new construction. Drawing on binary logistic, generalized estimating equation (GEE), and multinomial logistic models, we find that larger projects and those designated as permanent housing are significantly more likely to pursue hotel conversions. Housing authorities—owing to their specialized missions and lower form‐specific coordination costs—are over six times more likely than cities to select multifamily acquisition. Local vacancy constraints further steer implementers away from modular or new construction and toward hotel conversions. These results demonstrate that implementation form is not a neutral technical decision but an institutional response to coordination challenges embedded in intergovernmental and interorganizational contexts.

Edmund Poku Adu: Department of Government, Law, and Policy Arkansas State University Jonesboro Arkansas USA
Julius A. Nukpezah: Department of Political Science and Public Administration Mississippi State University Starkville Mississippi USA

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 제도적 집합행동(ICA) 관점에서 캘리포니아 Homekey 프로그램의 지방 집행자들이 호텔 전환, 다가구주택 매입, 모듈러·신축 중 주거 형태를 선택하는 데 조정 수요가 어떤 영향을 미치는지 분석했다. 이항 로지스틱, GEE, 다항 로지스틱 모형을 사용한 결과, 대규모·영구주택 사업은 호텔 전환을, 주택당국은 다가구주택 매입을 더 선택했으며, 지역 공실 제약은 모듈러·신축보다 호텔 전환을 유도했다.
items.title: Coordination Costs and Homelessness Housing Form Choice

items.abstract: A much-cited finding in recent political science is that average citizens in established democracies appear to have little influence on public policy, while the affluent have strong influence. Yet, as critics have pointed out, average and affluent often want the same from government, meaning that even without influence, average citizens often get the policies they want ‘by coincidence’. This raises an important question: Do citizens care about ‘who governs’ if government regularly adopts their preferred policies anyway? Using a preregistered survey experiment, I show that political inequality causes just as much popular dissatisfaction with government when policy outcomes are highly consistent with a respondent’s policy preferences, as it does when policy outcomes are inconsistent with those preferences. While opinion-policy congruence remains an important predictor of satisfaction, citizens also appear to value political equality independently of policy outcomes. These findings suggest that coincidental representation may not fully compensate for perceived inequalities in political influence.
items.summary_ko: 정책 선호와 실제 정책의 일치 여부가 정부 만족도에 미치는 영향과, 정책 결과가 선호와 일치하더라도 정치적 영향력의 불평등이 불만을 초래하는지를 사전등록 설문실험으로 검토했다. 정책-의견 일치는 만족도의 중요한 예측요인이었지만, 응답자들은 정책 결과와 무관하게 정치적 평등도 중시했으며, 우연한 대표성이 영향력 불평등을 완전히 보상하지 못하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Coincidental Representation: How Congruence and Influence shape Public Satisfaction with Government

items.abstract: ABSTRACT A growing body of scholarship views corruption not merely as a failure of monitoring and enforcement but as a resilient informal institution sustained by social perceptions—and misperceptions. When citizens believe others tolerate or engage in corruption, resisting it becomes a collective action problem, allowing corruption to perpetuate itself. Using a large‐scale survey experiment in China, this study tests whether correcting exaggerated perceptions of social tolerance for corruption can help break this cycle. We find that providing information about the actual (low) level of tolerance significantly strengthens anti‐corruption attitudes and intentions, especially among those who mistakenly believed a majority tolerated corruption. However, this effect is weakened when paired with punishment cues, suggesting that enforcement information can crowd out the motivational force of norm‐based messages. Our findings demonstrate both the potential and the limits of norm‐based informational interventions and offer implications for anti‐corruption messaging in comparable contexts.

Feng Yang: Center for Social Research Guanghua School of Management, and Yenching Academy Peking University Beijing China
Lin Zhu: Center for Chinese Public Administration Research and School of Government Sun Yat‐sen University Guangzhou China

items.summary_ko: 중국에서 부패에 대한 사회적 관용 수준을 실제보다 높게 인식하는 오해를 바로잡는 정보가 반부패 태도와 의도를 강화하는지, 그리고 처벌 단서가 이 효과에 미치는 영향을 대규모 설문실험으로 검증했다. 실제 관용 수준이 낮다는 정보는 특히 다수가 부패를 용인한다고 잘못 믿은 사람들에게 효과적이었지만, 처벌 정보와 결합하면 규범 기반 메시지의 동기 효과가 약화됐다.
items.title: Social Norms, State Punishment, and Motivation Crowding in Anti‐Corruption Messaging: Experimental Evidence From China

items.abstract: Existing research shows that voters in established democracies often fail to penalize politicians who violate democratic norms, as many are willing to trade democratic principles for partisan interests in polarized environments. Yet such partisan double standards remain underexplored in East Asia, where countries share authoritarian legacies, face ongoing risks of democratic backsliding, and operate under the geopolitical shadow of powerful authoritarian neighbors. Using a large-scale vignette experiment conducted in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and the United States (N = 10,194), this study examines whether voters sanction politicians who engage in democratic norm violations. We focus on reactions to three types of undemocratic statements: election denial, protest suppression, and attacks on the judiciary. The results show that voters in East Asian democracies impose stronger penalties than their American counterparts, though the degree and pattern of accountability differ across cases. Election denial consistently generates the strongest sanctions, while Japan and Taiwan show robust reactions across all scenarios. South Korea displays comparatively modest responses to protest suppression, and the United States shows the weakest effects overall. These findings highlight both the resilience and the heterogeneity of democratic accountability in East Asia and underscore the need to understand regional variation when assessing the prospects for democratic stability.
items.summary_ko: 일본·한국·대만·미국 유권자 10,194명을 대상으로 한 비네트 실험을 통해 선거 부정, 시위 억압, 사법부 공격 등 민주적 규범 위반 정치인에 대한 제재와 정파적 이중 기준을 비교했다. 동아시아 민주국가 유권자들이 미국 유권자보다 더 강하게 제재했으며, 선거 부정에 대한 제재가 가장 일관되게 강했고 국가별·위반 유형별 차이도 나타났다.
items.title: Democratic Accountability in East Asia: A Comparative Experimental Study of Voter Responses to Norm Violations

items.abstract: This paper explores how the discourse surrounding a racially marginalized community becomes politicized via culture war narratives across platforms. Drawing from identity politics and political polarization research, we discuss how racial justice discourse can be hijacked by partisan opinion leaders and their followers over time and explain how this process plays out through both differentiated and coordinated social media platform use. Situating our discussion in the “woke” discourse as originated within the Black Twitter community, we collect data from 2012 through 2022 on Twitter and YouTube and apply user- and content-level computational analyses. Results show that the term “woke” has been increasingly amplified in culture war conversations on both platforms over time. However, the two platforms exhibited differences: culture war topics dominated on Twitter, while conservative news and commentary channels were most prevalent on YouTube. These two platforms were also interrelated in the politicization process. YouTube was a top domain within external links embedded in tweets, and Twitter was also a top destination within the external links embedded in YouTube video descriptions. Conservatives were especially keen on sharing right-wing content across platforms, from YouTube to Twitter, suggesting the success of cross-platform coordination in amplifying culture wars. Both theoretical and political implications for polarization on social media are discussed.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 인종적으로 주변화된 공동체의 사회정의 담론이 트위터와 유튜브에서 문화전쟁 서사를 통해 어떻게 정치화되는지 2012~2022년 자료에 대한 이용자·콘텐츠 수준의 계산분석으로 검토했다. ‘woke’는 양 플랫폼에서 문화전쟁 담론 속에서 점점 증폭되었고, 트위터에서는 문화전쟁 주제가, 유튜브에서는 보수적 뉴스·논평 채널이 두드러졌으며, 특히 보수 이용자들의 플랫폼 간 콘텐츠 공유가 이러한 정치화를 연계·증폭했다.
items.title: From #StayWoke to “Culture Wars”: How Social Justice Discourse is Separately and Synergistically Politicized on Twitter and YouTube

items.abstract: A capable public sector workforce is essential for sustainable development. In public procurement, the ability of procurement reform to support Sustainable Development Goals depends on a workforce with the competencies and professional standing needed to translate reform into administrative practice. Drawing on Institutional Theory and strategic PHRM, this study examines how workforce professionalization in public procurement is being constructed and institutionalized in Lebanon under Public Procurement Law No. 244 of 2021. Using a document-based qualitative case study, the study analyzes legal documents, technical reports, competency frameworks, and training materials produced between 2020 and 2025. The findings show that workforce professionalization in public procurement advanced through competency frameworks, certification initiatives, and professional training systems. However, workforce professionalization remains unevenly embedded across the civil service system. The study contributes to strategic public HRM and procurement governance scholarship and offers insight into workforce professionalization in governance-constrained settings in the Global South.

Imane Hijal-Moghrabi: The University of Texas Permian Basin, Odessa, USA

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 레바논 공공조달법 제244호(2021) 아래 공공조달 인력의 전문화가 어떻게 구축·제도화되고 있는지를 문서 기반 질적 사례연구로 분석했다. 역량 프레임워크, 자격인증, 전문교육 체계를 통해 전문화가 진전됐지만, 공무원 체계 전반에 고르게 정착되지는 않은 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Advancing the Sustainability Development Goals Through Workforce Professionalization in Public Procurement: The Case of Lebanon

items.abstract: Public employees serve the public interest through their work and extend this commitment through volunteerism. However, it remains unclear what motivates them to volunteer when professional roles already fulfill intrinsic prosocial motivations. Drawing on theories from multiple life domains and public service motivation, this study examines how public sector workplace experiences, specifically exposure to public participation and job satisfaction, are associated with volunteering behavior. Using cross-sectional, nationally representative survey data from U.S. local government managers, this study finds that the relationships vary by individuals’ prior volunteering status. Among non-volunteers, higher levels of public participation exposure and job satisfaction are both associated with a greater probability of initiating volunteering. Among current volunteers, lower levels are associated with greater time devoted to volunteering, whereas higher levels are linked to volunteering across a wider range of domains. Job satisfaction negatively moderates the relationship between public participation exposure and volunteering intensity. This study extends conventional understanding of public employee volunteering beyond public service motivation and sector differences by demonstrating a contingent work–volunteerism association, offering practical insights into managing workplace experiences to sustain public service both within and beyond organizational boundaries.
items.summary_ko: 미국 지방정부 관리자 대상 전국 대표 단면 설문을 활용해, 공공참여 노출과 직무만족도가 자원봉사 참여 및 강도와 어떻게 관련되는지 개인의 기존 자원봉사 여부에 따라 분석했다. 비자원봉사자는 공공참여 노출과 직무만족도가 높을수록 자원봉사를 시작할 가능성이 높았고, 현재 자원봉사자는 이 수준이 낮을수록 더 많은 시간을 봉사했지만 높은 수준에서는 더 다양한 영역에서 봉사했으며, 직무만족도는 공공참여 노출과 봉사 강도의 관계를 부적으로 조절했다.
items.title: Serving the Public as Civil Servants or Citizens? Public Employees’ Exposure to Public Participation, Job Satisfaction, and Volunteering

items.abstract: Both government and government employees alike face negativity bias, but could conveying the exemplary work of public service help address declining public trust and engagement? While scholarly research has examined how the public assigns blame when the government or a contractor falls short, far less attention has been paid to the positive side. How is credit assigned to employees and agencies when they go above and beyond what is required in their jobs? This research addresses this gap through a vignette survey experiment, which is used to determine how contracting influences credit given to the service provider and the individual employee across levels of government –federal, state, and local. The results reveal that credit is more likely to be given to third-party providers than the government directly providing the service. However, at the individual employee level, the public prefers to give credit to public employees, especially at the federal government level, when outstanding work occurs. Findings have implications for contracting, performance, and accountability, where perhaps sharing more positive stories of public service can foster more positive public views.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 정부가 직접 서비스를 제공하는 경우와 외부 위탁하는 경우에 공공서비스 제공기관과 개별 직원에게 공로가 어떻게 귀속되는지를 연방·주·지방정부 수준별 비네트 설문실험으로 분석했다. 뛰어난 성과에 대한 공로는 정부보다 제3자 제공기관에 더 많이 돌아갔지만, 개별 직원 차원에서는 특히 연방정부에서 공무원에게 공로를 주려는 경향이 더 강했다.
items.title: Credit Attribution for Public Service Providers and Their Employees: Implications from Contracting Out

items.abstract: Abstract Territorial rights (TR) have become foundational in normative political theory, addressing pressing questions about boundary drawing, governance, and resource use. Influential TR theorists Cara Nine and Margaret Moore justify humans’ TR based on the functional, social, and identity‐anchored normative significance of non‐substitutable places. However, these arguments treat animals as resources, excluding them from normative consideration and political standing. This article analyzes Nine and Moore's arguments to assess whether their justificatory logic applies to wild animals. Using mule deers as a case study, I test whether they have sufficiently weighty interests in occupancy, residency, resource use, and control to ground duties on humans and whether TR theories should continue to treat animals as mere natural resources.

Pablo P. Castello: Sturm College of Law, University of Denver Denver Colorado USA

items.summary_ko: 본 논문은 인간의 영토권을 정당화하는 이론적 논리가 야생동물에게도 적용되는지, 특히 야생 당나귀사슴이 점유·거주·자원 이용·통제에 충분히 중대한 이해관계를 갖는지를 검토한다. 나인과 무어의 영토권 논리를 사례에 적용한 결과, 야생동물을 단순한 천연자원으로 취급하지 말고 인간에게 의무와 정치적 고려의 근거가 될 수 있는지 재검토해야 한다고 주장한다.
items.title: The territorial rights of wild animals: Justification

items.abstract: Abstract Timing of valence outcomes plays an important role in key theories of electoral choice, and different models place different emphases on past and future outcomes. Whereas sanctioning models consider only retrospective evaluations as an accountability mechanism, selection models hold that voters use past and proposed future conditions to infer the incumbent’s ability to deliver benefits. Drawing on four surveys run on six different samples, we demonstrate that voters prefer improving conditions in both retrospection and prospection. In retrospection, this pattern is difficult to distinguish from overweighting of temporally proximate conditions, which gave rise to the notion of “the myopic voter.” Distinguishing the two processes, we find that people do not ignore early datapoints and reward improving conditions (in both retrospection and prospection). This preference for improvement does not simply reflect an uncritical heuristic for upward trends. People are not universally myopic and many genuinely value improving aggregate conditions retrospectively and prospectively.
items.summary_ko: 유권자가 과거와 미래의 조건을 평가할 때 시간적으로 가까운 정보만 중시하는지, 아니면 개선되는 조건 자체를 선호하는지를 네 표본을 대상으로 한 네 차례 설문으로 검토했다. 유권자는 과거와 미래 모두에서 초기 정보도 무시하지 않으며 개선되는 조건을 선호했고, 이는 단순한 상승 추세 휴리스틱이나 보편적 근시안성으로 설명되지 않았다.
items.title: Are Voters Myopic or Looking for Improvement?

items.abstract: Social media and the internet have created new ways for representatives to communicate. How have members of Congress responded to these opportunities? We introduce a multi-platform dataset of congressional communications extending back to the onset of the social media era. Using computational language processing, we classify approximately 4.7 million tweets, 2.4 million Facebook posts, and 184,000 email newsletters authored by members of Congress between 2009 and 2022 based on intended purpose, and scale the partisanship of each message along a continuous left–right dimension. After validation, we demonstrate how our data can be used to study partisanship and representation in the contemporary Congress. Importantly, our data show congressional rhetoric has become more partisan and negative as social media usage has increased. We identify one potential mechanism contributing to this trend: partisanship and negativity receive inflated levels of positive engagement on social media relative to other forms of messaging like credit claiming or constituency service.
items.summary_ko: 의원들이 소셜미디어와 인터넷을 통해 의정 커뮤니케이션을 어떻게 수행하며, 그 과정에서 당파성과 대표성이 어떻게 나타나는지를 분석한다. 2009~2022년 약 470만 건의 트윗, 240만 건의 페이스북 게시물, 18만4천 건의 이메일 뉴스레터를 언어처리로 분류·측정한 결과, 소셜미디어 이용 증가와 함께 의회 수사가 더 당파적이고 부정적으로 변했으며, 소셜미디어에서는 당파적·부정적 메시지가 다른 메시지보다 긍정적 참여를 더 많이 얻는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Measuring Partisanship and Representation in Online Congressional Communications

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Some critical junctures fail to cause significant change in practice. Inspired by historical institutionalism, this article develops the concept of dynamic and static policy paths to explain why some critical junctures do not lead to change, while others do. Combining insights from policy process literature and policy implementation, it conceptualizes critical junctures through four elements: framing, targets, instruments, and actors/institutions. Based on two case studies, the article argues that the importance of framing and targets has been overexaggerated, and that a dynamic path will not occur unless there is also a significant change in instruments and actors/institutions. In Denmark, a climate policy agreement created a new policy direction for agriculture in which climate policy is a key component. In Norway, a climate policy agreement did not change the trajectory of sectoral policy and climate policy development has remained stagnant. Thus, differences in the critical junctures led to different policy paths.

Katrine Skagen: CICERO—Center for International Climate Research Oslo Norway
Department of Political Science University of Oslo Oslo Norway

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 왜 일부 중대 국면(critical junctures)이 정책의 실질적 변화를 이끌지 못하는지를 정책 경로의 동태성과 정태성 관점에서 두 사례를 비교해 분석한다. 덴마크에서는 기후정책 합의가 농업정책의 새로운 방향과 변화를 만들었지만, 노르웨이에서는 부문별 정책의 경로가 유지되었으며, 동태적 경로에는 프레이밍·대상뿐 아니라 정책수단과 행위자·제도의 유의미한 변화도 필요하다고 주장한다.
items.title: Why Some Critical Junctures Lead Nowhere: Exploring Dynamic and Static Policy Paths

items.abstract: Public corruption undermines government performance, erodes trust, and fuels illiberal populism. While macro-level drivers of corruption are well documented, little is known about the individual-level attitudes and beliefs associated with public servants' susceptibility to engaging in corrupt behaviour. Using a large-scale, globally stratified dataset of 18,277 public servants across 90 countries, we systematically compare a conventional regression baseline with five contemporary supervised machine learning models to predict susceptibility to corruption. Machine learning improves predictive accuracy and shows that democratic values, beliefs about competition, and attitudes towards leadership are more consistently predictive than socio-economic characteristics such as income, education, or gender. These patterns are robust across modelling approaches and analytical settings. The findings illustrate the value of transparent model comparison and machine learning for studying integrity risks, provide exploratory insights for corruption prevention strategies, and open new avenues for research on predictive modelling for public sector integrity.

Jurgen Willems: Vienna University of Economics and Business
Moritz Schmid: Vienna University of Economics and Business

items.summary_ko: 90개국 공무원 18,277명의 자료를 활용해 공직자의 부패행위 취약성을 예측할 때 기존 회귀모형과 5개 지도학습 모형의 성과를 비교했다. 머신러닝이 더 높은 예측 정확도를 보였으며, 소득·교육·성별보다 민주적 가치, 경쟁에 대한 신념, 리더십 태도가 일관되게 중요한 예측변수로 나타났다.
items.title: AI for integrity: Predicting public servants' susceptibility to corruption via supervised machine learning

items.abstract: Technology decentralisation is increasingly proposed as a key feature to build more trustworthy, accessible, and innovative digital public infrastructure, yet there is limited empirical knowledge of the actual benefits that such decentralised approaches would create from a public sector perspective. Furthermore, existing literature often relies on a linear dichotomy between data supply and demand that fails to capture the complexity of decentralised data ecosystems. This paper addresses these gaps by adopting an assemblage thinking perspective to conceptualise data platforms as complex socio-technical arrangements, and by developing a public values framework to broaden the understanding of the various outcome that data platforms can create. We apply this approach to an exploratory case study of Hamburg's Urban Data Platform (UDP). Our findings demonstrate that public value creation is not determined by technical decentralisation alone but by specific architecture-governance configurations. We illustrate that both decentral and central practices can co-occur within the same system, where the role of a leading orchestrator is crucial to drive public value creation.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 분권화된 공공부문 데이터 플랫폼이 어떤 조건에서 공공가치를 창출하는지 탐색하기 위해 조립체 관점과 공공가치 프레임워크를 적용해 함부르크 도시 데이터 플랫폼을 사례 분석했다. 분석 결과, 공공가치는 기술적 분권화만으로 결정되지 않으며, 분권적·중앙집중적 실천의 결합과 이를 조정하는 핵심 오케스트레이터를 포함한 아키텍처-거버넌스 구성에 달려 있는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Decentralisation in public sector data platforms: A pathway to enhancing public value?

items.abstract: Digital maturity frameworks have become central instruments of digital government practice, used by public sector organizations, national agencies, and international bodies to assess and steer digital transformation. Despite their widespread use, few frameworks have been subjected to rigorous psychometric testing. The scores they produce therefore rest on unverified assumptions about dimensionality, reliability, and validity. We address this gap by applying scale development methodology to a digital maturity framework deployed across more than 160 Swedish public sector organizations since 2018. Through exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis on a cleaned and multiply imputed sample from 118 organizations, we evaluate the framework's latent factor structure. The analysis yields a four-factor model that is empirically supported within the studied sample, comprising Digital Operations, Digital Legacy, Benefit Management, and Digital Development, subsumed under a second-order factor of Evaluated Digital Maturity. The results also reveal specific weaknesses that are predictable consequences of deploying an instrument developed without scale development methodology. We make two contributions. First, we provide a large-scale empirical test of a widely used digital maturity framework in the public sector, identifying its strengths and the implications of developing an instrument without psychometric grounding. Second, we adapt scale development methodology from prospective scale construction to retrospective framework evaluation, strengthening measurement in digital government research.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴 공공부문 118개 조직의 자료에 탐색적·확인적 요인분석을 적용해 기존 디지털 성숙도 프레임워크의 잠재 구조를 검증한 결과, 디지털 운영·디지털 유산·편익 관리·디지털 개발의 4요인 모형이 2차 요인인 평가된 디지털 성숙도 아래에서 지지되었다.
items.title: Digital maturity: Testing an existing framework through scale development

items.abstract: Public administration researchers traditionally approach the use of personal information in public service through the lens of direct user control, but a combination of cognitive constraints and rapid digitization has made privacy-preserving choices exceedingly difficult for citizens to manage independently. Recent research has shifted toward the notion of “data custodianship”, where public institutions serve as custodians of personal information. In a survey experiment conducted in Hong Kong ( n = 1031) and South Korea ( n = 1040), citizens evaluated their trust in various institutions serving as custodians tasked with managing biometric information for facial recognition. The findings suggest that while institutional trust can be influenced by accountability mechanisms, it is also shaped by individuals' experiences with public institutions, as well as their political orientation, social trust, and privacy preferences. Trust in one functional domain of data custodianship—such as data collection—may not carry over to others, like storage or management. Custodianship is only viable as a policy alternative to user control in data-intensive solutions if its design accounts for variation in public trust across societies, individuals, and aspects of data governance.
items.summary_ko: 홍콩과 한국 시민을 대상으로 안면인식용 생체정보의 관리 주체에 대한 신뢰를 설문 실험으로 비교한 결과, 제도적 신뢰는 책임성 장치뿐 아니라 공공기관 경험, 정치적 성향, 사회적 신뢰, 개인정보보호 선호에 의해 형성되며 수집·저장·관리 등 데이터 관리 기능별로 서로 다를 수 있었다. 따라서 데이터 수탁이 이용자 통제의 대안이 되려면 사회·개인·거버넌스 기능별 신뢰의 차이를 반영해야 한다.
items.title: Government institutions and data custodianship over personal information: Comparing citizen preferences in Hong Kong and South Korea

items.abstract: Public agencies are strategically adapting and applying digital technologies to improve their business processes and deliver greater value to society. This development has a profound impact on the agencies' institutional arrangements. While some services that the agencies offer are almost fully automated, others still require a high level of caseworker involvement. The variance in levels of automation and the coexistence of different institutional arrangements within the same agency are interesting and challenging because they contradict predictions made by both scholars and policymakers. Therefore, we present a study of three large Scandinavian public welfare agencies, utilizing document analysis supplemented by interviews with top managers and senior IT and business developers. We apply Bovens and Zouridis' (2002) typology of street-, screen-, and system-level bureaucracies as our main analytical lens, combined with Christensen and Lægreid's (2011) concepts of hybridity and sedimentation, with a socio-technical perspective in the background. We contribute to digital government and public administration research by enhancing theoretical understanding of the relationship between digital technologies, institutional arrangements and organizational trajectories. Specifically, we identify the hybrid bureaucracy as a composite, multifunctional organizational entity that encompasses several institutional arrangements simultaneously and combines aspects of street-, screen-, and system-level bureaucracies while also exhibiting its own distinct characteristics.

Karl Kristian Larsson: Simula Metropolitan Center for Digital Engineering

items.summary_ko: 디지털 기술과 제도적 배열의 관계를 규명하기 위해 세 개의 대규모 스칸디나비아 공공복지기관을 대상으로 문서분석과 고위 관리자·정보기술 및 업무개발 담당자 인터뷰를 실시했다. 분석 결과, 하나의 기관 안에서 가로·스크린·시스템 수준 관료제가 동시에 결합되는 다기능적 ‘혼합 관료제’가 나타나며, 자동화 수준과 조직 경로가 서비스별로 달라질 수 있음을 제시했다.
items.title: Hybrid bureaucracy: The relationship between digital technologies and institutional arrangements in public welfare agencies

items.abstract: Workplace surveillance is an increasingly pervasive feature of contemporary organisations, yet research overwhelmingly positions employees as its primary subjects and agents of resistance. Managers, by contrast, are implicitly framed as a homogeneous group who design, implement, and sustain surveillance. We argue that such framing ignores the complex positions managers simultaneously occupy as implementers, mediators, and potential subjects of surveillance, and further obscures situations in which they themselves are monitored, oppose surveillance, or actively engage in resisting it. Drawing on a grounded theory study of a UK local government authority, we examine how and why managers resist digitally augmented surveillance systems, revealing three interrelated resistance strategies: shielding employees from surveillance, obfuscating data to undermine system integrity, and deploying discursive practices to contest surveillance legitimacy. These strategies are simultaneously shaped by self-protective and value-driven motivations. By integrating sociotechnical systems theory with public service ethics, we develop a conceptual framework that repositions managers as agentive, morally reasoning actors navigating the contested terrain of digital control. The findings advance interdisciplinary understanding of resistance and ethics in digitally mediated public sector organisations, and respond to calls for research that recognises managerial diversity and conceptualises resistance as a situated sociotechnical process.
items.summary_ko: 영국 지방정부 기관을 대상으로 근거이론 연구를 수행해, 관리자가 디지털 감시를 어떻게 저항하는지와 그 동기를 분석했다. 관리자는 직원 보호, 데이터 은폐, 감시 정당성에 대한 담론적 이의 제기를 통해 저항했으며, 이러한 전략은 자기보호와 가치 지향적 동기에 의해 함께 형성되었다.
items.title: Managerial resistance to digital workplace surveillance in a local government authority

items.abstract: Policy documents guide technological transformations. Prior research on national artificial intelligence (AI) strategies has examined how these texts articulate governance values and principles, but how they promote identification, urgency, and action is less well understood. This gap is especially striking given arguments that national AI strategies are typically written for policy professionals. We show that these documents are also widely used as publicly accessible reference points in debates on responsible AI. Building on the narrative turn in public policy scholarship, we analyse 22 European national AI strategies. We find that AI strategies create normative entrainment through affect, constituted by three narratives: (1) establishing normative orientations by ascribing societal values to AI; (2) anchoring these orientations by invoking social emotions that embed AI in cultural identity and everyday life; and (3) promoting implementation by juxtaposing moral emotions such as fear and hope while mobilising urgency, leadership, and responsibility. By specifying how emotional narratives are woven into policy texts, this framework contributes to research on the communicative construction of AI policy and offers implications for responsible digital transformation.
items.summary_ko: 유럽 22개국의 국가 인공지능 전략을 분석해, 이 문서들이 책임 있는 AI 논의에서 감정이 결합된 서사를 통해 규범적 지향을 설정·고착하고 실행을 촉진하는 방식을 규명한다. 전략들은 AI에 사회적 가치를 부여하고 문화적 정체성과 일상에 연결하며, 두려움과 희망 같은 도덕적 감정을 활용해 긴급성·리더십·책임을 동원하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Normative entrainment through affect in national artificial intelligence strategies

items.abstract: Applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) to fraud detection in Public Procurement (PP) has become increasingly relevant due to its ability to process large volumes of data and identify suspicious patterns more efficiently than traditional methods. However, its implementation raises critical ethical concerns regarding respect for human autonomy, prevention of harm, fairness, and explainability. This study investigates these concerns through a four-phase methodology: (i) selection of ethical principles for AI in PP fraud detection, (ii) a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) on current approaches, (iii) cross-analysis and expert validation with senior auditors, and (iv) the construction of PRO-Trust, an ethics-oriented pipeline for constructing trustworthy AI-based fraud detection systems for PPs, based on the findings of the three former stages. PRO-Trust addresses five recurrent ethical challenges — system opacity, lack of user transparency, limitations in explainability tools, lack of operational oversight, and lack of strategic control — connected between tasks we specified for the construction process of AI-based technologies to fraud detection in PP, the responsible actors, and technological strategies to operationalize ethical principles. By doing so, this study contributes to the development of more trustworthy, transparent, and accountable AI-based fraud detection systems in public administration.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 공공조달 부정탐지에 AI를 적용할 때 자율성 존중, 위해 방지, 공정성, 설명가능성 등의 윤리적 우려를 어떻게 다룰 것인지 탐구한다. 윤리 원칙 선정, 체계적 문헌고찰, 선임 감사관과의 교차분석·전문가 검증을 거쳐, 불투명성·사용자 투명성 부족·설명 도구의 한계·운영 감독 부족·전략적 통제 부족에 대응하는 윤리 지향적 AI 구축 파이프라인인 PRO-Trust를 제시한다.
items.title: Trustworthy AI in public administration: The PRO-Trust pipeline for ethical fraud detection in public procurement

items.abstract: Local governments are beginning to use artificial intelligence (AI) in internal administrative work, including recruitment. In a decentralized municipality, however, a standardized AI assessment must travel between a technology vendor, central HR specialists, recruiters, and hiring managers responsible for different services. This creates a tension between representational portability and contextual adequacy. Based on a qualitative case study of a large Swedish municipality, we examine an AI interviewing system that translated candidates' open-ended responses into competency indicators and narrative summaries used in early-stage recruitment. We develop a process model of semantic reconciliation comprising five recurrent forms of work: scoping what could be delegated to the system, mapping vendor categories to municipal and occupational vocabularies, refining interpretations when role context was lost, embedding shared interpretations across a distributed organization, and composing AI reports with locally accountable human judgment. The study contributes to research on local-government AI and data governance by showing how semantic machines make evaluative information portable while requiring continuous organizational work to restore context. It also specifies practical arrangements through which municipalities can use common AI tools without allowing standardized outputs to displace role-specific knowledge or human decision authority.
items.summary_ko: 분권화된 지방정부에서 채용 AI 평가 결과가 공급업체·인사 전문가·채용 담당자·관리자 사이에서 어떻게 의미적으로 조정되는지를 질적 사례연구로 분석했다. 스웨덴 대규모 지방자치단체 사례는 위임 범위 설정, 범주 매핑, 맥락 보완, 해석의 조직 내 정착, 인간 판단과의 결합이라는 반복적 조정 작업을 통해 AI 정보의 이동성을 확보하면서도 직무 맥락과 인간의 결정 권한을 유지한다고 보여준다.
items.title: Working with semantic machines: The role of semantic reconciliation in public sector data governance

items.abstract: ABSTRACT As the digital footprint of public service expands, the need for accessible materials for individuals with disabilities grows. Public servants must consider accessibility in the creation of all materials, from websites to PDFs to audio and visual media. However, research around accessible material creation in public service has been limited. This study uses data from a 2024 survey of MPA alumni from five universities to identify their familiarity with accessible material creation, including their awareness of their own organization's policies, processes, and training. The findings reveal that respondent awareness of their own organization's practices was correlated with higher familiarity in generating accessible materials. However, many respondents did not know about their organization's practices, identifying the need for increased dialogue about this essential element of social equity and inclusion. As such, suggestions for organizations to improve their practices around accessible material creation along with ideas for continued research are shared.

Michelle Allgood: School of Politics, Public Affairs, and International Studies, University of Wyoming Laramie Wyoming USA

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 2024년 5개 대학 MPA 졸업생 설문을 통해 공공서비스 자료 접근성 제작에 대한 친숙도와 소속 기관의 관련 정책·절차·교육 인식 간의 관계를 기술적으로 분석했다. 기관의 실천에 대한 인식이 높은 응답자는 접근 가능한 자료 제작에 더 익숙했지만, 많은 응답자가 기관의 관련 실천을 알지 못해 조직 내 논의 확대의 필요성이 제기되었다.
items.title: Increasing Equitable Access in Public Service: A Descriptive Study About Accessible Materials

items.abstract: ABSTRACT After decades of expansion, liberal democracy is threatened by autocratic populists. These actors exploit widening gaps between leaders and citizens, as well as growing political polarization in the population, to consolidate executive power by undermining courts, sidelining elected assemblies, discrediting public administrators, and intimidating both opposition and the press. This alarming predicament begs the question of what enterprising role public administrators can play in curbing the rise of autocratic populism by reconnecting elected politicians with diverse and polarized population groups while fostering alignment among them. To this end, public administrators are conceptualized as bridgebuilders promoting interactive political leadership along the vertical axis of the political system; as mediators fostering agreement, accommodation, or compromise between polarized groups along the horizontal axis; and as institutional architects linking representative democracy and collaborative governance arenas. This expanded role of public administrators as democratic guardians and protagonists raises important questions regarding its legitimacy.

Eva Sørensen: Department of Social Sciences and Business Roskilde University Roskilde Denmark
Jacob Torfing: Department of Social Sciences and Business Roskilde University Roskilde Denmark

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 권위주의적 포퓰리즘의 부상에 대응해 공공관리자가 선출 정치인과 다양한·양극화된 시민집단을 연결하고, 집단 간 합의와 타협을 촉진하며, 대표민주주의와 협력적 거버넌스를 연계하는 역할을 할 수 있는지 개념화한다. 공공관리자를 민주주의의 수호자이자 행위자로 확장하는 것이 정당한지에 관한 문제도 제기한다.

items.abstract: Policy alienation research highlights how public professionals experience powerlessness and meaninglessness when policies misalign with their professional values and work context. While previous research conceptualizes policy alienation as a largely static condition, this article advances a processual understanding by examining how organizational context shapes its development. Drawing on interviews with nurses working in Swedish prisons—a paradigmatic case of misalignment between care and punishment—the study reveals that both expected (tactical powerlessness) and novel (spatial limitation) patterns of alienation coexist with processes that counteract it. Nurses describe how they re-connect with their primary policy domain through considerable work autonomy, trust-based managerial distance, and supportive professional networks. These findings extend policy alienation theory by demonstrating how misaligned organizational environments can generate both alienating and re-connecting processes. The study thus advances understanding of policy alienation as a dynamic, context-mediated phenomenon with important implications for public administration practice.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴 교도소 간호사 인터뷰를 통해, 돌봄과 처벌이 충돌하는 조직 맥락에서 정책 소외가 어떻게 형성되고 완화되는지 분석했다. 간호사들은 전술적 무력감과 공간적 제약을 경험했지만, 높은 업무 자율성·신뢰에 기반한 관리적 거리·전문직 네트워크를 통해 본래의 정책 영역과 다시 연결되었다.
items.title: Autonomy in Prison: Street-Level Bureaucrats Re-Connecting with Their Purpose

items.abstract: The 2008 recession forced U.S. state governments to make rapid personnel and fiscal decisions under austerity. Classic cutback management work catalogues managerial options and personnel stability research links stability to performance, but there is little work to date connecting these fields. This study begins to do so by examining changes in state employment in the wake of the 2008 recession. We conceptualize the components of Kingdon’s Multiple Streams Framework as competing policy influences to assess how state fiscal and organizational conditions shape personnel stability in the following years. Using a state-level panel of by-department employment and a battery of factors that influence the policy process, we estimate two-way fixed-effects models relating Political Competition, Institutional Influence, Policymaking Capacity, and Intragovernmental Conflict indices to two outcomes: year-to-year change in total employment and year-to-year variance in the distribution of jobs across departments. We find significant effects of policymaking capacity on both outcomes. Substantively, the relative strength of policymaking does not prevent recession-era workforce contraction, but it is associated with lower variance in cross-department personnel shifts, suggesting more coordinated adjustments that reduce disruption to routines, coordination, and the distribution of expertise.
items.summary_ko: 2008년 경기침체 이후 미국 주정부의 인력 안정성이 어떻게 형성되는지, 재정·조직 조건과 정책과정 요인이 고용 규모 및 부처 간 인력 재배치에 어떤 영향을 미치는지를 주정부 부처별 패널의 이원 고정효과 모형으로 분석했다. 정책형성 역량은 경기침체기의 인력 감소를 막지는 못했지만, 부처 간 인력 이동의 변동성을 낮춰 보다 조정된 인력 조정을 보이는 것과 관련됐다.
items.title: Managing Through Crisis: Understanding Personnel Stability in the States During Economic Downturns

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Administrative burden represents political choices embedded in policy design that affect how people perceive and experience government. While policymakers frequently invoke fraud prevention to justify imposing burdens in welfare programs, this rhetoric embodies an unacknowledged normative judgment about the relative costs of fraud and abuse versus program exclusion for eligible beneficiaries. This study quantifies this access–fraud trade‐off in means‐tested social welfare programs through a contingent valuation experiment ( N = 2250). We find that respondents were willing to accept approximately 192 ineligible recipients receiving benefits in exchange for 1000 eligible beneficiaries not being excluded due to administrative burdens. While we find no direct evidence that psychological distance (i.e., randomized exposure to “welfare” vs. specific programs) affects this trade‐off across the full sample, political affiliation is a significant moderator in our exploratory analysis. Unlike Democrats/Independents, Republicans demonstrate substantially lower tolerance for potential fraud when evaluating abstract “welfare” compared to specific programs like unemployment insurance. Experience with means‐tested welfare programs, which reduces psychological distance, has a similar moderating effect. These findings extend construal level theory to administrative burden preferences and contribute to the policy implementation literature by quantifying the access–fraud trade‐off—a metric largely absent from academic and policy discussions despite its importance for program legitimacy.

Elizabeth Bell: LBJ School of Public Affairs The University of Texas at Austin Austin Texas USA
Sebastian Jilke: McCourt School of Public Policy Georgetown University Washington DC USA

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 선별적 사회복지 프로그램에서 행정적 부담으로 인한 자격 있는 수급자의 배제와 부적격 수급자의 부정수급 사이의 상충관계를 어떻게 평가하는지 묻고, 2,250명을 대상으로 한 조건부 가치평가 설문실험으로 이를 측정했다. 응답자들은 적격자 1,000명의 배제를 막기 위해 약 192명의 부적격 수급자가 급여를 받는 것을 수용했으며, 전체 표본에서는 심리적 거리의 직접 효과가 나타나지 않았지만 정당 소속과 복지 경험에 따라 부정수급 허용도가 달라졌다.
items.title: Administrative Burden and the Access–Fraud Trade‐Off

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines how governments navigate policy legitimacy during crises through three distinct discursive processes: legitimization, delegitimization, and blame avoidance. Using a sequential mixed‐methods design, the study analyzes Denmark's decision to cull all mink during the COVID‐19 pandemic. The quantitative analysis of 947 newspaper articles indicates that while both periods were characterized by negative coverage, the force and target of delegitimization discourses shifted dramatically from questioning policy outcomes to scrutinizing procedural legitimacy. The qualitative analysis illustrates how, initially, the government successfully legitimized the mink culling through appeals to scientific authority, with broad political and public support. However, following legal and scientific challenges, policy legitimacy collapsed, coinciding with a strategic pivot from policy justification to blame avoidance. The analysis illustrates that legitimization and blame avoidance can be treated as analytically distinct discursive strategies: legitimization proactively affirms policy necessity through evidence and legal appeals, while blame avoidance reactively deflects responsibility through reframing, buck‐passing, and scapegoating. The policy persisted despite sustained delegitimization, initially aided by legitimization efforts and later by blame avoidance strategies. The findings advance policy theory by clarifying how discursive strategies evolve across a policy's lifecycle and offer a framework applicable to other high‐salience domains such as climate emergencies and migration policies.

Evangelia Petridou: Department of Humanities and Social Sciences Mid Sweden University Östersund Sweden
Jörgen Sparf: Department of Humanities and Social Sciences Mid Sweden University Östersund Sweden
Olivier Rubin: Department of Social Sciences and Business Roskilde University Roskilde Denmark
Olov Hemmingsson: Department of Humanities and Social Sciences Mid Sweden University Östersund Sweden

items.summary_ko: 덴마크의 코로나19 밍크 전량 살처분 위기에서 정부가 정당화·정당성 훼손·책임회피의 담론 전략을 어떻게 전환했는지를 순차 혼합방법으로 분석했다. 신문 기사 947건과 질적 분석 결과, 초기에는 과학적 권위와 법적 호소로 정책을 정당화했지만 법적·과학적 도전 이후 절차적 정당성에 대한 비판이 커지자 책임회피로 전환했으며, 정책은 이러한 전략 속에서 지속되었다.
items.title: From Policy Legitimization to Blame Avoidance—Discursive Strategies During Denmark's Mink Culling Crisis

items.abstract: Abstract Women consistently report lower levels of political interest and political ambition than men. Studies have examined how women politicians as role models can make women more politically engaged, but studies have not typically examined additional shared identities beyond gender. I propose that women politicians with whom women share additional identities will be perceived as more relatable and inspiring and, consequently, have stronger role model effects on women’s political engagement. Through a conjoint experiment (Study 1), I find that having additional shared identities with a woman politician increases perceptions of her as relatable and inspiring. However, a survey experiment with novel video treatments depicting a woman politician’s story (Study 2) did not produce positive role model effects on women’s political interest, internal political efficacy, or nascent political ambition – regardless of additional shared racial and partisan identity with the woman politician. Moreover, the video treatment had remarkably different effects across White and Black women, regardless of additional shared racial and partisan identity. An observational analysis (Study 3) replicates the finding that additional shared racial and partisan identity with women political representatives is not systematically correlated with higher levels of political interest. These findings carry important implications for understanding women politicians’ role model effects and the potential of role models to increase women’s political engagement.
items.summary_ko: 여성 정치인의 성별 외 추가 공유 정체성이 여성의 정치 참여에 미치는 역할모델 효과를 검토하기 위해 컨조인트 실험, 동영상 설문 실험, 관찰분석을 실시했다. 추가 공유 정체성은 정치인을 더 친근하고 영감을 주는 인물로 인식하게 했지만, 정치적 관심·내적 정치효능감·초기 정치적 야망을 높이는 효과는 확인되지 않았으며 백인 여성과 흑인 여성 간 처치 효과도 달랐다.
items.title: Women Politicians’ Role Model Effects: The Influence of Shared Identities Beyond Gender

items.abstract: This study examines how tax and expenditure competition, two distinct yet complementary mechanisms of horizontal fiscal governance, affect local debt management in China’s local government bond market, using a two-stage least squares (2SLS) approach. It further investigates the moderating role of intergovernmental transfers intended to promote fiscal stabilization and equalization. Drawing on panel data from 272 prefecture-level cities between 2010 and 2018, the results indicate that intensified tax and expenditure competition significantly increases local government debt, while intergovernmental transfers reduce direct borrowing needs through a substitution effect but exacerbate debt accumulation under fiscal competitive pressure by weakening local fiscal discipline. The study contributes to the public management and performance literature by highlighting how fiscal governance can distort local managerial incentives and undermine local debt management.
items.summary_ko: 중국 지방정부 채권시장에서 조세 경쟁과 지출 경쟁이 지방정부 부채 관리에 미치는 영향을 2010~2018년 272개 지급시 패널자료와 2단계 최소제곱법(2SLS)으로 분석하고, 정부 간 이전의 조절 역할을 검토했다. 조세·지출 경쟁은 지방정부 부채를 유의하게 늘렸으며, 정부 간 이전은 대체효과로 직접 차입 수요를 줄이지만 재정 경쟁 상황에서는 재정 규율을 약화해 부채 누적을 심화시켰다.
items.title: Fiscal Competition, Intergovernmental Transfer, and Local Debt Management

items.abstract: Despite growing attention to culture in public administration responses to crisis events, culture is often treated as background context rather than as part of the administrative infrastructure through which governance occurs. This article extends the theory of administrative capacity by arguing that culture can function as administrative infrastructure in post-disaster public management. Using qualitative interviews with community members, grassroots organizers, and nonprofit leaders in Maui, as well as public forum data collected within 12 months of the 2023 Maui wildfires, we examine how culture shaped legitimacy, coordination, authority, and recovery capacity in the aftermath of disaster. Findings show that culturally grounded relationships to land, water, community, and history shaped how residents interpreted formal recovery efforts, mobilized outside government systems, asserted authority over rebuilding, and defined what recovery should mean. We develop a culture as administrative infrastructure framework that shows how culturally grounded forms of authority, resistance, and place-based knowledge reveal the limits of culturally neutral administrative systems. The article contributes to public administration theory by showing that administrative capacity is not only built through agencies, resources, procedures, and networks, but also through culturally embedded systems of legitimacy, knowledge, authority, and collective care.

Christa L. Remington: School of Public Affairs University of South Florida, University of South Florida
Lauren Azevedo: Department of Political Science and Public Administration, University of North Carolina at Charlotte
Ratna B. Dougherty: School of Public Affairs University of South Florida, University of South Florida
