items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 마우이 산불 이후 문화가 재난 대응과 회복의 행정 인프라로 어떻게 작동했는지를 질적 인터뷰와 12개월 이내의 공청회 자료로 분석했다. 토지·물·공동체·역사에 대한 문화적으로 뿌리내린 관계가 공식 회복 노력의 정당성 해석, 외부 정부체계 동원, 재건 권위의 주장, 회복의 의미 정의를 형성했으며, 행정 역량이 기관·자원·절차·네트워크뿐 아니라 문화적으로 내재된 정당성·지식·권위·집합적 돌봄에도 기반함을 보였다.
items.title: Culture as Administrative Infrastructure: Crisis Governance and Community Recovery After the Maui Wildfires

items.abstract: What do citizens believe to be guiding motives behind the increasing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in government, and how are these beliefs related to AI acceptance? Drawing on moral judgment theory, the present article argues that the presumed intentions behind AI use matter for citizens’ evaluations of this use. It studies how citizens’ beliefs about public values motives are associated with AI acceptance across four types of AI use that involve different citizen-state relationships. The analysis uses survey data from 2072 respondents in Germany and the Netherlands and finds that that acceptance of AI use hinges on whether citizens believe that government AI adoption is guided by performance-related values – efficiency, effectiveness, productivity. Beliefs about procedure-related public values motives – impartiality, equal treatment, transparency – do not matter. The findings have implications for how to engender public support for government AI use and for understanding imbalances in public values driving AI adoption.
items.journal: The American Review of Public Administration
items.summary_ko: 독일과 네덜란드 시민 2,072명을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시해, 정부의 AI 도입을 이끄는 동기에 대한 인식이 시민의 AI 활용 수용과 어떻게 관련되는지 네 가지 AI 활용 유형별로 분석했다. 시민이 정부 AI 도입의 동기를 효율성·효과성·생산성 같은 성과 관련 가치로 인식할 때 수용성이 높아졌지만, 공정성·동등대우·투명성 같은 절차 관련 가치에 대한 인식은 유의한 관련이 없었다.
items.title: Why Government Turns to AI – What Citizens Believe and How it Matters. Survey Evidence from Germany and the Netherlands

items.abstract: Abstract Many political surveys rely on post-stratification, raking or related weighting adjustments to align respondents with the target population. But when respondents differ from nonrespondents on the outcome itself (nonignorable nonresponse), these adjustments can fail, introducing bias even into basic descriptives. We provide a practical method that corrects for nonignorable nonresponse by leveraging response-propensity proxies (e.g., a respondent’s rating of the interview or interviewer-coded cooperativeness) observed among respondents to extrapolate toward nonrespondents, while directly integrating observable covariates and retaining the benefits of post-stratification with known population shares. The method generalizes the variable-response-propensity framework of Peress (2010) from binary to ordinal outcomes, which are widely used to measure trust, satisfaction and policy attitudes. The resulting estimator is computed by maximum likelihood and implemented in a compact R routine that handles both ordinal and binary outcomes. Using the 2024 American National Election Study, we show that accounting for nonignorable nonresponse produces substantively meaningful shifts for life satisfaction (estimated latent correlation ρ ≈ 0.47 $\rho \approx 0.47$ rho almost equals 0.47 ), while yielding only modest changes for retrospective economic evaluations ( ρ ≈ 0.14 $\rho \approx 0.14$ rho almost equals 0.14 ), highlighting when nonignorable nonresponse substantively affects survey estimates.

Jozef Michal Mintal: Matej Bel University in Banská Bystrica
Lukáš Lafférs: Matej Bel University in Banská Bystrica

items.summary_ko: 비순응답자가 응답자와 결과변수에서 다를 수 있는 상황에서, 응답자에게 관측된 응답성향 대리변수와 공변량 및 사후층화 정보를 통합해 순서형 조사자료의 비무작위 응답편향을 보정하는 방법을 제시한다. 2024년 미국선거연구 자료에 적용한 결과, 삶의 만족도에서는 추정치가 실질적으로 변했지만 회고적 경제평가에서는 변화가 비교적 작았다.
items.title: Correcting for Nonignorable Nonresponse Bias in Ordinal Observational Survey Data

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Few regulatory reforms are as celebrated or emulated as the performance measurement system of Sunnyvale, California, which inspired the Government Performance and Results Act of 1993 and countless other national and local efforts. This study presents the first longitudinal, cross‐programmatic analysis of a performance measurement system, introducing a digital archival approach to analyze 152 performance indicators across 35,000 pages of documents from 1984 to 2023, supplemented with interviews of key stakeholders. Even if Sunnyvale's system initially functioned as an exemplar of performance‐based decision‐making, it deteriorated with weakened commitment and, more importantly, sustained significant implementation costs while its benefits reduced over time. The findings illustrate three core trade‐offs for performance measurement systems: measuring what matters (the “quantity‐quality” tradeoff); ensuring continuity while allowing for adaptation (the “continuity‐flexibility” tradeoff); and ensuring accountability without having implementation detract from productivity (the “accountability‐productivity” tradeoff).

Daniel E. Ho: Stanford Law School Stanford California USA
Derek Ouyang: Stanford Law School Stanford California USA
Joyce Kasing Tagal: Stanford Law School Stanford California USA

items.summary_ko: 써니베일의 성과측정 체계가 의사결정의 모범으로 기능했는지, 그리고 장기간 어떻게 변화했는지를 1984~2023년 3만 5,000쪽의 문서와 152개 지표에 대한 디지털 기록 분석 및 핵심 관계자 인터뷰로 추적했다. 초기에는 성과기반 의사결정을 지원했지만, 헌신 약화와 지속적인 실행비용으로 체계의 편익이 감소했으며, 연구는 중요사항 측정의 양-질, 연속성-유연성, 책무성-생산성 간 상충을 제시한다.
items.title: The Practice and Origins of Performance Measurement: Assessing the Sunnyvale Model, 1984–2023

items.abstract: Contemporary governance faces mounting environmental challenges, straining governmental capacity to achieve policy objectives. We extend Wu et al.'s policy capacity framework, arguing that systemic political capacity is grounded in political trust, itself conditioned by legitimacy. Applying this framework to proactive conservation under the U.S. Endangered Species Act, we analyze the failure of Colorado’s sage-grouse initiative. Findings suggest contested legitimacy surrounding coercive federal intervention diminished political trust in regulatory authority, constraining systemic political capacity and limiting development of enforceable conservation arrangements satisfying federal requirements. The analysis has broader implications for collaborative governance dependent on credible regulatory authority.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 정치적 신뢰와 정당성에 기반한 체계적 정치역량이 미국 멸종위기종보호법에 따른 선제적 보전에서 어떻게 작용하는지 콜로라도 세이지그라우스 사례로 분석한다. 강제적 연방 개입의 정당성을 둘러싼 갈등이 규제 권위에 대한 정치적 신뢰를 약화시켜, 연방 요건을 충족하는 집행 가능한 보전 합의의 형성을 제약한 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Systemic Political Capacity and Regulatory Failure: Evidence From Proactive Conservation Under the Endangered Species Act

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Not all policy change is expansive, yet non‐expansive trajectories remain underexamined. This article introduces the concept of dead ends: a stage of the policy process in which initiatives cease to develop or be implemented in their existing form, structuring subsequent policy change such as rollback, redirection, or termination. To examine such trajectories, the article combines large‐scale analysis of 27,103 policy experiments announced in the People's Republic of China between 2013 and 2018 with qualitative case studies. The findings suggest that a substantial majority—up to 90%—of experiments reach dead ends. These dead ends are associated with leadership turnover, policy complexity, and misalignment with bureaucratic incentives and socio‐economic conditions. Altogether, the article provides new frameworks for understanding alternative directions of policy change. In doing so, it also sheds new light on the adaptive capacity and structural constraints of China's governance system.

Vincent Brussee: Faculty of Humanities Leiden University Leiden the Netherlands

items.summary_ko: 중국의 정책 실험이 확장되지 않는 경로와 그 이후의 정책 변화를 어떻게 설명할 수 있는지 분석하기 위해, 2013~2018년에 발표된 정책 실험 27,103건의 대규모 분석과 질적 사례연구를 결합했다. 분석 결과 최대 90%의 실험이 ‘막다른 길’에 도달했으며, 이는 지도자 교체, 정책 복잡성, 관료적 유인 및 사회경제적 조건과의 불일치와 관련되어 롤백·전환·종료 같은 후속 변화를 구조화했다.
items.title: Dead Ends and Policy Change in Chinese Experimental Governance

items.abstract: Digital election platforms increasingly mediate administrative performance, transparency, and accountability in electoral governance. Examining Indonesia’s regional elections, this study analyzes how such platforms shape administrative performance and redistribute accountability. A qualitative design combining documentary analysis, platform-artifact analysis, and documentary process tracing compares three centrally governed platforms operated by Indonesia’s General Elections Commission: Sidalih for voter registration, Silon for candidate nomination, and Sirekap for results reporting. Findings show that these platforms operate as performance regimes, translating electoral work into visible signals such as synchronization status, validation outcomes, upload completion, dashboard display, correction records, and verification pathways. Platform architecture simultaneously centralizes operational control over data structures, validation rules, user permissions, publication logic, and correction procedures, while subnational offices retain implementation responsibility. Such arrangements create an accountability squeeze: implementing units become increasingly visible as responsible actors without commensurate control over technical conditions shaping performance outcomes. By linking platform-mediated visibility to asymmetries in control, this study shows how digital transparency can strengthen administrative legibility while redistributing responsibility, risk, and authority across organizational levels.

Ahmad Nur Hidayat: Department of Public Administration, Faculty of Social and Political Science, Universitas Padjadjaran
Nina Karlina: Department of Public Administration, Faculty of Social and Political Science, Universitas Padjadjaran
R. Widya Setiabudi Sumadinata: Department of Public Administration, Faculty of Social and Political Science, Universitas Padjadjaran
Ramadhan Pancasilawan: Department of Public Administration, Faculty of Social and Political Science, Universitas Padjadjaran

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 인도네시아 지방선거에서 중앙 운영 디지털 플랫폼이 행정성과와 책임성을 어떻게 형성·재분배하는지 문서·플랫폼 산출물 분석과 과정추적을 통해 분석했다. Sidalih·Silon·Sirekap은 업무를 가시적 성과 신호로 전환하면서 데이터 구조와 검증·수정 절차를 중앙집중화해, 통제권이 제한된 지방 집행기관에 책임과 위험을 집중시키는 ‘책임성 압박’을 সৃষ্টি했다.
items.title: Digital Election Platforms, Administrative Performance, and the Accountability Squeeze: Recentralization by Design in Indonesia’s Regional Elections

items.abstract: MIchael Young satirizes a global society envisaged for the 21st century, in which all job appointments and rewards are determined solely by merit. Notable advancements in intelligence and ability testing were assumed to enable accurate performance projections and effective educational monitoring. Consequently, the influence of social obstacles such as socioeconomic class, family, race, and religion would be significantly mitigated. The system, however, has shifted to produce winners and losers, a phenomenon Sandel characterizes as hubris . We argue that this hubris stems from meritocracy’s roots in bureaucracy, grounded in a rationalized myth.

Akhil Jain: Indian Institute of Management, Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India
Nidhi Mishra: XLRI Xavier School of Management, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, India
Rajalaxmi Kamath: Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
Teena Bharti: Indian Institute of Management, Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India
Vinita S. Sahay: Indian Institute of Management, Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India

items.summary_ko: 본 논문은 메리토크라시가 능력에 따른 공정한 배분이라는 이상에서 출발했지만, 관료제에 뿌리를 둔 합리화된 신화로 인해 승자와 패자를 만들어내는 허브리스로 변질되는 과정을 개념적으로 논의한다.
items.title: Understanding Meritocracy: From an Imagination of ‘Ideal’ to Producing ‘Myth’ and Beyond

items.abstract: Abstract Multi‐site/context studies have become popular strategies to address the most common and challenging external validity concerns about contexts. Under such studies, scholars conduct causal studies in each site and evaluate whether findings generalize across sites. Despite the potential, there has been little guidance on the fundamental research design question—how should we select sites for external validity? Existing approaches have challenges: random sampling of sites is often infeasible, while the current practice of purposive sampling is suboptimal without statistical guarantees. We propose synthetic purposive sampling (SPS), which optimally selects diverse sites for external validity. SPS combines ideas of purposive sampling and the synthetic control method—it selects diverse sites such that nonselected sites are well approximated by the weighted average of the selected sites. We illustrate its general applicability using both experimental and observational studies. Overall, this paper offers a new statistical foundation to design multisite studies for external validity.

Diana Da In Lee: Center for the Study of Democratic Institutions Vanderbilt University Nashville Tennessee USA
Naoki Egami: Department of Political Science and Statistics and Data Science Center Massachusetts Institute of Technology Cambridge Massachusetts USA

items.summary_ko: 다기관 연구에서 외적 타당성을 확보하기 위한 사이트 선택 방법을 어떻게 설계할 것인지 묻고, 합성통제 방법과 목적표집을 결합한 합성 목적표집(SPS)을 제안한다. SPS는 선택되지 않은 사이트를 선택된 사이트의 가중평균으로 잘 근사하도록 다양성이 높은 사이트를 최적으로 선정하며, 실험·관찰 연구를 통해 일반적 적용 가능성을 보인다.
items.title: Designing multi‐site studies for external validity: Site selection via synthetic purposive sampling

items.abstract: The ultimate objective of performance measurement is to enhance organizational performance, with the use of performance information often regarded as a proxy for its effectiveness. However, there remains a limited understanding of the mechanisms through which performance information use is associated with actual performance improvements within the nonprofit sector. Drawing on survey data from 134 California-based nonprofits, this study finds that the use of performance information is positively associated with organizational performance, with these associations operating through goal clarity, developmental culture, and organizational capacity. The study advances theoretical understanding by developing and testing an integrated model showing that the relationship between performance information use and performance improvement is primarily indirect and operates through internal organizational processes. By revealing these underlying mechanisms, the findings also provide practical insights for nonprofit leaders seeking to optimize performance measurement practices.

Chongmyoung Lee: California State University at Los Angeles

items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 비영리조직에서 성과정보 활용이 실제 조직성과와 어떤 관련을 맺는지, 그리고 그 메커니즘이 무엇인지 검토했다. 캘리포니아 비영리조직 134곳의 설문자료를 분석한 결과, 성과정보 활용은 조직성과와 긍정적으로 관련되었으며, 이 관계는 목표 명확성, 발전적 조직문화, 조직역량을 통해 주로 간접적으로 나타났다.
items.title: Exploring the Associations Between Performance Information Use and Nonprofit Performance: The Mediating Role of Goal Clarity, Developmental Culture, and Organizational Capacity

items.abstract: This study examines how bureaucrats enact functionalization reform under conditions of unfinished reform, conceptualized as instrumental incompleteness in which structural change outpaces the development of operational HR infrastructures. Drawing on a comparative qualitative case study across four Indonesian local government jurisdictions, the study identifies a common mechanism through which an HR-instrument void generates operational ambiguity, prompting collective sensemaking and adaptive coordination. Cross-case comparison shows that these mechanisms follow different reform trajectories according to organizational support conditions, comprising fiscal capacity, administrative support, and reform facilitation. Rather than fiscal capacity alone, the combined configuration of these conditions explains why some jurisdictions move toward partial formalization of functional roles while others continue to rely on hierarchical coordination. The study contributes by conceptualizing unfinished reform as instrumental incompleteness and by integrating structural reform, operational HR infrastructures, and bureaucratic sensemaking into a comparative mechanism-based explanation of reform enactment in decentralized public administration.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 구조적 변화가 운영적 인사관리 인프라의 발전을 앞서는 ‘도구적 불완전성’ 상황에서 지방 관료들이 기능화를 어떻게 실행하는지, 인도네시아 4개 지방정부의 비교 질적 사례연구로 분석한다. 인사 도구의 공백은 운영상 모호성을 낳고 집단적 의미형성과 적응적 조정을 촉발하며, 재정역량만이 아니라 행정지원과 개혁 촉진을 포함한 조직지원 조건의 결합에 따라 일부 지역은 기능직 역할을 부분적으로 공식화하는 반면 다른 지역은 위계적 조정에 계속 의존하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Functionalization Without Instruments: How Local Bureaucrats Make Sense of Unfinished Reform While Managing Public Services

items.abstract: This article examines the conditions under which USAID awards contracts to NGOs within an increasingly marketized foreign aid system. Using procurement data on USAID contracts awarded between 2008 and 2023, as well as World Bank data, I employ logistic regression to identify the macro-level factors associated with NGO selection as contractors. Results suggest that NGO selection is primarily shaped by competitive pressures, information asymmetries, and task characteristics. Greater competition reduces the likelihood of NGO selection, while prior contracting experience is associated with for-profit rather than NGO selection. Moreover, NGOs are more likely to be selected for human service projects, where outcomes are difficult to measure and verify. In contrast, infrastructure and economic development contracts predominantly favor for-profit firms. Overall, these findings suggest that although U.S. foreign assistance is oriented toward market principles, NGOs persist in sectors where their organizational characteristics and mission orientation align with USAID’s priorities.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 시장화된 대외원조 체계에서 USAID가 어떤 조건에서 NGO를 계약자로 선정하는지 분석하기 위해 2008~2023년 USAID 계약·세계은행 자료에 로지스틱 회귀분석을 적용했다. 경쟁이 클수록 NGO 선정 가능성은 낮아지고, NGO는 측정·검증이 어려운 인적 서비스 사업에서 상대적으로 더 많이 선정되는 반면, 인프라·경제개발 계약은 영리기업을 선호하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: NGO Selection in a Marketized Foreign Aid System: Evidence from USAID Contracts

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This study examines the association between ethnoracial characteristics (ethnoracial self‐identification, speaking an Indigenous language, and skin tone) and police abuse within Mexico's criminal justice system, drawing on street‐level bureaucracy frameworks. Using data from the 2021 National Survey of Persons Deprived of Liberty (ENPOL in Spanish), we analyze whether ethnoracial traits are conditionally associated with reported experiences of police abuse. Logistic regression models suggest that Afro‐Mexican or Afro‐descendant and Indigenous persons have higher odds of reporting abuse, supporting existing literature on discrimination and policing. Unexpectedly, speaking an Indigenous language and having darker skin tones were associated with lower reported abuse, suggesting a complex relationship that merits further examination. These results underscore the need to incorporate ethnoracial variables into the study of police behavior and public administration in Mexico, while informing public policies aimed at preventing and addressing police abuse to strengthen accountability within the criminal justice system.

Arturo Luna Cancino: División de Administración Pública Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas Ciudad de México Mexico
Javier Reyes‐Martínez: División de Administración Pública Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas (Región Centro) Aguascalientes Mexico

items.summary_ko: 멕시코 형사사법체계에서 민족·인종적 특성과 경찰 학대 신고 경험의 연관성을 2021년 수감자 전국조사 자료와 로지스틱 회귀모형으로 분석했다. 아프리카계·아프리카계 후손 및 원주민은 학대 신고 오즈가 높았지만, 원주민 언어 사용과 어두운 피부색은 낮은 신고와 연관되어 복합적인 양상이 나타났다.
items.title: Ethnoracial Characteristics and Police Abuse Within Mexico's Criminal Justice System

items.abstract: ABSTRACT How do policy entrepreneurs change policy when politicians are not directly involved in the process? While public policy scholars have examined the conditions under which politicians refrain from direct engagement in policy design, they have paid less attention to the strategies policy entrepreneurs employ in the absence of political actors. Drawing on textual analysis and 30 in‐depth interviews with members of the “Roim Rachok” (“Looking Ahead”) program, which facilitates the inclusion of individuals on the autism spectrum in the Israel Defense Forces as a case study, we addressed this lacuna by exploring how policy entrepreneurs independently advance policy change. The findings suggest that the policy entrepreneurs operated through institutionalized collaborative networks. They also leveraged Israel's security challenges as a structured framework for promoting their new policy. In addition, they created an organizational infrastructure. Finally, they focused on establishing trust with the security organizations with whom they collaborated.
items.summary_ko: 정치인이 정책 과정에 직접 관여하지 않을 때 정책기업가가 어떻게 정책 변화를 추진하는지 탐구하기 위해, 이스라엘군 내 자폐 스펙트럼 개인의 포용을 지원하는 ‘로임 라촉’ 프로그램을 사례로 텍스트 분석과 30건의 심층 인터뷰를 실시했다. 정책기업가들은 제도화된 협력 네트워크, 안보 위기를 활용한 정책 틀, 조직 인프라 구축, 안보 조직과의 신뢰 형성을 통해 독자적으로 정책 변화를 진전시켰다.
items.title: Policy Entrepreneurs and Policy Change When Politicians Are Absent: The Inclusion of Autistic Individuals in Armed Forces

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The moral decision‐making and behavior of politicians is influenced by the distinctive and characteristic attributes of political office. This literature review analyzes 80 articles from public administration, political science and related disciplines to systematically map these attributes and their underlying mechanisms. This study identifies six categories of attributes of political office that relate to moral decision‐making and behavior: political system design, political role, relations to societal actors, legal and regulatory measures, political cycle, and some general attributes such as the size of the political institution. Interestingly, existing research focuses mostly on unethical behavior, creating white spots in our understanding of how the attributes of political office shape individual and collective processes of moral decision‐making and behavior more generally. We conclude with an agenda for future research that advocates for more targeted research of the sociopsychological aspects that shape the moral decision‐making and behavior of politicians across their different roles.

Koen Migchelbrink: Department of Public Administration and Sociology Erasmus University Rotterdam Rotterdam the Netherlands
Leonie Heres: Department of Public Administration and Sociology Erasmus University Rotterdam Rotterdam the Netherlands
Manon Koopman: Department of Public Administration and Sociology Erasmus University Rotterdam Rotterdam the Netherlands

items.summary_ko: 정치적 직위의 어떤 속성이 정치인의 도덕적 의사결정과 행동에 영향을 미치는지 파악하기 위해 행정학·정치학 등 관련 분야의 80편을 체계적으로 검토했다. 정치체계 설계, 정치적 역할, 사회 행위자와의 관계, 법·규제 조치, 정치 주기, 정치기관 규모 등 여섯 범주의 속성이 관련되지만, 기존 연구는 비윤리적 행동에 치우쳐 전반적인 도덕적 의사결정 과정에 대한 이해에는 공백이 있는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Why Politicians Misbehave: A Systematic Review of How Attributes of Political Office Affect Moral Decision‐Making and Behavior

items.abstract: The paper explores the performance-measurement systems (PMSs) used in the provision of prison services (and their non-human agent role) to reflect on: the role PMSs play in inter-organisational relationships; the boundary objects that connect human and non-human actors across inter-organisational levels; and what affordances such connections generate. The study focuses on the English prison sector, drawing on document analysis and interviews. The findings show that PMSs represent both active non-human agents and boundary objects. The positioning of the actors involved can be seen as a second-order boundary object. Moreover, PMSs can generate affordances that go beyond the initially-intended purposes.
items.summary_ko: 영국 교도소 서비스 제공에서 성과측정시스템(PMS)이 조직 간 관계와 인간·비인간 행위자를 연결하는 경계 객체로 어떻게 작동하는지 문서분석과 인터뷰로 탐색했다. PMS는 능동적 비인간 행위자이자 경계 객체로 기능하며, 행위자들의 위치 설정은 2차 경계 객체로 나타나고, 이러한 연결은 당초 의도된 목적을 넘어서는 가능성을 생성했다.
items.title: Performance-measurement systems as actors and boundary objects: a sociomaterial perspective to the provision of prison services

items.title: Bounded Rationality and Public Policy: From Target Groups’ Behavior to Policymakers’ Constraints

items.summary_ko: 이 서평은 Edoardo Ongaro의 저서가 공공행정의 철학적 가정과 철학·공공행정 간 탐구 방향을 어떻게 제시하는지 검토한다. 초록에 제시된 범위에서는 구체적 연구질문이나 분석 결과는 확인되지 않는다.
items.title: Connecting Philosophy and Public Administration: Directions of Inquiry—A Review

items.abstract: The idea of accountability has shaped public institutions across multiple countries, impacting how institutions are designed and governance is executed. In the public administration domain, it has been studied from a variety of disciplinary perspectives; however, the development of the field remains fragmented across many domains. The fragmentation is not just attributed to the domain of conception and its subsequent development but also the origins and adoption of accountability in practice. To understand this, we explore the intellectual structure of accountability literature. Using the PRISMA framework, we reviewed the literature in public administration and identified 81 peer-reviewed articles influencing the scholarship of the domain. Further, building on this literature, we conducted the citation and co-citation analysis for understanding the intellectual structure of the domain. The findings reveal the way in which managerial reforms, institutional norms, and democratic values have collectively influenced present-day accountability conception and theory.
items.summary_ko: 공공행정의 책무성 문헌이 어떻게 형성되고 통합되어 왔는지를 규명하기 위해 PRISMA에 따라 동 분야의 동료심사 논문 81편을 검토하고 인용·공인용 분석을 실시했다. 분석 결과, 현재의 책무성 개념과 이론은 관리개혁, 제도적 규범, 민주적 가치의 상호 영향 속에서 형성된 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Accountability in Public Administration: A Review and Conceptual Integration

items.abstract: Abstract Based on resource dependence theory, this article theorizes why government agencies adopt citizen proposals in participatory budgeting. Agencies depend on the executive budget office and the legislature for budget approval, which makes them face uncertainty in securing budgets from these political principals. In this context, agencies can adopt citizen proposals to present their requests as reflecting citizen demands, thereby increasing the probability of approval. Building on this logic, this study argues that the greater the uncertainty agencies face in their dependencies on principals, the more likely they are to depend on proposals. This argument is tested using multilevel mixed-effects logistic regression based on citizen proposals (N = 3,609) submitted through Korea’s national participatory budgeting initiative from 2020 through 2023. The results show that agencies with less financial support from the legislature or those with smaller budgets are more likely to adopt proposals, as they face greater uncertainty due to unstable budgetary flows or fewer response options to manage resource instability. Agencies are also more likely to adopt proposals when they previously secured greater funding through proposal adoption, but this effect weakens for larger-budget agencies or those receiving greater legislative support. These findings emphasize the strategic nature of proposal adoption and the role of resource dependence in agency responses to proposals.

Seunghyun Kim: Sungkyunkwan University Associate Professor, School of Global Leader/ Graduate School of Governance, ,25-2, Seonggyungwan-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South

items.journal: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 자원 의존 관점에서 정부기관이 정치적 상급기관의 예산 승인 불확실성에 대응해 시민참여예산 제안을 채택하는 이유를 설명하고, 한국 국가참여예산제도에 제출된 제안 3,609건(2020~2023년)을 다층 혼합효과 로지스틱 회귀로 분석했다. 의회의 재정 지원이 적거나 기관 예산이 작을수록 제안 채택 가능성이 높았으며, 제안 채택을 통해 이전에 더 많은 재원을 확보한 기관에서도 채택 가능성이 높았지만 기관 예산 규모와 의회 지원이 클수록 이 효과는 약해졌다.
items.title: A Model of Agency Behavior in Participatory Budgeting: A Resource Dependence Perspective

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The intersection of immigration and welfare has taken a central stage in the politics of social policy and garnered increasing scholarly attention in welfare politics research. While prior research has examined how immigration affects welfare support and welfare generosity in the US, less is known about the determinants of immigrant‐related welfare policies. This paper investigates how state‐level policymakers shape immigrant welfare policies in response to changing social and economic state contexts across the U.S. states from 2000 to 2020. Using data from the Urban Institute's Welfare Rules Database, we create a policy index of welfare inclusion of immigrants to track policy variations across the American states from 2000 to 2020. We then employ panel data analyses to explore the determinants of state immigrant TANF policies. Our findings reveal diverging strategies of state legislatures: conservative state legislatures tend to be associated with more restrictive immigrant welfare policies than their liberal counterparts; moreover, conservative and liberal state legislatures respond to different types of state contexts in adjusting their immigrant welfare policies. Conservative state legislatures respond to rising poverty by enacting restrictive policies, whereas liberal state legislatures respond to declining levels of anti‐immigration sentiment by adopting more inclusive policies.

Ling Zhu: Department of Political Science University of Houston Houston Texas USA
Ping Xu: Department of Political Science University of Rhode Island Kingston Rhode Island USA
Sebastian Ege: Department of Political Science University of Houston Houston Texas USA

items.summary_ko: 미국 각 주의 이민자 복지정책을 결정하는 요인을 2000~2020년 Urban Institute 복지 규칙 데이터베이스와 정책 포용성 지수, 패널자료 분석으로 검토했다. 보수적 주의회는 빈곤 증가에 대응해 더 제한적인 정책을, 진보적 주의회는 반이민 정서 감소에 대응해 더 포용적인 정책을 채택하는 경향이 나타났다.
items.title: Evolving Contexts and Diverging Strategies: Federalism and the Politics of Immigrant Welfare Exclusion in the US

items.abstract: Abstract Science‐related populism—populist attitudes toward scientific authority—has attracted growing scholarly attention. Although the SciPop Scale measures this construct, its cross‐national psychometric properties remain underexamined. Using data from the Trust in Science and Science‐Related Populism project ( N = 69,341; 68 countries/regions) and the Swiss Science Barometer ( N = 1124), we evaluate factor structure and reliability, test multigroup invariance, apply alignment for approximate invariance, and compare scoring philosophies (Bollen vs. Goertz approach) on criterion validity. We further employ multidimensional item response theory models to provide complementary item‐level diagnostics, including discrimination, threshold, item information, and differential item functioning. Results show that reliability is high and a four‐factor model fits most broadly. Full measurement invariance holds across sex, age, education, residence, political orientation, and religiosity; partial invariance appears across regions, economic development, cultural values, and regime types. Cross‐national comparability is limited but improves via measurement alignment. Different scoring methods identify different weakest dimensions. For criterion validity, Bollen‐based aligned scores consistently outperform the Goertz approach, yielding higher explanatory power in cross‐national and cross‐group analyses. Finally, we provide guidelines for researchers using the SciPop Scale and future directions for measuring science‐related populism.

Xue‐Fei Yan: Computational Communication Collaboratory, School of Journalism and Communication Nanjing University Nanjing China
Zhihao Ma: Computational Communication Collaboratory, School of Journalism and Communication Nanjing University Nanjing China

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 SciPop 척도의 요인구조·신뢰도·측정불변성과 국가·집단 간 비교 가능성을 검토하고, Bollen식과 Goertz식 점수 산정 및 다차원 문항반응이론을 비교했다. 68개국 자료와 스위스 자료에서 4요인 모형이 가장 넓게 적합했으며, 국가 간 비교는 제한적이지만 측정 정렬로 개선되고 Bollen 기반 정렬 점수가 기준타당도에서 일관되게 우수했다.
items.title: Revisiting the SciPop Scale: Measurement alignment, scoring rules, and cross‐context comparability

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Collaborative governance is becoming a practical imperative. At the same time, resolving complex public affairs could offer opportunities to overcome bottlenecks, while Artificial Intelligence (AI) could help. This study draws on polycentric governance theory and multilayer network theory to explain why collaborative governance could occur and how it could be influenced by AI, respectively. Mathematical deductions from both micro and macro perspectives are employed to reinforce this theoretical viewpoint. Using Chinese cities as a case study, the impact of AI on collaborative governance has been tested in practice, supported by benchmark regression and subsequent tests for endogeneity and robustness. Mechanism tests demonstrate AI's functions by advancing digital government, lifting corporate transparency, and improving public knowledge. Moreover, econometric evidence from difference‐in‐differences, threshold regressions, and spatial econometric models robustly addresses concerns about AI. This study offers a quantifiable multi‐stakeholder governance framework and actionable policy insights for China and the Global South.

Fei Fan: Economics and Management School, Wuhan University Wuhan China
Song Wang: School of Business Administration, Northeastern University Shenyang China
Zhennan Yang: School of Business Administration, Northeastern University Shenyang China
Zhuocheng Lu: School of Public Policy and Administration, Chongqing University Chongqing China

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 다중심 거버넌스 이론과 다층 네트워크 이론에 기반해 AI가 협력적 거버넌스를 촉진하는 메커니즘과 다차원적 효과를 중국 도시 자료로 분석했다. 기준회귀와 내생성·강건성 검증, 이중차분·임계값·공간계량 분석 결과, AI는 디지털 정부 발전, 기업 투명성 제고, 시민 지식 향상을 통해 협력적 거버넌스를 촉진하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: How Artificial Intelligence Facilitates Collaborative Governance? Research on Mechanisms and Multi‐Dimensional Effects Based on Triple Entities

items.abstract: ABSTRACT In an era of time constraints and publication pressures, scholars risk becoming entrenched in familiar approaches. Christopher Hood's public administration scholarship reminds us that excellence often arises from a broad exploration of ideas. This paper identifies three core elements of Hood's research practice. First, a deep skepticism toward dominant narratives, which often revealed hidden complexities. Second, careful selection of temporal frames: this often meant adopting remarkably long time‐horizons to reveal patterns in administrative and policy reform. Third, genuine interdisciplinarity. While firmly rooted in public administration, Hood drew on concepts, evidence, and methods from a wide range of disciplines. Analyzing how these three elements interacted in Hood's work, the paper reflects on how adopting aspects of his approach can help scholars produce work of lasting value. Hood's legacy is therefore not only a record of past achievement but also a practical guide to navigating the contemporary academic environment.

Barbara Maria Piotrowska: Department of Political Economy King's College London London UK
Maia King: Department of Political Economy King's College London London UK
Rozana Himaz: Department of Risk and Disaster Reduction University College London London UK

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 Christopher Hood의 연구 실천에서 지배적 서사에 대한 회의적 검토, 장기적 시간 프레임의 선택, 진정한 학제성을 어떻게 결합했는지 분석하고, 이러한 접근이 지속적 가치가 있는 연구를 산출하는 데 어떤 지침을 제공하는지 고찰한다. 분석 결과, 세 요소의 결합은 행정·정책 개혁의 숨은 복잡성과 장기적 패턴을 드러내며, 오늘날 학문 환경에서 연구 전략으로 활용될 수 있음을 제시한다.
items.title: Strategies for Public Administration Research: Insights From the Scholarship of Christopher Hood

items.abstract: The bureaucratic, resource-constrained, and politically contested nature of the public sector often exposes public servants to illegitimate tasks – assignments perceived as unreasonable or unnecessary. Such tasks frustrate public servants and can undermine behaviours critical to high-quality public service. Despite their prevalence, their consequences in public sector contexts remain underexplored. This study investigates how illegitimate tasks affect citizen-oriented boundary-spanning behaviours (COBSBs), a set of positive work behaviours connecting agencies with stakeholders through service delivery, knowledge sharing, and external representation. Using a time-lagged survey of Vietnamese public servants, we find that illegitimate tasks indirectly reduce COBSBs by increasing work cynicism. Surprisingly, public service motivation and ethical leadership – typically considered resources – intensify rather than buffer the negative effects of illegitimate tasks. By uncovering the costs of illegitimate tasks and these counterintuitive moderating mechanisms, the study offers new insights for public management theory and practice concerning task assignment, leadership, and motivation.

Diep Nguyen: Honours College, University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Tuyen Nguyen: Cai Ngang Public Administrative Service Center

items.summary_ko: 베트남 공무원을 대상으로 시간차 설문을 실시해, 정당화되기 어렵다고 인식되는 과업이 업무 냉소를 높여 시민지향적 경계확장 행동을 간접적으로 감소시키는지 분석했다. 공공봉사동기와 윤리적 리더십은 이러한 부정적 영향을 완화하기보다 오히려 강화하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: When tasks feel unjustified: effects of illegitimate tasks on public servants’ citizen-oriented boundary-spanning behaviours

items.abstract: This article investigates how Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) constructed policy narratives on artificial intelligence (AI) in the legislative process leading up to the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) adopted in 2024. While previous research has primarily focused on executive-driven strategy documents, the Parliament's discursive role remains underexplored. To address this gap, the study applies the Narrative Policy Framework (NPF) to a corpus of 18 parliamentary documents from 2020 to 2024, in which 500 narratives were manually coded according to the NPF categories of plot, character, setting, and moral. The findings reveal remarkable stability in the Parliament's AI narratives over time, despite significant external shocks such as the release of ChatGPT 3.5 in 2022. Plots were dominated by stories of control and rising, supported by heroes and beneficiaries, framing AI as both manageable and beneficial. Settings spanned security, global competition, and European legal norms, while morals centered on risk-based regulation, ethical standards, and calls for a joint approach. By illuminating how the European Parliament narrates AI policy, this study contributes to understanding the discursive dynamics shaping EU AI governance and their implications for digital government research, particularly regarding the normative conditions under which AI systems are adopted in public administration.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 유럽의회 의원들이 2024년 EU 인공지능법으로 이어진 입법 과정에서 AI 정책 서사를 어떻게 구성하고 변화시켰는지 분석했다. 2020~2024년 의회 문서 18건의 서사 500개를 서사정책체계(NPF) 범주로 수기 코딩한 결과, ChatGPT 3.5 출시 같은 외부 충격에도 서사는 대체로 안정적이었으며, 통제와 부상 플롯 및 영웅·수혜자 구도가 AI를 관리 가능하고 유익한 대상으로 제시하고 위험기반 규제·윤리 기준·공동 접근을 강조했다.
items.title: Narrating the AI Act: Policy narratives on artificial intelligence, their construction, and evolution within the European Parliament

items.abstract: This study investigates how citizens perceive human versus algorithmic decision-making in routine public service interactions involving administrative discretion. We conducted a vignette experiment on a sample of 2,345 German citizens, focusing on the renewal of an ID card, a low-complexity task involving potential fines for late submission. The experiment varied service agent type (human vs. Smart-Self-Service Terminal (SSST)), decision outcome (fine vs. no fine), and agents’ human-likeness. Results show that citizens respond differently to negative outcomes depending on whether they are delivered by a human or a SSST. Unfavorable decisions were evaluated more positively when made by a SSST than by human officials. These findings point to a potential dark side of algorithmic discretion. Even in routine interactions, negative outcomes imposed by an allegedly cold machine may be perceived more positively than those delivered by human bureaucrats, which could incentivize governments to digitize enforcement and weaken public accountability.
items.summary_ko: 독일 시민을 대상으로 신분증 갱신 과정의 벌금 부과 상황에서 인간 공무원과 스마트 무인단말기(SSST)의 의사결정을 비교하는 비네트 실험을 실시했다. 부정적 결정은 인간보다 SSST가 내릴 때 더 긍정적으로 평가되어, 알고리즘 재량이 불리한 결과에 대한 시민의 반응을 다르게 만들 수 있음을 보였다.
items.title: Let the Machine Impose the Fine! Algorithmic Discretion with Negative Outcomes. Experimental Evidence from Germany

items.abstract: Drawing upon uncertainty management theory, this study examines whether, how, and when leader unethical pro-organizational behaviour (UPB) is associated with subordinate UPB in the Chinese public sector. Using three-wave survey data from 231 civil servants, our study indicates that organizational accountability for unethical behaviour and subordinates’ public service motivation (PSM) jointly moderate this trickle-down effect. Specifically, the effect peaks when both factors are low, with subordinates’ moral justification mediating this process. These findings highlight the UPB trickle-down mechanism, suggesting managers enhance accountability and cultivate employees’ PSM to reduce moral justification and attenuate the spread of UPB.
items.summary_ko: 중국 공공부문에서 리더의 비윤리적 친조직 행동(UPB)이 부하직원의 UPB와 어떤 조건에서 연계되는지 231명의 공무원을 대상으로 한 3시점 설문으로 분석했다. 조직의 비윤리적 행동에 대한 책무성과 부하직원의 공공봉사동기(PSM)가 함께 낮을 때 이 효과가 가장 강했으며, 부하직원의 도덕적 정당화가 이를 매개했다.
items.title: A fish rots from the head down: unpacking the trickle-down effect of leaders’ unethical pro-organizational behaviour (UPB) in the Chinese public sector

items.abstract: How female street-level bureaucrats navigate decisions involving socially stigmatized female clients lies at the intersection of a theoretical debate between representative bureaucracy and street-level stereotyping research. It also reflects a practical dilemma stemming from regulatory gaps in China’s online-to-offline (O2O) massage apps that compel frontline workers to adjudicate ambiguous disputes involving suspected sexual assault or sex work. Using a within-subject vignette experiment with 679 Chinese bureaucrats, this study examines how gender congruence and social stereotypes interact to shape discretionary decisions in high-discretion contexts. Findings reveal that gender congruence outweighs social stereotypes in shaping female bureaucrats’ decisions regarding stigmatized female massage therapists, suggesting that shared demographic traits foster supportive interactions (representation) even as they are counteracted by stigmatizing stereotypes (discrimination). These results highlight the role of individual-level discretion in protecting vulnerable groups and promoting social equity within regulatory gray areas, underscoring the need for more representative, socioculturally aware street-level bureaucracies.
items.summary_ko: 중국 관료 679명을 대상으로 한 피험자 내 비네트 실험을 통해, 사회적으로 낙인찍힌 여성 마사지 종사자 관련 재량적 판단에서 성별 일치와 사회적 고정관념의 상호작용을 분석했다. 여성 관료의 판단에서는 사회적 고정관념보다 성별 일치가 더 큰 영향을 미쳐, 낙인과 차별의 가능성에도 불구하고 공유된 성별 특성이 지지적 결정을 촉진하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Still Women Help Women? Gender Congruence, Social Stereotypes, and Street-Level Discretionary Decision-Making

items.abstract: Abstract This article asks a central question in digital government research: why do local governments operating under similar institutional conditions follow sharply different digital transformation trajectories over time? Drawing on theories of gradual institutional change, the study conceptualizes digital transformation not as a discrete adoption outcome, but as a process of institutional conversion through which technological capacity is translated into sustained digital service provision. Information governance is theorized as the key conditioning mechanism linking technological resources to durable organizational outcomes. The analysis combines longitudinal panel models, fixed-effects estimators, and trajectory-based clustering using a panel of all Brazilian municipalities (MUNIC/IBGE; N = 5,569) across seven waves between 2004 and 2024. Results show that increases in technological capacity are associated with subsequent gains in digital services, but these effects are gradual and conditional. Information governance significantly shapes how municipalities mobilize and stabilize technological resources over time, while interaction models reveal non-linear and diminishing returns consistent with institutional coordination limits. Trajectory analyses identify four distinct patterns of digital transformation, ranging from ‘institutionalized pioneers’ to ‘persistent stagnation’, demonstrating that digital development unfolds through path-dependent and institutionally anchored trajectories rather than through simple convergence. The article contributes to public administration research in three ways: provides rare longitudinal evidence on local digital transformation over two decades; integrates institutional change theory into digital government research by conceptualizing governance as a mechanism of institutional conversion; and advances a trajectory-based explanation of digital transformation that shifts attention from episodic technological adoption to cumulative institutional processes shaping long-run administrative performance.

Adalmir de Oliveira Gomes: University of Brasilia (UnB), Colina, Block H, Apartment 205, Darcy Ribeiro University Campus, Asa Norte , Brasília, Federal District, Brazil, Zip Code: 70904-108

items.summary_ko: 브라질 지방정부가 유사한 제도적 조건에서도 서로 다른 디지털 전환 경로를 보이는 이유를 규명하기 위해, 2004~2024년 7개 시점의 5,569개 지방정부 패널에 고정효과 모형과 궤적 기반 군집분석을 적용했다. 기술 역량 증가는 디지털 서비스 확대와 관련되지만 그 효과는 점진적·조건부였으며, 정보 거버넌스가 기술 자원의 지속적 활용을 형성하고 비선형적·체감적인 네 가지 전환 궤적이 나타났다.
items.title: Institutional Conversion and Digital Transformation in Local Governments: A Longitudinal Analysis of Trajectories

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Welfare policies often combine particularistic and universalistic elements, yet we know less about how shifts in this balance shape public attitudes toward vulnerable low‐status groups. This article develops a three‐dimensional framework for analyzing welfare policy, distinguishing among welfare scope, welfare benefits, and inclusion criteria. We argue that public attitudes toward lower‐status groups are shaped by the combined signal about the welfare deservingness hierarchy generated by the configuration of particularistic and universalistic elements across these dimensions. Because policy design packages convey a broader normative stance about who belongs and who deserves, they can influence perceptions of groups that are not directly targeted by a policy change, lowering or raising their perceived deservingness. Using difference‐in‐differences and regression discontinuity methods, we analyze Weibo posts during China's two‐round hukou reform. We find that shifts toward more particularistic policy configurations lead to more negative attitudes toward low‐skilled migrant workers, whereas shifts toward more universalistic configurations yield more positive attitudes. Subgroup analyses yield suggestive patterns across local economic contexts and individual characteristics. These findings have broader implications for research on welfare policy systems and for reform efforts regarding social integration.

Liu Chen: School of Public Policy and Management Tsinghua University Beijing China
Tom Christensen: School of Public Policy and Management Tsinghua University Beijing China
Department of Political Science University of Oslo Oslo Norway
Xufeng Zhu: School of Public Policy and Management Tsinghua University Beijing China

items.summary_ko: 복지정책의 범위·급여·포괄 기준에서 특수주의와 보편주의의 결합 변화가 취약한 저지위 집단에 대한 대중의 태도에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 분석했다. 중국 호구제도 개혁 기간의 웨이보 게시물을 대상으로 이중차분과 회귀불연속 분석을 실시한 결과, 특수주의적 구성으로의 변화는 저숙련 이주노동자에 대한 부정적 태도와, 보편주의적 구성으로의 변화는 긍정적 태도와 연관되었다.
items.title: Balancing Particularism and Universalism in Welfare Policy: Insights From China's Hukou Reform

items.abstract: Abstract Political parties in advanced democracies face a dual challenge: fewer citizens are willing to volunteer, and those who remain active are disproportionately older and male. This is troubling given the central role that volunteers play in campaigns and party processes. Whether party leaders can recruit a larger and more diverse activist base remains an open question. We partnered with a major party in the Netherlands and conducted two field experiments before the 2021 general and 2022 municipal elections, targeting over 35,000 party members. The party randomized whether members received a personal call, an email or both. Results show that calls—where members could voice their opinions—increased volunteer sign-up rates (83% in Study 1 and 361% in Study 2), especially among younger members. By contrast, emails had no effect. These findings clarify mixed evidence in the literature, suggesting that voice opportunities are key to expanding and diversifying the activist base.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 정당의 회원 3만 5천 명 이상을 대상으로 선거 전 두 차례 현장실험을 실시해, 개인 전화·이메일·두 방식 병행이 자원봉사 참여를 늘리고 활동가 기반을 다양화할 수 있는지 검증했다. 의견을 말할 기회를 제공한 전화는 특히 젊은 회원의 자원봉사 신청을 크게 늘렸지만, 이메일은 효과가 없었다.
items.title: Get Out the Volunteer: Encouraging Diverse Political Party Activism

items.abstract: We evaluate whether campaign advertisements that generate larger emotional reactions also generate larger persuasive effects in contemporary elections. We analyze 29 weeks of experiments conducted during the 2016 U.S. presidential campaign, in which 48 authentic campaign ads were tested in real time, often within days of their debut. The ads and a placebo were randomly assigned to approximately 28,000 subjects. We find that campaign ads reliably move emotions, albeit in largely partisan ways, with comparatively muted reactions among independents. Critically, however, these emotional reactions do not predict the magnitude of an ad’s effect on candidate favorability, vote intention, policy preferences, or turnout intention. Our results cast doubt on emotion-based accounts of advertising persuasion in polarized elections and caution practitioners against using self-reported emotional reactions as a measure of message effectiveness.
items.summary_ko: 2016년 미국 대선 기간 29주 동안 약 2만8천 명을 대상으로 48개의 실제 선거광고와 위약을 무작위 배정한 실시간 실험을 실시해, 광고의 정서 반응과 설득 효과의 관계를 검토했다. 광고는 주로 당파적으로 정서를 변화시켰지만, 정서 반응의 크기는 후보 호감도·투표 의향·정책 선호·투표 참여 의향에 대한 광고 효과의 크기를 예측하지 못했다.
items.title: Do Emotional Ads Persuade? Evidence from Real-Time Campaign Advertising Experiments

items.abstract: Abstract Why do some Latino and Asian Americans support conservative policies that may discriminate against them? Elaborating on system justification theory, we argue that ideologies such as meritocracy perpetuate the status quo by placating marginalized groups and assuaging their emotional concerns regarding their unfair treatment. This research examined the extent to which endorsing meritocratic ideology is associated with deportation policy attitudes and the degree of emotional concern about deportation among Latino and Asian Americans. Using data from the 2024 and 2020 Collaborative Multiracial Post‐Election Surveys, we find that higher meritocratic ideology predicted greater support for deportation policies and lower emotional concern about deportation for Latino and Asian Americans. This research demonstrates that Latino and Asian Americans who have ingrained the ethos of meritocracy are more likely to support conservative policies and develop sentiments that work against the interests of their communities.

Jin X. Goh: Department of Psychology University of Illinois Chicago Chicago Illinois USA
Nathan K. Chan: Department of Political Science Loyola Marymount University Los Angeles California USA

items.summary_ko: 라틴계·아시아계 미국인의 능력주의 이데올로기 수용이 추방 정책 태도 및 추방에 대한 정서적 우려와 어떤 관련이 있는지 2024년·2020년 다인종 선거 후 공동조사 자료로 분석했다. 능력주의 이데올로기가 강할수록 추방 정책 지지는 높고 추방에 대한 정서적 우려는 낮았다.
items.title: Working hard to belong: Meritocratic ideology and deportation sentiments among Latino and Asian Americans

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This study addresses the under‐theorized formation of specific co‐production arrangements by exploring governance pathway formation. Using 76 community regeneration projects in Shanghai, we identify a parsimonious two‐level typology: State‐led co‐production (comprising sub‐type A: state as operator and sub‐type B: non‐state as operator ) and Citizen‐led co‐production (comprising sub‐type C: volunteers as operator and sub‐type D: users as operator ). Findings reveal pathway emergence is contingent upon configurations of providers' capabilities, citizen empowerment, political leadership, and public service characteristics, reflecting logics associated with Neo‐Weberian State, New Public Management, and New Public Governance paradigms. The study shifts focus from static lists to dynamic governance pathways by proposing a configurational contingency framework that explains how governance logics are activated by specific contextual conditions.

Bing Ran: School of Public Affairs Penn State Harrisburg Middletown Pennsylvania USA
Huanming Wang: School of Public Administration and Policy Dalian University of Technology Dalian Liaoning Province China

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 공공서비스 공동생산의 구체적 거버넌스 경로가 어떻게 형성되는지를 탐구하기 위해 상하이 지역재생사업 76개를 분석했다. 분석 결과, 제공자의 역량·시민의 권한부여·정치적 리더십·공공서비스 특성의 조합에 따라 국가 주도형과 시민 주도형 공동생산 및 그 하위 유형이 나타나는 것으로 확인됐다.
items.title: How Were Governance Pathways Formed for Public Service Co‐Production? A Contingency Perspective

items.abstract: ABSTRACT While scholarship has documented how populist and authoritarian‐leaning executives deform bureaucratic institutions, post‐illiberal reconstruction has only begun to receive attention. This paper develops an exploratory framework distinguishing four repair strategies (neutralizing, rectifying, balancing, and democratic hardening) and two repair modes (formal‐institutional and normative‐capacity repair). Applying the heuristic to Poland, Brazil, and Hungary, we posit that the selection and limits of repair strategies follow the gap between the depth of illiberal entrenchment and the legal‐political capacity of successor governments to overcome veto players and enact rectifying reforms. Within the periods observed, formal‐institutional repair has outpaced the reconstruction of professional norms, expertise, and trust, and repair has produced layered administrative orders in which illiberal‐era instruments partly persist and thus remain available to future governments. Administrative repair is thus structurally asymmetric. Democratic successors can rebuild the administrative state, but they are unlikely to restore it to the status quo ante.

Andrzej Schultz: Department of Law European University Institute Fiesole Italy
Bárbara Motta: Universidade Federal de Sergipe São Cristóvão Brazil
Department of Social and Political Sciences European University Institute Fiesole Italy
Daniel Kovarek: Florence School of Transnational Governance European University Institute Fiesole Italy
Michael W. Bauer: Florence School of Transnational Governance European University Institute Fiesole Italy

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 비자유주의 통치 이후 관료국가를 어떻게 복구할 수 있는지, 그리고 복구 전략의 선택과 한계가 비자유주의적 제도 고착 정도 및 후임 정부의 법·정치적 역량과 어떻게 연관되는지를 탐색적 틀로 분석한다. 폴란드·브라질·헝가리를 적용 사례로 검토한 결과, 공식·제도적 복구가 전문 규범·전문성·신뢰의 재구축보다 앞섰고, 비자유주의 시기의 수단이 일부 존속하는 층위적 행정질서가 형성되어 복구는 구조적으로 비대칭적이며 현상태 이전으로의 완전한 복귀는 어렵다고 본다.
items.title: Restoring the Deformed Administrative State? Bureaucratic Repair After Illiberal Rule

items.abstract: Design is increasingly recognized as a promising approach to foster societal transformation, yet its transformative potential is rarely realized. Empirical guidance on how to unlock this potential remains limited. To address this gap, we first conceptualize design for societal transformation as operating across three levels of design activity – i.e. design within context, designing context, and design of context – in mutually reinforcing ways to enable broad, deep, and lasting change. Using this lens, we then examine three cases from our own design practice to identify (1) key barriers constraining design’s transformative potential, and (2) main strategies that can be employed to navigate them. Our analysis reveals that barriers interrelate across the three levels of design activity, and that design’s inherent transformative qualities can be leveraged to navigate them. Together, these insights suggest that design can function as a mode of transformative governance that operates through a small wins logic.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 사회 변혁을 위한 디자인의 잠재력이 실현되지 못하는 장벽과 이를 극복하는 전략을 어떻게 설명할 수 있는지 묻고, 디자인 실천에서의 세 사례를 ‘맥락 안의 디자인·맥락 설계·맥락 디자인’의 세 수준으로 분석했다. 장벽은 세 수준에 걸쳐 상호 연관되며, 디자인의 변혁적 특성을 활용하면 이를 헤쳐 나갈 수 있고, 디자인은 ‘작은 승리’의 논리로 작동하는 변혁적 거버넌스 방식이 될 수 있음을 제시한다.
items.title: Unlocking the transformative potential of design: reflections from practice on navigating barriers to designing for societal transformation

items.abstract: Abstract Do media depictions of a ‘polarized society’ merely describe division or actually deepen it? We report two laboratory experiments in Germany (Study1 $$N=302$$ ; Study2 $$N=295$$ ). After reading authentic newspaper articles in which brief polarization cues were experimentally included versus omitted, participants (i) completed standard affective- and ideological-polarization measures and (ii) played incentivized Dictator, Ultimatum, and Trust Games with ideological out-group partners. Polarization cues increased both affective polarization and ideological extremity. Behavioral responses, however, were mixed. In the Dictator Game, where the recipient cannot respond, treated participants shared less with the out-group. In the Trust Game, characterized by mutual dependence and potential efficiency gains, treated participants sent more to out-group partners. Ultimatum behavior, where interdependence is partial, showed weaker and less consistent shifts. Taken together, polarization cues reliably heighten perceived division but do not uniformly translate into behavioral antagonism: even after cues that increase self-reported polarization, participants can still cooperate with ideological opponents when cooperation is perceived as mutually beneficial.
items.summary_ko: 독일의 두 실험에서 신문 기사에 양극화 단서를 포함하거나 제외해, 이러한 단서가 이념적 외집단에 대한 인식과 행동에 미치는 영향을 검증했다. 양극화 단서는 정서적 양극화와 이념적 극단성을 높였지만, 독재자 게임에서는 외집단에 대한 공유를 줄인 반면 신뢰 게임에서는 상호 이익이 가능한 협력을 늘리는 등 행동 효과는 맥락에 따라 달랐다.
items.title: From Antagonistic Talk to Cooperative Acts: The Effect of Polarization Cues on Newspaper Audiences

items.abstract: While most research on democratic resilience and decline focuses on institutional erosion, less is known about how these shifts manifest in elite political communication. We examine how democratic resilience and decline are articulated on Facebook by political leaders, comparing Hungary, an archetype of informational autocracy, and Sweden, a case of resilient democracy. Drawing on 9,737 Facebook posts from 10 Swedish and 9 Hungarian party leaders between 2022 and 2024, we use computational text analysis to identify linguistic, rhetorical, and emotional patterns. We address three research questions: (1) What dimensions of democracy do politicians emphasize, and how do these emphases differ between resilient and backsliding contexts? (2) How do populism and government/opposition dynamics shape these patterns? (3) How do patterns vary across campaigns, crises, and routine communication? Our results show that democracy is not only institutional but also communicatively produced through distinct discursive logics. Disaggregating by actor affiliation and populist orientation reveals that actors in the Hungarian government frame democracy in populist, performance-based terms. In contrast, in Sweden, both populists and non-populists communicate within a shared, deliberative repertoire. Temporal analysis highlights that Hungary’s discourse on democracy is event-driven and affirmatively neutral, while Sweden’s is sustained and critically self-reflective. We advance the concept of elite communicative resilience, finding that patterns of democratic discourse differ markedly between resilient and backsliding contexts in ways that parallel institutional differences.

Xénia Farkas: Umeå University, Umeå, Sweden; Research Fellow at ELTE Centre for Social Sciences

items.summary_ko: 스웨덴과 헝가리 정당 지도자들의 2022~2024년 페이스북 게시물 9,737건을 계산적 텍스트 분석으로 비교해, 정치인들이 민주주의의 어떤 차원을 강조하고 그 담론이 포퓰리즘·집권/야당 지위·정치적 사건에 따라 어떻게 달라지는지 분석했다. 헝가리 집권 세력은 민주주의를 포퓰리즘적·성과 중심적으로 구성한 반면, 스웨덴에서는 포퓰리스트와 비포퓰리스트 모두 숙의적 레퍼토리를 공유했으며, 헝가리의 담론은 사건 주도적이고 스웨덴의 담론은 지속적·비판적으로 성찰적이었다.
items.title: The Language of Democratic Resilience and Decline: A Comparative Study of Politicians’ Communication on Facebook in Sweden and Hungary

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Governments at all levels are grappling with AI's implications for public administration. Because federal actions often establish the principles guiding wider governance efforts, this study asks how US federal AI policies reflect—or fail to reflect—core public values. Drawing on a dataset of US federal AI policies from 2020 to 2023, we systematically analyze the risks, harms, and governance strategies employed across government‐issued and enacted policy documents. Specifically, we analyze 120 discrete policy sections or subsections of federal laws and regulations, utilizing the parsing approach of the AI Governance and Regulatory Archive (AGORA), all of which regulate the operation of the government itself rather than private sector behavior. We develop a theoretical and empirical crosswalk linking AI‐related risks and harms to prominent public values. Results indicate that while values such as individual rights, the common good, and accountability are regularly invoked, additional guidance around public values like citizen engagement, workplace standards, and responsiveness may be necessary to prevent public value failure. The study further categorizes governance strategies in AI policy documents into regulatory, service‐based, and informational instruments, and finds that regulatory policies are most likely to engage with public values.

School of Government and International Affairs Kennesaw State University Kennesaw Georgia

items.summary_ko: 미국 연방 AI 정책이 핵심 공공가치를 어떻게 반영하거나 간과하는지 분석하기 위해 2020~2023년 정책 문서의 120개 조항을 체계적으로 검토하고, AI 위험·피해와 공공가치의 연계를 구축했다. 개인 권리·공익·책임성은 자주 다뤄졌지만 시민 참여·직장 기준·대응성에 대한 추가 지침이 필요했으며, 규제 수단이 서비스 기반·정보 제공 수단보다 공공가치를 더 많이 반영했다.
items.title: A Public Values Framework for AI Governance: Evidence From US Federal AI Policymaking

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Responsible algorithmization refers to the use of algorithms in the public sector while safeguarding public values. Approaches to responsible algorithmization suggested by the EU, OECD, and others depart from a rational perspective and highlight formal structures and procedures. This paper complements this perspective by adding a “natural perspective,” which emphasizes sense‐making and actual practices. This natural perspective is used for a set of ethnographic studies of algorithmization in three domains in the Netherlands: regulation, policing, and healthcare. Our findings show that algorithmization of government organizations is an emergent, political, open, and fragmented process, rather than, as assumed by rational approaches to responsible algorithmization, pre‐structured, neutral, closed, and simple. This means that rational approaches fall short of providing a comprehensive basis for establishing responsible algorithmization. We conclude that not only passive responsibility but also active responsibility for algorithmization in the public sector needs to be addressed to safeguard public values.

Albert Meijer: Utrecht University School of Governance Utrecht the Netherlands
Isabelle Donatz‐Fest: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam Amsterdam the Netherlands

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 공공부문에서 공공가치를 보호하는 책임 있는 알고리즘화를 어떻게 이해할 수 있는지 묻고, 네덜란드의 규제·경찰·보건의료 분야를 대상으로 민족지 연구를 수행했다. 분석 결과 알고리즘화는 사전에 구조화되고 중립적이며 폐쇄적인 과정이 아니라 emergent하고 정치적이며 개방적이고 파편적인 과정이므로, 형식적 구조와 절차에 초점을 둔 합리적 접근만으로는 충분하지 않으며 수동적 책임뿐 아니라 능동적 책임도 다뤄야 한다.
items.title: Responsible Algorithmization in the Public Sector: A “Natural Perspective” Based on Ethnographic Research in Regulation, Policing, and Healthcare

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Outcomes‐based contracts (OBCs) organize public service delivery around measurable results, yet little is known about how different investors engage with these instruments. This article examines how investor orientation (social, financial, or dual‐purpose) shapes investor commitment in OBCs worldwide. Drawing on a global dataset of 338 contracts, we combine descriptive analyses, regression models, and qualitative interviews to investigate how investor orientation relates to investment scale. We hypothesize that OBCs involving socially oriented investors are associated with higher levels of investment than those involving financially or dual‐purpose investors. Consistent with this prediction, socially oriented investors consistently commit larger amounts, whereas financially oriented and dual‐purpose investors typically participate with smaller contributions. These patterns challenge a central premise of OBCs: that such instruments would mobilize significant mainstream private capital for public services. Interview evidence points to reputational risks, limited familiarity with local conditions, and outcome measurement complexity as key deterrents.
