items.abstract: ABSTRACT Public consultations are a cornerstone of democratic policymaking, yet the sheer volume and heterogeneity of submissions often overwhelm traditional analysis. Emerging large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for making sense of such data, but their performance in contexts with high linguistic and technical diversity remains underexplored. In this research note, we present a case‐based demonstration rather than a generalizable evaluation, assessing an open‐source LLM (Gemma3:27b) and a proprietary LLM (GPT‐5‐mini) for analyzing stakeholder inputs from three Swiss pre‐parliamentary consultations. The coexistence of multiple languages and varying technical complexity in submissions creates uniquely challenging datasets, providing a rigorous test for automated tools. We benchmark the model against official administrative reports, assessing accuracy and completeness. Results show the open‐source model performs excellently in straightforward consultations, achieving a mean accuracy of 90%, but encounters difficulties in retrieving the substantive content (overall completeness: 70%). Comparatively, the proprietary model obtains better results than the open‐source one in these two settings. Overall, LLMs can streamline analysis and enhance interpretive capacity, complementing (but not replacing) human expertise. The study highlights both the potential and limits of algorithmic support for participatory governance in linguistically and technically diverse environments.

Edgar Mathevet: Institute of Political Studies University of Lausanne Switzerland
Lauriane Cailleux: Institute of Political Studies University of Lausanne Switzerland

items.summary_ko: 이 연구노트는 스위스의 3개 의회 전 단계 공론협의 자료를 대상으로 오픈소스 LLM(Gemma3:27b)과 독점 LLM(GPT-5-mini)이 다언어·기술적 이질성이 높은 의견을 공식 행정 보고서와 비교해 얼마나 정확하고 완전하게 분석하는지 사례 기반으로 평가한다. 오픈소스 모델은 단순한 협의에서 평균 정확도 90%를 보였지만 내용 검색의 완전성은 70%였고, 두 비교 상황에서는 독점 모델이 더 우수했으며, LLM은 인간 전문성을 대체하기보다 보완하는 데 유용한 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Open‐Source LLMs for Automated Analysis of Multilingual Consultation Feedback: A Swiss Case Study

items.abstract: Abstract This study investigates how blame-attributing crisis frames influence support for incumbents in an electoral authoritarian context, focusing on Türkiye. It asks how, to what extent, and under what conditions incumbents’ blame frames shape public attitudes toward the government. The study examines four crisis types (i.e., global warming , earthquake , economic collapse , and pandemic ) and compares the effects of religious , conspiratorial , and scientific framing across these contexts. Drawing on original data from seven pre-survey focus groups and a nationwide face-to-face survey experiment with 3,562 respondents, the findings indicate that the independent effects of blame frames are generally limited. However, the effectiveness of religion-based blame framing is highly context dependent. Compared with climate and economic crises, its estimated effects are more favorable in crises characterized by high uncertainty and relatively low perceived governmental responsibility, such as earthquake and pandemic. These findings suggest that the effectiveness of blame attribution is conditioned by the nature of the crisis itself. The study contributes to research on crisis framing, political accountability, and authoritarian durability.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 튀르키예의 선거권위주의 맥락에서 지구온난화·지진·경제붕괴·팬데믹 위기에 종교적·음모론적·과학적 책임 귀속 프레임이 집권자에 대한 태도에 미치는 영향과 조건을 전국 대면 설문실험으로 분석했다. 책임 귀속 프레임의 독립적 효과는 대체로 제한적이었지만, 종교 기반 프레임은 위기의 성격에 따라 달라져 정부 책임 인식이 낮고 불확실성이 큰 지진·팬데믹에서 기후·경제 위기보다 더 유리한 효과를 보였다.
items.title: The Limits of Incumbent Blame Games in Times of Crisis: Experimental Evidence from Electoral Autocracy

items.abstract: In the U.S. the availability of news information has grown exponentially while trust in traditional sources of news and information has declined. Amid this high-information, low-trust environment, many now advocate for doing your own research (DYOR) to discern accurate claims from false, misleading, or biased information. The perception that it is better to do one’s own research has important implications for information seeking and attitudes toward mainstream news and journalism. In this study, we use a panel survey to investigate DYOR perceptions in the context of the 2020 U.S. election. We find that DYOR perceptions are associated with decreased nonpartisan news use, decreased belief accuracy, and more negative attitudes toward media, highlighting how information skepticism may be contributing to adversarial views toward mainstream media and expertise. Results suggest that such perceptions encourage negative views of news media and may contribute to distrust of public institutions.
items.summary_ko: 2020년 미국 대선 맥락에서 패널 설문으로 ‘스스로 조사하기(DYOR)’ 인식이 뉴스 이용과 주류 언론 태도에 미치는 관련성을 분석했다. DYOR 인식은 초당파적 뉴스 이용과 믿음의 정확성 저하, 언론에 대한 부정적 태도와 연관되어 주류 언론 및 전문성에 대한 불신을 강화할 가능성을 보였다.
items.title: Do Your Own Research: What Skepticism of Expertise Means for the News Media in the U.S.

items.abstract: First-generation immigrants face a seniority ceiling that limits their political incorporation as candidates and officeholders. Career ladders that require qualification time in lower positions create structural barriers for this group. We use linked data from Swedish electoral ballots andadministrative records to examine this idea. A novel identification strategy isolates the effect of seniority-based promotion structures from immigrant-specific disadvantages by comparing immigrants’ incorporation patterns to those of internal movers—native-born Swedes whorelocate between municipalities. The seniority ceiling explains about half of the immigrant-native gap in holding political positions and almost the entire gradient of worsening incorporation at higher levels. We find strong selection effects at both the individual and group level. The seniority ceiling restricts incorporation at higher career steps for those with fewer opportunities to accumulate qualification time: those who arrived more recently or at older ages.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴의 선거투표용지와 행정자료를 연계하고, 지방자치단체 간 이동을 한 내국인과 비교하는 식별전략을 통해 이민자의 정치직 진출을 제한하는 연공서열 장벽을 분석한다. 연공서열 장벽은 이민자와 내국인의 정치직 보유 격차의 약 절반, 상위 직급에서의 통합 악화 경향의 거의 전부를 설명하며, 자격 축적 기회가 적은 최근 이주자와 고령 이주자에게 특히 크게 작용한다.
items.title: The seniority ceiling: Why some immigrants struggle to rise in political office

items.abstract: Abstract Regression Inside Out (RIO) describes a set of related methods based on a decomposition of regression coefficients by individual cases. In this article, we offer three important extensions of RIO: 1) we generalize RIO to any model for which linear predictors are estimated; 2) we introduce an adapted bootstrap approach for determining whether case-level contributions differ from the baseline average contribution for cases; and 3) we describe how RIO is related to model diagnostics, particularly DFBETA. To illustrate the value added of these extensions, we apply RIO to a published example of the Cox proportional hazard model exploring factors associated with democratic durability.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 회귀계수의 사례별 기여를 분해하는 RIO를 선형 예측자를 추정하는 모든 모형으로 확장하고, 사례별 기여가 평균 기준과 다른지를 검정하는 부트스트랩과 모형 진단, 특히 DFBETA와의 관계를 제시한다. 이를 민주주의 지속성을 분석한 Cox 비례위험모형에 적용해 이러한 확장의 유용성을 보인다.
items.title: Turning Hazard Models Inside Out

items.abstract: ABSTRACT The second Trump administration saw the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), a group of outsider technologists given extraordinary power to pursue a massive downsizing of the federal government. They also displaced an alternative approach: the civic tech movement. Civic tech for government applies technology, data, and human‐centered design to improve policy implementation, fueled by prosocial motivation, promising to increase state capacity in a way that centers attention on public service clients. This article explains the origins of civic tech for government in the US setting, its core values, and evolution. The movement grew in prominence and influence from 2014 to 2024, making steady inroads into government but never gaining sufficient power to implement profound change. The conflicting origins, philosophy, and power between civic tech and DOGE offer contrasting visions for how tech can reshape the American administrative state.

Donald Moynihan: Ford School of Public Policy University of Michigan Ann Arbor Michigan USA

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 미국에서 정부를 위한 시민기술 운동의 기원·핵심 가치·발전을 설명하고, 시민기술과 DOGE가 기술을 통해 미국 행정국가를 재편하는 상반된 비전을 제시한다고 분석한다. 시민기술은 공공서비스 이용자를 중심에 두고 국가역량을 높이려 했으나 2014~2024년 정부 내 영향력을 확대하는 데 그쳤고, 근본적 변화를 실행할 충분한 권력을 확보하지 못했다고 주장한다.
items.title: From Civic Tech to DOGE : The Role of Tech Movements in the American Administrative State

items.abstract: Public management reforms like corporatization often fail due to a lack of cultural and institutional compatibility, leading to divergence from globally prescribed reform models rather than convergence towards their intended managerial and organizational outcomes. While global templates prioritize managerial autonomy and efficiency, national ‘cultural ecologies’ filter these changes, sometimes creating deceptive window dressing to secure external legitimacy. This paper addresses a significant gap in current research by exploring how social relationships governed by clientelism – integral to the cultural ecologies of many countries – also impact on reform implementation. Using the Iranian healthcare sector as a case study, the paper investigates whether clientelism inevitably derails corporatization (the brake) or serves as an inherent cultural component that managers must navigate to achieve organizational goals (the bridge).
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 이란 보건의료 부문 사례를 통해 고객주의적 사회관계가 병원 법인화 개혁을 필연적으로 저해하는지, 아니면 관리자가 조직 목표를 달성하도록 돕는 문화적 가교로 작용하는지를 탐구한다. 세계적 개혁 모형과 국가의 문화적 생태계 간 부적합성 속에서 고객주의는 법인화를 좌절시키는 제동장치이면서도 개혁 실행을 위해 관리자가 조정해야 하는 내재적 요소로 나타난다.
items.title: Brake or bridge? The dual impact of clientelism on hospital corporatization in Iran

items.abstract: Facing performance pressure, public organizations frequently experience top manager turnover, yet how they select successors is understudied. This study argues negative performance feedback (NPF) critically influences successor origin. Based on 2,045 TM turnovers , we find that NPF reduces the odds of internal succession by 41.7%. Internal promotion history strengthens external successor selection by signalling a break from discredited routines, while exploratory learning emphasis reinforces external selection as strategic identity. This research advances public management by offering a dynamic, antecedent-based explanation for TM selection, challenging monolithic views of organizational history, and highlighting successor origin as a strategic governance tool.

Jiaheng Ling: School of Public Policy & Management, Tsinghua University, Beijing, China
Siqi Chen: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China
Institutes of Science and Development, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China

items.summary_ko: 공공조직의 부정적 성과 피드백이 최고관리자 후계자의 내부·외부 출신 선택에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 2,045건의 최고관리자 교체 자료로 분석했다. 부정적 성과 피드백은 내부 승계 가능성을 41.7% 낮췄으며, 내부 승진 이력과 탐색적 학습 강조는 외부 후계자 선택을 강화했다.
items.title: Insider or outsider: negative performance feedback and top manager succession in the public sector

items.abstract: Public value research increasingly recognizes that societal value is generated by public, private, philanthropic, and hybrid actors. However, empirical tools for identifying public value beyond the state remain underdeveloped, particularly regarding its political-social dimension. This study operationalizes this dimension by identifying and analytically defining eight constituent elements. It draws on a multiple case study of three Brazilian social enterprises, combining document analysis, field visits, and semi-structured interviews. Findings clarify the dimension’s components and demonstrate how they can be identified in organizational practices and relationships. The study advances empirical approaches to public value and extends research to non-state actors in a non-European context.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 국가를 넘어 공공가치를 식별하기 위해 공공가치의 정치·사회적 차원을 어떻게 조작화할 수 있는지 탐구한다. 브라질 사회적기업 3곳을 대상으로 문서분석, 현장방문, 반구조화 인터뷰를 실시한 결과, 해당 차원을 구성하는 8개 요소를 정의하고 조직의 실천과 관계에서 이를 식별할 수 있음을 보였다.
items.title: Revisiting the political-social dimension of public value

items.abstract: This study explores how NGOs facilitate the transition from co-production to value co-creation in rural ecological governance through a case study of the Guanba River Basin, China. Drawing on qualitative evidence and social network analysis, it reveals that NGOs’ front-loaded participation in problem framing, planning, and rule formation creates institutional and relational foundations for collaborative governance. Beyond boundary-spanning roles, NGOs function as institutional intermediaries that reshape governance arrangements and enhance local capacity. Value co-creation emerges through institutional embeddedness, actor absorption, and adaptive governance within a recursive ecosystem. This study provides an institutionally grounded explanation of how externally facilitated co-production evolves into locally sustained value co-creation.
items.summary_ko: 중국 농촌 생태 거버넌스 사례를 통해, NGO가 문제 규정·계획·규칙 형성에 초기부터 참여함으로써 공동생산이 지역적으로 지속되는 가치 공동창출로 전환되는 과정을 분석한다. 질적 자료와 사회연결망 분석 결과, NGO는 경계 연결자를 넘어 제도적 중개자로서 거버넌스 arrangements와 지역 역량을 재구성하며 제도적 내재성, 행위자 흡수, 적응적 거버넌스를 통해 순환적 공공가치를 촉진하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: From co-production to value co-creation: NGOs as catalysts of cyclical public value in rural China

items.abstract: New Public Management (NPM) reforms are argued to have induced welfare state convergence in public sector organizing. However, this argument has been examined mainly at the discourse and decision-making level, leaving the adoption of NPM reforms at the organizational level underexplored. Taking non-profit marketization as a case, this study draws on survey data from non-profits across three welfare states to examine the extent to which (a) different marketization patterns appear and (b) these patterns are explained by contextual differences. Findings suggest that welfare state robustness, not convergence, is the superior frame of reference at the organizational level.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 벨기에·스웨덴·미국 비영리조직의 설문자료를 비교해 비영리 시장화 패턴의 차이와 맥락적 설명 여부를 검토했다. 조직 수준에서는 복지국가 수렴보다 복지국가의 견고성이 시장화 양상을 설명하는 데 더 적절한 틀이라는 결과를 제시한다.
items.title: Welfare State Convergence or Robustness? Comparing Nonprofit Marketization Patterns Across Belgium, Sweden and the United States

items.abstract: Hybrid work—alternating between office and remote locations—has become the norm across Canadian public services, yet questions remain about whether it is implemented fairly. In 2022, the Ontario Public Service (OPS) mandated three in-office days per week, then announced in August 2025 that all employees must return to the office full-time. Based on qualitative content analysis of OPS subreddit data and semi-structured interviews with Indigenous and Black public servants, this paper explores perspectives on hybrid work, focusing on fairness and equity. It examines access to hybrid arrangements, consistency in implementation and enforcement, and impacts on recruitment and retention. Findings reveal concerns about unequal access, inconsistent enforcement, and disproportionate burdens on racialized public servants, along with implications for recruiting and retaining talent. Fairness and equity should therefore be central considerations in public sector hybrid work and return-to-office policies, given their impacts on recruiting and retaining a diverse government workforce.
items.summary_ko: 온타리오 공공서비스의 하이브리드 근무에 대한 공정성과 형평성 인식을 레딧 자료의 질적 내용분석과 원주민·흑인 공무원 대상 반구조화 면담으로 분석했다. 분석 결과 하이브리드 근무 접근성의 불평등, 시행·집행의 불일치, 인종화된 공무원에게 집중되는 부담이 나타났으며, 이는 다양한 인력의 채용과 유지에 영향을 줄 수 있는 것으로 제시됐다.
items.title: Fairness and equity in hybrid work: insights from the Ontario Public Service

items.abstract: Abstract This article examines whether mainstream political parties adopt prejudiced rhetoric from the far right and how such shifts shape anti-prejudice norms. Building on existing work, I argue that mainstream parties are particularly influential in weakening anti-prejudice norms because they possess greater normative credibility and legitimacy than far-right parties. Empirically, the article combines cross-national observational evidence with two preregistered survey experiments in Germany and Denmark. Using parliamentary speeches from six European countries between 1994 and 2022, I document rising mainstream party anti-Muslim rhetoric and its association with weaker norms against holding far-right views. The experiments provide causal evidence for the argument. In Germany, exposure to prejudiced rhetoric weakens anti-prejudice norms, but only when voiced by mainstream parties, rather than far right parties, likely due to their normative credibility and legitimacy. In Denmark, comparable effects are absent, consistent with decades of mainstream accommodation having already normalized such rhetoric. The experimental results also show that rhetoric targeting Muslims weakens anti-prejudice norms toward out-groups more broadly, suggesting spillover effects. These findings have important implications for future scholarship: when mainstream parties adopt prejudiced rhetoric from the far right, they affect not only electoral politics, but also the broader social norm environment.
items.summary_ko: 주류 정당이 극우 정당의 반무슬림 수사를 채택할 때 반편견 규범이 약화되는지, 그리고 그 효과가 언제 나타나는지를 분석했다. 6개 유럽 국가의 의회 연설에 대한 비교 관찰분석과 독일·덴마크의 사전등록 설문실험을 결합한 결과, 독일에서는 주류 정당의 수사가 극우 정당의 수사보다 반편견 규범을 더 약화시켰지만 덴마크에서는 유사한 효과가 나타나지 않았으며, 무슬림 대상 수사의 효과는 다른 외집단에 대한 태도에도 파급되었다.
items.title: Credible Prejudice? When and Why Mainstream Party Adoption of Far-Right Rhetoric Weakens Anti-Prejudice Norms

items.abstract: Abstract To understand politics, people often rely on political discussion. Among the many ways that discussion may shape political perceptions, one possible mechanism is by promoting a shared sense of priorities— which issues are important. A second mechanism is by framing how people think about important issues. We examine these potential mechanisms by answering the descriptive question: Do policy priorities and policy frames tend to co-occur within political discussion networks? We answer this question by reanalyzing the 1996 Indianapolis-St. Louis Study in which participants—and their discussion partners—described the most important problem facing the United States in their own words. We show that the modal outcome is for people to hold both different priorities and different frames than their discussion partners. This finding stands in contrast to network scholarship suggesting that homophily is so often the norm. Yet we also show that people disproportionately share the same policy priorities as their discussion partners, and adopt the same frames in thinking about policy topics, especially when their policy priorities match. This finding suggests that some policy priorities are so embedded in certain frames of thinking that the topic and frame stay linked even as the topic may diffuse through a social network.
items.summary_ko: 정치적 토론 네트워크에서 사람들이 토론 상대와 정책 우선순위 및 정책 프레임을 공유하는지 검토하기 위해 1996년 인디애나폴리스–세인트루이스 연구 자료를 재분석했다. 사람들은 대체로 상대와 우선순위와 프레임이 모두 달랐지만, 정책 우선순위는 상대와 불균형적으로 공유되었고 우선순위가 일치할 때 동일한 프레임을 채택하는 경향도 나타났다.
items.title: Do Political Discussion Partners Share Policy Priorities and Policy Frames?

items.abstract: The transformation of parliamentarians into media producers has heightened concerns about emerging forms of political communication. This mixed-methods paper examines the strategies they employ to enhance their digital presence. Based on in-depth interviews, it shows that Brazilian parliamentarians believe that social media penalize them for posting about congressional matters, reporting that content about legislative work and constituency services receives little engagement online. Conversely, they view the production of antagonistic content and alignment with news cycles as essential to maintaining an engaging social media presence. A computational analysis of 4,5 million posts on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter supports these evaluations: posts about congressional matters are associated with lower engagement metrics, while the use of antagonistic language increases them. The analysis further discusses pathways through which visibility is sustained at the intersection of platform incentives and communicative practices. In sum, this mixed-methods study demonstrates that the mediatization of politics has created perverse incentives for parliamentarians to downplay congressional activity and prioritize confrontations on social media, weakening accountability in ways that may resonate far beyond Brazil.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 정치인들이 소셜미디어에서 의회 활동과 지역구 서비스를 알리는 대신 가시성을 높이기 위해 대립적 콘텐츠와 뉴스 주기 연계를 활용하는 이유와 효과를, 심층 인터뷰와 페이스북·인스타그램·트위터 게시물 450만 건의 계산적 분석으로 검토했다. 의회 관련 게시물은 참여도가 낮고 대립적 언어는 참여도를 높이는 것으로 나타나, 플랫폼 유인이 정치인들로 하여금 의정활동을 축소하고 대립을 우선시하게 해 책무성을 약화시킬 수 있음을 보였다.
items.title: The Democratic Cost of Pursuing Virality: A Study into Parliamentary Communications

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Faced with diverse and complex demands from citizens, the government has consistently sought ways to enhance its ability to respond. Metaphorically, citizens' needs can be viewed as locks, and the government requires keys to unlock them. Artificial intelligence (AI) is an innovative new key offering a fresh paradigm for unlocking the door to high citizen satisfaction. Drawing on government responsiveness theory, this study applies a 2 × 3 between‐subjects survey experiment to explore the impact of government response methods (traditional responses, AI‐enabled responses) and citizen demand types (consultation, complaint/help‐seeking, suggestions) on citizen satisfaction. Findings show that AI‐enabled government responses significantly increase citizen satisfaction compared to traditional approaches. Among demand types, consultation yields the highest satisfaction, while suggestion results in the lowest. Further, the satisfaction level is significantly influenced by the interaction effect between response method and demand type. Perceived fairness mediates the relationship between government responses and citizen satisfaction, with citizen participation experience having a moderating effect. This study offers new insights into increasing citizen satisfaction from the perspective of government responses. It reveals the content‐dependent nature of AI‐enabled government responses, helping the government create unique AI response strategies and enhance digital interaction with citizens.

Mengyao Zhang: College of Public Administration, Huazhong University of Science and Technology Wuhan China
Na Tang: College of Public Administration, Huazhong University of Science and Technology Wuhan China
Nana Huang: College of Public Administration, Huazhong University of Science and Technology Wuhan China
Wenjia Huang: College of Public Administration, Huazhong University of Science and Technology Wuhan China

items.summary_ko: 정부의 전통적·AI 기반 응답 방식과 시민 요구 유형이 시민 만족도에 미치는 영향을 2×3 집단 간 설문 실험으로 분석했다. AI 기반 응답은 전통적 응답보다 만족도를 높였고, 상담 요구의 만족도가 가장 높고 제안 요구가 가장 낮았으며, 응답 방식과 요구 유형의 상호작용이 유의했고 지각된 공정성이 매개하고 참여 경험이 조절했다.
items.title: The Right Key for the Right Lock: How Government Response Methods and Demand Types Affect Citizen Satisfaction

items.abstract: Performance metrics are often reported alongside benchmarks, such as past performance (historical reference point) or peer group performance (social reference point), often as part of a performance report or dashboard to inform the public and hold agencies accountable. Prior research has found that social reference points are more salient than historical ones in shaping citizens’ perceived performance. However, additional empirical evidence is crucial to enhance the generalizability of these findings and deepen our understanding of how citizens process different benchmarks. This study conceptually replicates and extends earlier work to further investigate how different types and combinations of benchmarks influence citizens’ perceptions and attitudes through three pre-registered randomized survey experiments. The findings reveal that reference points interact in complex ways: social reference points are less influential when presented alone but become more salient when paired with historical benchmarks. Moreover, while absolute performance levels affect citizens’ support for changes in public services, benchmarks alone do not. These results suggest that social reference points, historical reference points, and absolute performance metrics can all have meaning to citizens when forming judgments about public performance and making decisions. This study contributes to the literature by offering a more comprehensive understanding of how citizens interpret complex performance information.

Jinah Yoo: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey

items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 과거 실적과 동료 집단 실적 같은 기준점의 유형·조합이 시민의 공공서비스 성과 인식과 태도에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 세 차례 사전등록 무작위 설문실험으로 검토했다. 사회적 기준점은 단독으로 제시될 때보다 역사적 기준점과 함께 제시될 때 더 두드러졌으며, 서비스 변화 지지는 기준점보다 절대적 성과 수준의 영향을 받았다.
items.title: How Citizens Perceive Public Service Performance: Do Reference Points Really Matter?

items.abstract: Citizens often favor public servants who resemble them demographically, but studies also indicate that this preference for symbolic representation may be unevenly distributed, shaped by individuals’ own lived experiences. Against this backdrop, we ask: in what contexts do citizens express a preference for symbolic representation? Focusing on publicly-supported mental health services as an empirical case, we field a conjoint experiment depicting provider information in a format informed by real-world listings. We find that preferences for symbolic representation are most apparent for social groups that have experienced significant marginalization—women, non-binary respondents, and people of color. Meanwhile, factors describing the organizational context in which services are provided—wait times and modality of service provision—do not appear to consistently moderate the preference for symbolic representation. These results underscore the importance of macro factors, such as systemic racism and sexism, in shaping individual preferences for bureaucratic representation.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 시민이 어떤 맥락에서 자신과 인구학적으로 유사한 정신건강 서비스 제공자를 선호하는지 알아보기 위해, 실제 서비스 목록을 반영한 제공자 정보를 활용한 컨조인트 실험을 실시했다. 상징적 대표성 선호는 여성·논바이너리 응답자·유색인종처럼 상당한 주변화를 경험한 집단에서 가장 뚜렷했으며, 대기시간과 서비스 제공 방식은 이를 일관되게 조절하지 않았다.
items.title: Preferences for symbolic representation: identity, context, and selection of mental health providers

items.abstract: In their recent and first coauthored book, computer science scholars, Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor address promises and pitfalls with the “dawn of AI” (Narayanan and Kapoor 2024:3) amid the e...

Julie Beasley: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill School of Government

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 Narayanan과 Kapoor의 저서를 바탕으로 공공서비스에서 AI의 약속과 위험, 특히 ‘AI snake oil’에 관한 논의를 검토한다. AI의 발전이 제시하는 기대와 한계를 함께 조명하지만, 제공된 초록만으로는 별도의 연구질문이나 경험적 분석, 구체적 결론을 확인할 수 없다.
items.title: The promises and pitfalls of AI in public service: a review of AI snake oil,

items.abstract: This study examines how candidates’ gender shapes campaign messaging across different branches and levels of political office. Prior research offers mixed evidence on whether women are more likely than men to emphasize communal traits and women-related policies, often because gender effects are examined without fully accounting for institutional context. We address this inconsistency by foregrounding the role of electoral institutions. Building on strategic stereotype theory, we argue that gendered campaign messaging is a strategic response to office-specific incentives and expectations. In particular, we expect gendered appeals to be more prevalent at lower levels of government than at higher levels, and more pronounced in legislative than in executive races. We test these expectations using an original dataset of 46,966 official campaign booklets issued by all candidates competing for district-based executive and legislative offices in seventeen national and local elections in South Korea from 2000 to 2022. These booklets are legally standardized, page-limited documents distributed to voters and provide a rare opportunity to compare campaign messages across offices while holding the communication medium constant. We measure gendered messaging through candidates’ use of relational language and women-related policy terms. The results show that female candidates emphasize relational identities and women’s policy concerns more than male candidates. Crucially, the magnitude of this gender gap varies across institutional contexts. Gender differences are larger in legislative contests than in executive races and increase as elections move from national to subnational levels.
items.summary_ko: 정치적 직위의 유형과 수준에 따라 후보자의 성별이 선거 메시지에 미치는 영향이 어떻게 달라지는지를, 한국의 2000~2022년 전국·지방선거에서 지역구 행정부·입법부 후보자가 배포한 공식 선거공보 46,966건의 관계적 언어와 여성 관련 정책 용어로 분석했다. 여성 후보자는 남성 후보자보다 관계적 정체성과 여성 정책을 더 강조했으며, 이러한 성별 격차는 행정부보다 입법부 선거에서, 전국보다 지방 수준에서 더 크게 나타났다.
items.title: Does Office Type Determine Gendered Campaign Messages?

items.abstract: Local governments worldwide increasingly adopt social media to engage citizens. What factors make governments more likely to respond to citizens on social media? We explore how Mexican municipal governments use Facebook to interact with citizens, with a mixed-methods approach analysing data from 635 municipalities. Using a crisp-set qualitative comparative analysis, we distinguish between general responsiveness (channel setup) and interactive responsiveness (substantive engagement). Small municipalities are more likely to engage citizens when adaptive potential and formal participation policies are present. In contrast, larger cities show responsiveness when they have available resources, established participation rules and policies, and a propitious environment.

Guillermo M. Cejudo: Centre for Research and Teaching in Economics CIDE

items.summary_ko: 멕시코 635개 지방자치단체의 페이스북 활용을 대상으로, 지방정부가 시민에게 반응할 가능성을 어떻게 좌우하는지 혼합방법과 크리스프셋 질적비교분석으로 분석했다. 소규모 지방정부는 적응 잠재력과 공식 참여정책이 있을 때, 대도시는 자원·확립된 참여 규칙과 정책·우호적 환경이 있을 때 시민 참여와 상호작용에 더 반응적이었다.
items.title: Unpacking local government responsiveness to social media: evidence from Mexico

items.abstract: This qualitative case study examines how a federal field detachment sustained operational continuity during the initial implementation of the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) workforce reforms. Centered on the loss of a clearance-restricted Security Officer, the study draws on interviews, surveys, and organizational artifacts to examine how responsibilities were redistributed under constrained staffing conditions. Findings indicate that mission-essential operations were maintained through task redistribution, knowledge capture, leadership, and informal coordination; however, these adaptive responses also increased workload concentration, exposed dependence on undocumented institutional knowledge, and heightened reliance on individual effort. The study distinguishes operational continuity from organizational resilience by demonstrating that sustained mission performance can mask underlying degradation in organizational capacity. The findings extend beyond the DOGE reforms and offer practical lessons for workforce restructuring, continuity planning, succession management, and organizational resilience across public and private organizations.

Erick Yokomizo: Colorado State University, Fort Collins, USA
Greg Lockhart: Colorado State University, Fort Collins, USA
Justin P. Johnson: Colorado State University, Fort Collins, USA
Matthew W. Hurtienne: Colorado State University, Fort Collins, USA

items.summary_ko: 이 질적 사례연구는 DOGE 인력개혁 초기 시행에서 연방 현장 파견조직이 보안인가가 필요한 보안담당자 공석에도 업무 연속성을 어떻게 유지했는지, 면담·설문·조직자료를 통해 분석했다. 업무 재분배, 지식 포착, 리더십, 비공식 조정으로 핵심 운영은 지속됐지만, 업무 집중과 문서화되지 않은 지식 의존 및 개인 노력에 대한 의존이 커져 운영 연속성이 조직 회복탄력성의 약화를 가릴 수 있음을 보였다.
items.title: Organizational Resilience in Public Workforce Transitions: A Case Study of Continuity and Change under the DOGE Reforms

items.abstract: In 1929, the British Empire launched a four-decade development initiative to modernize colonial economies without self-government. Known as the Colonial Development and Welfare Fund, the program required colonial administrations to raise local taxes to cofinance development projects. This article shows that imperial aid expanded colonial taxation only after organizational reforms in the Colonial Service screened in officials who shared the metropole’s developmental agenda and made tax mobilization incentive-compatible with career advancement. Drawing on original data from 12 African colonies and extensive archival evidence, I show that aid increased tax revenues when patronage-based governors were replaced by career officers and promotion within the Colonial Service became conditional on fiscal performance. These findings highlight how bureaucratic incentives shaped the effectiveness of imperial aid and offer a new explanation for the expansion of fiscal capacity in late colonial Africa.
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 식민지 개발 원조가 아프리카 식민지의 조세 동원을 언제 확대했는지를 12개 식민지의 원자료와 광범위한 기록자료로 분석한다. 원조는 식민행정의 후원 기반 총독을 경력 관료로 교체하고 승진을 재정 성과와 연계하는 조직개혁이 이루어졌을 때에만 세수를 늘렸다.
items.title: Imperial Aid and Tax Mobilization in Late Colonial Africa

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Artificial intelligence (AI) has gained much interest in public administration and public policy fields in recent years. Research on and that uses AI has so far treated it as an object or context within the broader administrative and governance discourse. In this article, we aim to shift the locus of scholarly attention on AI by focusing on its premise as a new epistemic technology that will shape how scholars conduct research. In doing so, it proposes a framework for leveraging AI as a methodological enabler that augments researchers' cognitive and analytical capabilities, thereby overcoming longstanding methodological barriers in the fields. We propose a framework distinguishing AI applications along two epistemological dimensions of research that make use of synthetic data and real‐world data: (1) inductive approaches to discover patterns and build theory to address exploratory questions (“what,” “so what”), and (2) deductive approaches to test hypotheses and establish causal relationships to serve explanatory and predictive purposes (“why,” “how”). We contend that AI has propelled the fields toward a “new normal science” characterized by human‐machine collaboration.

Jianxiang Tan: Department of Public and International Affairs City University of Hong Kong Hong Kong China
Yanto Chandra: Department of Public and International Affairs City University of Hong Kong Hong Kong China

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 인공지능을 공공행정·정책 연구를 증강하는 새로운 인식론적 기술로 활용할 수 있는 방법을 어떻게 체계화할 것인지 묻고, 합성자료와 현실자료를 대상으로 귀납적 탐색과 연역적 가설·인과 검증을 구분하는 분석 틀을 제시한다. 주요 결론은 AI가 연구자의 인지·분석 능력을 보완하며 인간-기계 협력에 기반한 ‘새로운 정상과학’을 촉진한다는 것이다.
items.title: Epistemic Capabilities of Artificial Intelligence for Public Administration and Policy Research: A Framework for Scholarship in the Age of Intelligent Machines

items.abstract: Abstract One formal mechanism for effecting change to progress the rights of structurally disadvantaged groups is via citizen referenda. However, referenda are often characterized by divisive public debate. We suggest that sustaining action for long‐term change (beyond a referendum itself) may be associated with identifying with an opinion‐based group and perceiving shared values between advantaged and disadvantaged groups. Among a nationally representative sample of Australians ( N = 2467), we examined collective action intentions for the Reconciliation Movement 1 month before, 1 week before, and 1 week after the 2023 Voice to Parliament referendum. Study 1 used a random intercept cross‐lagged panel model to show that value consensus, opinion‐based identification as a supporter of Reconciliation, and reconciliation action were positively associated at a temporally stable level, but within‐person effects did not vary much from these levels. Study 2 used growth mixture models and revealed five diverging trajectories of reconciliation action, which were explained by differences in value consensus, opinion‐based identification, and support/opposition to the Voice referendum. Our findings offer some of the first evidence showing that value consensus and opinion‐based identification are associated with sustaining action for social change, especially during times of polarization and division.

Emily A. Haines: College of Human Sciences and Culture Flinders University Adelaide South Australia Australia
Emma F. Thomas: College of Human Sciences and Culture Flinders University Adelaide South Australia Australia
Janquel D. Acevedo: School of Psychology The University of Queensland Brisbane Queensland Australia
Michael Wenzel: College of Human Sciences and Culture Flinders University Adelaide South Australia Australia
Susilo Wibisono: School of Psychology Murdoch University Perth Western Australia Australia
Winnifred R. Louis: School of Psychology The University of Queensland Brisbane Queensland Australia

items.summary_ko: 2023년 호주 ‘의회 발언권(Voice to Parliament)’ 국민투표를 전후해, 화해운동의 장기적 집단행동 의도가 공유 가치 인식과 의견 기반 집단 동일시와 어떻게 관련되는지 전국 대표 표본 설문으로 분석했다. 패널 모형과 성장 혼합 모형 분석 결과, 두 요인은 화해 행동과 시간적으로 안정적인 긍정적 관련을 보였고, 가치 합의·동일시·국민투표 찬반에 따라 화해 행동의 다섯 가지 궤적이 나타났다.
items.title: From referendum to reconciliation: How shared values and identities align with a commitment to long‐term collective action

items.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines how a propaganda frame alleging the existence of a “Censorship Industrial Complex” was institutionalized and then helped justify the dismantling of US election information resilience infrastructure across multiple federal agencies. Drawing on documentary evidence and process tracing, we show how political entrepreneurs reframed routine, non‐coercive election information coordination and communication practices as a covert censorship regime targeting conservative speech. The article argues that this case is best understood as administrative deformation: weakly evidenced claims were laundered into higher‐status venues, including congressional investigations, litigation, executive action, and budget rationales, where they altered the incentive environment facing public agencies. The result was staff reductions, program cuts, and chilling effects, and weakened state capacity in a core domain of democratic administration. We conclude with recommendations for protecting administrative resilience under conditions of narrative attack.

Dean Jackson: University of Pittsburgh's Communication Research Technology Lab (CTRL) Pittsburgh Pennsylvania USA
Renée DiResta: Georgetown University's McCourt School of Public Policy Washington DC USA

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 ‘검열 산업 복합체’라는 선전 프레임이 어떻게 제도화되어 미국 연방기관의 선거 정보 회복탄력성 인프라 해체를 정당화했는지 문서 증거와 과정추적을 통해 분석한다. 근거가 취약한 주장이 의회 조사·소송·행정조치·예산 논리 등 권위 있는 장으로 유입되면서 기관의 유인 환경을 바꾸고, 인력 감축·프로그램 축소·위축 효과를 통해 민주적 행정의 핵심 영역에서 국가역량을 약화시켰다고 주장한다.
items.title: Propaganda, Administrative Deformation, and the Erosion of State Capacity: The Case of the “Censorship Industrial Complex”

items.abstract: Public employees increasingly face turbulent challenges in which principles such as foresight, planning, and consensus-seeking fall short. We examine bricolage as a robust governance strategy and conceptualize turbulence as a contextual moderator of the relationship between public leadership and bricolage behaviour. Based on survey data from 368 German public employees, the findings suggest that bricolage is less practiced under turbulent conditions. While rule-following leadership, contrary to expectations, becomes even more strongly and positively related to bricolage behaviour as conditions grow more turbulent, the positive association between accountability leadership and bricolage behaviour weakens substantially. Surprisingly, network governance leadership does not gain in importance. This study contributes to public administration research by further conceptualizing and exploring bricolage as a micro-level behavioural capacity in response to turbulence, by operationalizing turbulence as a graded situational stressor, and by demonstrating that turbulent contexts constitute a critical boundary condition for the exercise of public leadership.
items.summary_ko: 독일 공무원 368명을 대상으로 한 설문을 통해, 격변성이 공공리더십과 관료제 내 브리콜라주 행동의 관계를 어떻게 조절하는지 분석했다. 격변적 조건에서는 브리콜라주가 전반적으로 덜 나타났지만, 규칙준수 리더십과의 긍정적 관계는 강화된 반면 책무성 리더십과의 관계는 약화되었고, 네트워크 거버넌스 리더십의 중요성은 커지지 않았다.
items.title: Bricolage in bureaucracies: public leadership and bricolage behaviour in turbulent situations

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Regulatory capture, where special interests steer regulation away from public interest, is widely discussed, but its broader public consequences remain underexplored. We explore the relationship between perceived regulatory capture, public trust and pro‐environmental behaviors using online survey data in China. Findings show that perceived material and information capture (the latter measured with a single scenario‐based proxy) have significant negative associations with public trust in local ( b = −0.154, −0.105) and central government ( b = −0.087, −0.064). Direct associations with non‐activist pro‐environmental behaviors in the public sphere are consistently negative and supported by bootstrapped confidence intervals across specifications (material: β = −0.066 to −0.082; information: β = −0.036 to −0.047), whereas several corresponding private sphere associations are not. Indirect associations are supported only in selected models. These findings highlight the public implications of regulatory capture, distinguishing material and information capture, and extend understanding of public trust and pro‐environmental behaviors.

Jianhua Xu: School of Government Peking University Beijing China
Institute for Global Health and Development Peking University Beijing China
Songsong Chen: School of Public Policy and Management Tsinghua University Beijing China

items.summary_ko: 중국 온라인 설문자료를 활용해 인식된 규제 포획이 지방·중앙정부에 대한 공공 신뢰 및 친환경 행동과 어떤 관련이 있는지 분석했다. 물질적·정보적 포획 인식은 정부 신뢰와 공공 영역의 비활동적 친환경 행동에 일관되게 부정적으로 연관됐지만, 사적 영역 행동과 신뢰를 통한 간접 연관은 일부 모형에서만 지지됐다.
items.title: Regulatory Capture, Public Trust and Pro‐Environmental Behaviors

items.abstract: ABSTRACT In crisis responses such as the COVID‐19 medical supply shortage, senior policy makers often emphasize urgency, a strategy that prioritizes the rapid achievement of intermediate goals. While this approach can drive swift action, it also introduces challenges and trade‐offs that can hinder collaboration toward long‐term success. These challenges often arise from misalignment between organizational norms and priorities of collaborating partners, which can undermine legitimacy and performance. Policymakers should consider how personnel composition, such as large military contingents, shapes task force culture and operational dynamics. Even in fast‐moving crises, clearly aligning roles, goals, and timelines from the start can reduce confusion, while leaders must navigate cultural norms and challenge ingrained practices to support collaboration.

Christopher Bowers: US Department of Defense Washington DC USA
James L. Olds: Schar School of Policy and Government George Mason University Washington DC USA
Qian Hu: Schar School of Policy and Government George Mason University Washington DC USA

items.summary_ko: 코로나19 의료물자 부족 위기에서 긴급성을 우선하는 대응이 협력의 장기적 성공에 어떤 긴장과 상충을 초래하는지 검토한다. 협력 기관 간 규범·우선순위의 불일치, 대규모 군 인력의 참여에 따른 태스크포스 문화, 역할·목표·일정의 불명확성이 협력의 정당성과 성과를 저해할 수 있으며, 초기 조정과 문화적 규범에 대한 리더십이 이를 완화할 수 있음을 제시한다.
items.title: Managing Collaboration Dynamics Under Pressure: Lessons From the COVID ‐19 Medical Supply Shortage

items.abstract: Abstract Low‐skilled men have long been vulnerable to globalization, decarbonization, and other forms of economic disruption. When shocks are realized, women often increase their paid labor to compensate for men's loss of income. We study how layoffs of low‐skilled men and concurrent shifts in workforce composition toward women affect voting. We theorize that this labor market rebalancing produces “nostalgic” coalitions of men and women that seek a return to male‐breadwinner family models. Such attitudes fuel right‐wing movements that pledge to protect conservative gender roles. Evidence from local labor markets and voting in the United States over the last two decades, as well as a longitudinal study tracking individual Americans over several decades, support this theory. These findings contribute a new gender‐based account of the globalization backlash.

Noah Zucker: Assistant Professor, Department of Politics Princeton University Princeton New Jersey USA
Richard Clark: Associate Professor, Department of Political Science University of Notre Dame Notre Dame Indiana USA
Roza Khoban: Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Economics University of Zurich Zürich Switzerland

items.summary_ko: 저숙련 남성의 해고와 여성 중심으로 재편되는 노동시장 구성이 투표에 미치는 영향을 분석한 결과, 이러한 재편은 남성 생계부양자 가족모델로의 회귀를 추구하는 남녀의 ‘향수적’ 연합과 우파 운동을 강화하는 것으로 나타났다. 연구는 미국의 지역 노동시장·투표 자료와 장기 개인추적 자료를 활용해 이론을 검증했다.
items.title: Breadwinner backlash: The gendered effects of industrial decline

items.abstract: To mitigate and adapt to the challenges posed by population aging, the Chinese government had implemented the New Rural Pension Program (NRPP), a top-down initiative with extensive coverage. As a form of social welfare, it remains unclear whether the implementation of the NRPP improves rural residents’ attitudes toward public services. To identify this causal relationship, this study disaggregates public services attitudes into eight dimensions and employs five waves of CFPS data (2012–2020) to examine the effects of NRPP benefit receipt on public services attitudes. Results show that receiving social welfare significantly improves farmers’ evaluations of public services. Moreover, increased trust in local officials serves as an important mechanism, while household size moderates this effect. This study extends the explanatory scope of theories such as self-interest theory and offers targeted recommendations for the construction and development of China’s social security system.
items.summary_ko: 중국 신농촌연금제도(NRPP) 급여 수급이 농촌 주민의 공공서비스 태도에 미치는 인과적 영향을 분석하기 위해 2012~2020년 CFPS 5개 시점 자료로 공공서비스 태도를 8개 차원으로 나누어 검토했다. 사회복지 수급은 공공서비스 평가를 유의하게 높였으며, 지방 공무원에 대한 신뢰가 주요 기제이고 가구 규모가 이 효과를 조절했다.
items.title: How Does Participation in the New Rural Pension Program Affect Attitudes Toward Public Services?

items.abstract: Public sector organizations increasingly operate within broader performance regimes—the wider systems of rules, actors, and practices that shape how performance is measured and managed—yet little research has examined how these regimes enable or block attempts of public sector organizations to redesign their performance measurement (PM) systems. This study addresses that gap by developing an analytical framework built around the concept of lock-in mechanisms, which provides a structured way to identify regulatory, material, behavioral and discursive barriers to the redesign of public sector PM. This framework is then applied to the performance regime governing Danish employment services, where municipal job centers are actively trying to redesign their PM systems to better reflect client experiences and value creation. Our findings reveal that redesign efforts are constrained by lock-in mechanisms operating at three distinct levels: within the institutional context, mechanisms entrench upward accountability as the dominant purpose of PM; at the level of performance actors, mechanisms preserve rigid boundaries between those who are measured and those who do the measuring; and at the level of performance interventions, mechanisms sustain top-down uses of performance information, limiting more bottom-up approaches.
items.summary_ko: 공공부문 성과측정 체계의 재설계를 가로막거나 가능하게 하는 성과 레짐의 잠금 메커니즘을 분석하기 위해, 덴마크 고용서비스의 성과 레짐에 분석틀을 적용했다. 제도적 맥락에서는 상향책임성, 성과 행위자 수준에서는 측정자와 피측정자의 경계, 성과 개입 수준에서는 하향식 성과정보 활용이 고착되어 재설계를 제약하는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Arrested development: how performance regimes constrain changes to public sector performance measurement

items.abstract: Traditional hierarchical approaches to governing and leading public professionals have not always proven successful, and integrative and hybrid perspectives on professionalism are therefore receiving increasing attention. This study integrates professional development leadership (PDL) and distributed leadership (DL) theory and introduces the concept of distributed professional development leadership (D-PDL). D-PDL implies that employees without formal leadership responsibilities are engaged in core PDL activities focused on facilitating and realizing a shared understanding of professionalism within the scope of organizational goals. The study theorizes that professionals’ engagement in D-PDL leads to more autonomous motivation than engagement in generic DL, which covers a broad range of leadership activities that are disconnected from the professional core task. Survey data from approximately 2,400 Danish medical doctors support the theoretical framework and show that doctors’ engagement in D-PDL is associated with more intrinsic motivation and public service motivation, whereas their engagement in generic DL is primarily associated with extrinsic motivation. The study emphasizes the relevance of moving PDL beyond a leader-centric concept and of distinguishing between different types of DL activities.
items.summary_ko: 본 연구는 전문직 개발 리더십(PDL)과 분산적 리더십(DL)을 통합해 분산적 전문직 개발 리더십(D-PDL)을 개념화하고, 일반적 DL보다 전문직의 자율적 동기를 더 높이는지 덴마크 의사 약 2,400명의 설문자료로 검토했다. D-PDL 참여는 내재적 동기와 공공봉사동기와 연관된 반면, 일반적 DL 참여는 주로 외재적 동기와 연관되는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Differentiating distributed leadership: introducing distributed professional development leadership and its motivational consequences

items.abstract: Public service motivation (PSM) is widely treated as a resource that strengthens engagement, yet excessive motivation may yield diminishing returns. Integrating the job demands-resources model, conservation of resources theory, and the too-much-of-a-good-thing logic, this study tests a curvilinear relationship between PSM and job exhaustion, and the moderating role of collaborative culture. Using a two-wave survey of 408 Korean public servants with a one-month lag, hierarchical regressions identify a U-shaped pattern: exhaustion declines at low-to-moderate PSM but rises beyond a threshold. Collaborative culture significantly flattens this curve, indicating that supportive, collective norms mitigate PSM-related strain at very high levels of PSM. The findings challenge the assumption that PSM is uniformly beneficial, recasting PSM as a conditional resource that can operate as a demand at high levels. The study clarifies when PSM is sustainable and positions collaboration as an actionable boundary condition, yielding implications for motivation theory and for the collaborative organization of public service.
items.summary_ko: 한국 공무원 408명을 대상으로 1개월 간격의 2시점 설문과 위계적 회귀분석을 통해 공공봉사동기(PSM)와 직무 소진의 비선형 관계 및 협력적 조직문화의 조절효과를 검증했다. PSM은 낮거나 중간 수준에서는 소진을 낮추지만 일정 수준을 넘으면 소진을 높였으며, 협력적 조직문화는 이러한 U자형 관계를 완화했다.
items.title: Motivated to exhaustion? Public service motivation, curvilinear strain, and the buffer of collaborative culture

items.abstract: Administrative reforms often seek to improve performance by changing bureaucratic or professional expertise. Yet technical skills alone may not disrupt the forces that generate unequal outcomes across social groups. We argue that systemic bias shapes professionalization and discretionary judgment, limiting expertise-substitution reforms’ capacity to reduce racial disparities even when they improve average outcomes. We test this using a 2018 Dallas reform that deployed co-response teams pairing police officers with clinicians and social workers on mental health calls. A difference-in-­differences analysis across divisions finds significant reductions in psychiatric holds and arrests, but the gains concentrate among White male citizens; arrests of Black males increase significantly. A complementary incident-level analysis of the conditional probability of a coercive outcome points to a different pattern of heterogeneous effects: White males show a higher post-reform probability of psychiatric holds while Black females and Hispanic males experience lower ones. Both sets of findings shed new light on the scholarship of administrative reform and hold practical implications for both the impact of such programs and the ways in which they are evaluated.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 전문지식 대체형 행정개혁이 인종별 불평등을 줄일 수 있는지, 2018년 댈러스의 경찰·임상가·사회복지사 공동대응팀 개혁을 대상으로 부서 간 이중차분 및 사건 수준 분석으로 검토했다. 정신과적 강제입원과 체포는 전반적으로 감소했지만 효과는 백인 남성에게 집중되었고, 흑인 남성의 체포는 유의하게 증가했으며, 강제적 결과의 조건부 확률에서도 인종·성별에 따른 이질적 효과가 나타났다.
items.title: Reform for all? The limits of expertise in producing equitable outcomes

items.abstract: Strategy content is an inherent part of the strategic management of public service organizations. Venerable research on strategy content proposes that organizations with the strategic stance of a prospector (i.e. innovation-oriented) outperform a defender (i.e. core business-oriented) in terms of public service performance (PSP), while a reactor (i.e. awaits instructions) negatively associates with PSP. Previous reviews have supported these propositions, but they have relied on binary integration techniques. We present meta-analytic evidence (articles = 22, effect sizes = 88) of the extent to which strategy content matters for PSP. Our findings support expectations; however, the overall effect sizes are not major: small to moderate for prospectors and trivial for defenders and reactors. Strategy content matters at least somewhat but is hardly a silver bullet and needs to be considered in relation to broader strategy processes and practices. Variation in effect sizes is uncovered _via_ moderator analysis. A prospector strategy appears more pronounced when performance is measured as an index or output (less well for effectiveness and efficiency) and for multi-purpose organizations. A defender strategy is associated with enhancing outputs and for single-purpose organizations. In conclusion, we reconsider the venerable tenets of the strategy content–PSP relationship and stipulate an agenda for future research.
items.summary_ko: 전략 내용이 공공서비스 성과에 얼마나 영향을 미치는지 22편 논문과 88개 효과크기를 활용한 메타분석으로 검토했다. 기대한 방향은 대체로 지지됐지만 효과는 전반적으로 작았으며, 탐색자 전략은 산출·지표 기반 성과와 다목적 조직에서, 방어자 전략은 산출 증대와 단일목적 조직에서 더 두드러졌다.
items.title: Revisiting the venerable debate on strategy content and public service performance

items.abstract: While contracting out is often viewed as having negative consequences for public employees, less attention has been paid to the positive outcomes certain types of contracting may have for them. In particular, recent scholarship proposes that contracting out may improve employees’ work attitudes when it emphasizes pro-social factors in the process. Using the case of the federal Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) contracting program—which emphasizes diversity and equity in procurement—this study examines whether contracting programs that promote social outcomes are associated with public employees’ job satisfaction. Drawing from research on sector differences, person-organization fit, and representative bureaucracy, we hypothesize a positive association between SDB contracting efforts and job satisfaction, with employees from underrepresented backgrounds experiencing a more pronounced increase. Linking U.S. federal government contracting data to the Federal Employee Viewpoint Survey (FEVS), our analyses provide support for the hypotheses. The implications of these findings for government contracting and public human resource management are discussed.
items.summary_ko: 연방 소기업 불리기업(SDB) 계약 프로그램처럼 다양성과 형평성 등 친사회적 성과를 강조하는 외주계약이 공무원의 직무만족도와 관련되는지, 그리고 그 효과가 소수 배경 직원에게 더 큰지를 검토했다. 연방 계약자료와 연방 공무원 인식조사(FEVS)를 연계한 분석 결과, SDB 계약 노력은 직무만족도와 긍정적으로 관련되며 그 증가 폭은 대표성이 낮은 배경의 직원에게 더 큰 것으로 나타났다.
items.title: Socially oriented contracting and public employees’ job satisfaction: evidence from the federal small disadvantaged business program

items.abstract: This paper draws together insights from political science and political communication to advance a new understanding of the role of media in democratic backsliding and resilience. The central argument is that all political actors may also be media actors, although they may do so anonymously or use false identities. Thus, mass participation in media enables mass participation in political change, with better and worse democratic outcomes. As such, when analyzing backsliding and resilience scholars need to move away from focusing solely on particular institutions and actors with presumed democratic functions, as well as assuming that media and expressive freedom will necessarily serve democratic ends. Instead, we advocate analyzing how the participatory media practices of various actors interact with one another via communicative structures within processes of backsliding and resilience. Participatory media practices that prevent democratic breakdown include disseminating early warnings of backsliding, exposing executive errors and corruption, coordinating pro-democratic mobilization, and platforming the opposition, as well as countering disinformation and delegitimizing democratic institutions and processes. We also indicate how participatory media practices may aid democratic bounceback, as well as the challenges involved in reimagining the media infrastructure needed to sustain democratic recovery in the long-term. Thus, we argue that democratic backsliding and resilience should be reconceptualized as profoundly participatory, mediated processes.
items.summary_ko: 본 논문은 민주적 퇴행과 회복탄력성을 분석할 때 정치행위자와 미디어행위자의 구분을 넘어, 다양한 행위자의 참여적 미디어 관행이 의사소통 구조를 통해 상호작용하는 매개된 과정에 주목해야 한다고 주장한다. 이러한 관행은 퇴행의 조기 경고·권력 남용 폭로·민주적 동원·야당의 발언 기회 제공·허위정보 대응 등을 통해 민주주의의 붕괴를 막거나 회복을 지원할 수 있지만, 반대로 민주적 제도와 절차를 약화시킬 수도 있다.
items.title: Political Actors and Their Media Practices: Analyzing the Role of Media Participation in Democratic Backsliding and Resilience

items.abstract: This article makes the argument that design can serve the purpose of transforming power relations in societal transitions. The article discusses diverse theories of power and their relationship to design, whereby it considers aspects of agency, relationality and scale. Using a design anthropology approach, a theoretical framework is defined for the empirical study of power. The framework is operationalized in a local energy transition project in Amsterdam Southeast. In this empirical study, we describe three power relations that were encountered, the design interventions performed, and their transformative outcomes. Finally, the broader implications for design in societal transitions are discussed.

Abhigyan Singh: Amsterdam Institute for Advanced Metropolitan Solutions, the Netherlands

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 사회적 전환에서 디자인이 행위성·관계성·규모를 고려해 권력관계를 변형할 수 있는지 이론화하고, 디자인 인류학의 분석틀을 암스테르담 남동부의 지역 에너지 전환 프로젝트에 적용했다. 사례에서 확인된 세 가지 권력관계와 디자인 개입 및 그 변혁적 결과를 제시하며, 사회적 전환에서 디자인의 함의를 논의한다.
items.title: Design anthropology for transforming power relations in societal transitions

items.abstract: This article compares agencification in developing and OECD countries, illustrated by the case of Suriname. Findings show that developing countries prefer statutory bodies and SOEs. Motives for establishment are economic development and the provision of collective goods; typical motives from OECD countries are not present. Patronage plays a major role, and governance and accountability relations are generally weak. Based on these findings, existing agencification theory should include motives that are specific to developing countries, such as pressure from international organizations; pay attention to colonial legacies and acknowledge that agencification in developing countries is much less driven by NPM.
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 수리남의 준공공기관을 사례로 개발도상국과 OECD 국가의 기관화를 비교한다. 개발도상국에서는 경제개발과 집합재 제공, 국제기구의 압력 및 후견주의가 기관 설립에 중요하며, 거버넌스와 책무성은 약하고 신공공관리의 영향은 상대적으로 제한적이라는 점을 보인다.
items.title: Executive agencies in developing countries: the case of the parastatal organizations in Suriname

items.abstract: Public-sector classification systems accumulate classification drift, a widening gap between what employees actually do, how their work is described, and how they are compensated. Because classification shapes pay, role comparison, and internal equity at scale, classification drift quietly compounds into measurable inequity. At a large U.S. urban public school district (the District), this drift manifested as 435 employees sharing the title “Specialist” across 24 pay grades ($47,000–$125,000). This article describes PRISM (Progressive Refinement and Intelligence Synthesis Model), a multi-model AI framework developed with a research-university partner’s Data Science Institute that introduces validation friction at high-stakes decision points. Rather than automating approvals, PRISM surfaces disagreement between independent AI models and routes ambiguous cases to human reviewers with a structured evidence package. Across 992 positions, 173 cases (17%) were flagged for escalated review. This article describes what public HR offices, with or without AI, can do to address classification drift.

Martin Renfro: Metro Nashville Public Schools, TN, USA
Wayne Birch: Metro Nashville Public Schools, TN, USA

items.summary_ko: 이 글은 공공부문 직무분류에서 실제 업무·직무기술·보상 간 격차인 ‘분류 표류’가 어떻게 불평등을 누적시키는지, 그리고 이를 식별·검토할 수 있는지를 다룬다. 미국 대도시 교육구의 992개 직위를 대상으로 독립적인 AI 모델 간 불일치를 인간 검토로 넘기는 PRISM을 적용한 결과, 173건(17%)이 추가 검토 대상으로 분류되었다.
items.title: Classification Drift: Decisions Passing Quietly but Compounding Inequity

items.abstract: Existing accounts of presidential particularism emphasize the targeted distribution of benefits to electorally valuable constituencies. This research note demonstrates that presidential particularism can also operate punitively, through the selective imposition of costs on constituencies that provided weaker electoral support for the president. I examine this dynamic through the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), a highly centralized and politicized agency created at the start of Donald Trump’s second term. Leveraging data on nearly 700,000 federal contracts linked to DOGE contract cuts and 2024 county-level election returns, I show that these cuts were systematically concentrated in counties that provided weaker electoral support for Trump. These patterns hold across contract- and county-level analyses. Together, these findings broaden theories of presidential particularism by showing that presidents may use administrative authority to impose costs on electorally oppositional constituencies. More broadly, I demonstrate how presidents can wield administrative power as a tool of partisan punishment.
items.summary_ko: 대통령의 특수주의가 선거적으로 덜 지지한 지역에 선택적으로 비용을 부과하는 방식으로도 작동하는지, DOGE와 약 70만 건의 연방계약 자료 및 2024년 카운티별 선거 결과를 분석했다. 분석 결과, DOGE의 계약 삭감은 트럼프 지지도가 낮았던 카운티에 체계적으로 집중되었으며, 이는 대통령이 행정권을 정파적 처벌의 수단으로 사용할 수 있음을 보여준다.
items.title: The Punitive Dimension of Presidential Particularism

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Donor‐conceived adults are a growing population, mobilizing against the very regulatory arrangements that determined the terms into which they were conceived. In Canada and the United States, where donor conception remains persistently under‐regulated, gamete donation policy has historically prioritized the presumed needs of donors, recipient parents, and fertility clinics, structuring regulation around treatment access and donor supply rather than the long‐term interests of those conceived. The result is a population that bears disproportionate administrative burdens and is now mobilizing through advocacy organizations, legal claims, and the pathways consumer DNA testing has made possible. Yet donor‐conceived adults remain largely outside the scope of policy scholarship. This paper argues that donor conception offers a theoretically distinctive site for the study of administrative burden, policy feedback, and the social construction of target populations. The paper proposes a research agenda organized around the politics of administratively produced populations and the deliberate distribution of administrative burden through policy design.

Ashley Splawinski: Department of Political Science University of Toronto Toronto Ontario Canada

items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 캐나다와 미국의 기증 생식 규제가 기증받아 태어난 사람들의 장기적 이해보다 기증자·수혜 부모·난임 클리닉의 필요와 치료 접근성 및 기증자 공급을 우선시하면서 행정적 부담을 불균등하게 배분해 왔다는 점을 연구 의제로 제시한다. 기증받아 태어난 성인들의 옹호 활동, 법적 청구, 소비자 DNA 검사 경로를 바탕으로 행정적 부담, 정책 피드백, 대상집단의 사회적 구성 및 ‘행정적으로 생산된 인구’의 정치에 대한 연구 방향을 제안한다.
items.title: From Policy Neglect to Research Agenda: Administrative Burdens and Donor‐Conceived Mobilization

items.abstract: ABSTRACT Switzerland presents a most peculiar political system whose institutional idiosyncrasies shape not only the practice of public administration but also the scientific study thereof. This country study presents the development and state of both public administration as practice and Public Administration as a scholarly discipline. It argues that both are largely determined by three properties of Switzerland as a political context and field of study: Semi‐direct democracy turns the administration into an important political actor. The “Milizsystem” (Switzerland's tradition of non‐professionalized, part‐time public engagement) enables hybrid careers between the public and private sectors and produces a structurally weaker political class that the professional administration regularly outmaneuvers. And the small size of the country has pushed the discipline toward international orientation while simultaneously entangling researchers with their object of study. Taken together, the Swiss case illustrates how political institutions do not merely constrain public administration but fundamentally constitute it.
